papers.title: Validation of a HILIC–LC–MS/MS Method for Simultaneous Determination of Paralytic Shellfish Toxins and Tetrodotoxins in Multiple Marine Matrices: The Critical Role of Matrix Effects
papers.authors: Lucchetti, Dario; Delfino, Daniela; Senofonte, Marta; Spinaci, Laura; Baccelliere, Rocco; Ubaldi, Alessandro; Longo, Francesca
papers.abstract: The presence and accumulation of marine biotoxins, including paralytic shellfish toxins (PSTs) and tetrodotoxin (TTX) analogues, in marine organisms poses a significant food safety concern. This study describes the validation of a quantitative confirmatory HILIC–LC–MS/MS method for the simultaneous determination of a broad panel of marine toxins in four matrices: mussels, clams, sea snails, and sea urchins. The method covered 17 target compounds, including TTX analogues (TTX, 4-epiTTX, and 4.9-anhTTX), saxitoxin and analogues (STX, dcSTX, NEO, and dcNEO), gonyautoxins (GTX 1–4, GTX 2–3, GTX 5, GTX 6, and dcGTX 2–3), and sulfocarbamoyl toxins C1–C2. Particular attention was devoted to the evaluation of matrix effects (ME), a critical factor affecting LC–MS/MS quantification. The method was validated according to SANTE/11312/2021 guidelines, showing satisfactory selectivity, precision (RSD ≤ 20%), and accuracy (recoveries within 70–120%). Significant matrix-dependent signal suppression and enhancement were observed among the investigated species. Matrix-matched calibration enabled reliable quantification in mussels, clams, and sea snails, whereas sea urchin samples showed greater analytical complexity. The validated method provides a robust approach for the determination of PSTs and TTX analogues in different marine organisms and supports its application in official monitoring programs.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究建立了HILIC–LC–MS/MS方法，可同时定量检测贻贝、蛤、海螺和海胆中17种麻痹性贝类毒素（PSTs）和河豚毒素（TTX）类似物，并依据SANTE/11312/2021指南完成验证，选择性、精密度（RSD ≤ 20%）和准确度（回收率70–120%）均满足要求。研究重点评估了matrix effects，发现不同物种间存在显著的信号抑制或增强，其中海胆基质分析复杂度最高。采用matrix-matched calibration可在贻贝、蛤和海螺中实现可靠定量，该方法适用于官方监测项目。

papers.title: Marine Macroalgae as Sustainable Feed Additives in Ruminants: A Systematic Review of Methane Mitigation and Animal Responses
papers.authors: Mwanda, Lwazi; Mbambalala, Lwando; Idowu, Peter Ayodeji
papers.abstract: This systematic review synthesized evidence on the effects of marine macroalgae supplementation on enteric methane (CH4) emissions, rumen fermentation, nutrient utilization, animal performance, animal health, and product quality in ruminants. Google Scholar, Scopus, Web of Science, and CAB Abstracts with Full Text were systematically searched for peer-reviewed in vivo studies published between January 2015 and 30 July 2026. Following PRISMA 2020 procedures, 25 studies were included in the qualitative synthesis, and risk of bias was assessed using the SYRCLE tool. Red macroalgae, particularly Asparagopsis spp., produced the greatest reductions in CH4 production, yield, and intensity, although responses varied with species, inclusion level, basal diet, animal species, and supplementation duration. Brown macroalgae produced less consistent CH4 responses, while evidence for green macroalgae was limited. Several studies reported reduced acetate and increased propionate, whereas effects on nutrient digestibility varied. Animal performance was generally maintained at lower inclusion levels, but higher inclusion levels of some red macroalgae reduced dry matter intake and, in some studies, milk production. Some seaweed treatments increased iodine and bromine concentrations in milk and other biological matrices, highlighting the importance of residue monitoring. The evidence was limited by methodological and biological heterogeneity, small sample sizes, short experimental periods, variation in macroalgal composition and CH4-measurement methods, geographical concentration, and limited long-term evidence. Marine macroalgae shows potential as functional feed additives for enteric CH4 mitigation, but the evidence does not support a universally optimal inclusion rate. Longer-term, adequately powered in vivo studies are needed to establish species-specific dose-response relationships, persistence of CH4 mitigation, food-safety requirements, and economic feasibility.
papers.summary_cn: 该系统性综述评估了海洋大型藻类作为反刍动物饲料添加剂对肠道甲烷排放、瘤胃发酵、养分利用及动物生产性能的影响，基于2015至2026年间25项体内研究。红藻（尤其 Asparagopsis spp.）对 CH4 产量和排放强度的减排效果最强，褐藻效果不稳定，绿藻证据有限；低添加水平下生产性能基本维持，但高剂量红藻可降低干物质采食量甚至产奶量，并提高乳中碘和溴残留。现有证据受方法学异质性、样本量小、试验期短及藻类成分变异等限制，尚无法确定普适最优添加比例，需开展长期、足量的体内试验以建立物种特异性剂量-效应关系及食品安全与经济可行性评估。

papers.title: Comparative Genomic Analysis Reveals Evolutionary Features of Glugea plecoglossi, a Fish-Infecting Microsporidian Parasite of Ayu (Plecoglossus altivelis)
papers.authors: Duan, Lijun; Zheng, Yiming; Zhou, Qianjin; Zhou, Yinghao; Yan, Maocang; Liu, Yuanyi; Tao, Ye; Chen, Jiong
papers.abstract: Microsporidia are obligate intracellular parasites with extensively reduced genomes, yet substantial genomic variation occurs among lineages. Glugea plecoglossi infects ayu (Plecoglossus altivelis) and forms conspicuous xenomas, but its genome characteristics and evolutionary position remain poorly resolved. We generated a genome assembly of G. plecoglossi and compared it with 42 additional microsporidian taxa using phylogenomics, functional profiling, repeat analysis, and multi-copy orthogroup analysis. The 16.71 Mb assembly comprised 59 scaffolds, with a scaffold N50 of 557.5 kb and 78.5% complete BUSCOs, and contained 4331 predicted protein-coding gene loci. Phylogenomic analysis recovered G. plecoglossi as the sister taxon to Pseudoloma neurophilia. Compared with closely related taxa, G. plecoglossi had a substantially larger genome and more predicted protein-coding genes. Major Gene Ontology profiles were broadly similar across taxa, whereas metabolism-related profiles varied considerably. Among 11 genomes, repetitive-sequence composition differed markedly, with G. plecoglossi showing particularly high long terminal repeat coverage and substantial DNA-transposon coverage. The retained multi-copy orthogroups showed highly heterogeneous member distributions across taxa, with relatively high member numbers in G. plecoglossi restricted to a limited subset. These findings highlight genomic and functional variation among microsporidian lineages and provide a comparative genomic resource for future studies of fish-infecting microsporidia.
papers.summary_cn: 研究对感染香鱼（Plecoglossus altivelis）的微孢子虫Glugea plecoglossi进行了基因组组装，并与42个其他微孢子虫类群开展比较基因组学分析。该菌基因组大小为16.71 Mb，含4331个蛋白编码基因，系统发育分析显示其与Pseudoloma neurophilia为姐妹群。相比近缘类群，G. plecoglossi基因组和基因数目显著更大，重复序列组成差异明显，尤以长末端重复和DNA转座子覆盖度较高。研究揭示了微孢子虫谱系间的基因组与功能变异，为鱼类感染微孢子虫的后续研究提供了比较基因组学资源。

papers.title: Integrative taxonomy of the temporary fish parasitic isopod Gnathia gunayalaensis n. sp. (Isopoda: Gnathiidae) from Panama, with supplementary data on Gnathia magdalenensis Müller, 1988
papers.authors: Erasmus, Anja; Hadfield, Kerry A.; Nicholson, Matthew D.; Hendrick, Gina C.; Sikkel, Paul C.; Smit, Nico J.
papers.abstract: Abstract Gnathiid isopods are common ectoparasites of fishes whose unusual life history has created challenges for characterising their biodiversity and biogeography. Based on morphological and molecular data, we describe a new species, Gnathia gunayalaensis n. sp., from Panama in the Southwestern Caribbean ecoregion of the Tropical Atlantic realm. The new species can be identified by a distinctly pointed superior, inferior and produced frontal margin, and by falciform mandibles with a finely serrated inner margin of the blade. In addition, supplementary morphological characters, as well as new scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and molecular data, are provided for Gnathia magdalenensis Müller, 1988, from the same locality. Newly collected specimens conform to the original description by Müller and subsequent information, notably in possessing a frontal margin with 3 processes (projections), with the medio-frontal process slightly shorter than the superior (submedial) pair, and an internal lobe on the mandible. The SEM observations revealed an additional character: a secondary process on top of the medio-frontal process at the base of the setae. Both species have distinct pigmentation patterns. Molecular analysis confirms that these species are distinct from any previously sequenced gnathiids and expands the available molecular dataset for this family. By establishing robust morphological and molecular reference data for the adult males of these species, this study provides a basis for linking and identifying their parasitic juvenile stages in future investigations of host associations, parasite ecology and biogeographical patterns.
papers.summary_cn: 基于形态与分子数据描述了巴拿马加勒比海地区鱼类寄生等足类新种 Gnathia gunayalaensis n. sp.，并补充了同域分布种 Gnathia magdalenensis 的形态、SEM 及分子数据。新种可通过明显突出的额缘及镰刀状大颚内缘细锯齿特征鉴别，两物种均具独特的色素沉着模式。分子分析确认二者区别于已知测序的 gnathiid 类群，为后续关联其寄生幼体阶段、研究宿主关系与寄生虫生态及生物地理格局提供了形态与分子参考基础。

papers.title: Mismatches between genetic and assessment units in commercial fish species: A systematic review in the North‐East Atlantic
papers.authors: Maggini, Sara; Papadopulos, Alexander S. T.; Jardim, Ernesto; Martinsohn, Jann T.; Nielsen, Einar E.; Carvalho, Gary R.
papers.abstract: Abstract While sustainable fisheries depend upon spatial and temporal identification at below the species level (i.e., stock units), the choice and identification of appropriate units remain challenging. Advances in DNA sequencing and improved computational power have generated extensive genetic and genomic data on the spatio‐temporal dynamics and resolution of marine fish populations. Here, we clarify terminology employed to designate fishery units and highlight the benefits of alignment between assessment units and biological processes. Our systematic review synthesises four decades of population genetic and genomic data in major North‐East Atlantic commercial fishes, appraising mismatches between genetic and assessment units. We confirm the progressive increase of genetic data, also indicating an increased detection of genetic population structure. Patterns of small‐scale temporal and spatial differentiation yield demonstrable tools for elucidating the integrity and dynamics of assessment units, including in mixed‐stock fisheries. Atlantic cod ( Gadus morhua ) and herring ( Clupea harengus ) remain extensively researched (46% of the reviewed studies). We found that genetics is informing realignment of stock boundaries, with increased incidence of alignment between genetic and assessment units, though mismatches persist for many stocks. Moreover, several species and fisheries lack genetic data. With reduced costs of molecular analysis and implementation of real‐time applications, we anticipate increased re‐evaluation of stock boundaries and monitoring of complex population structure, providing baseline genetic tools for management of mixed‐stock fisheries and inclusion of genomic data in stock assessment models. Generating reference genetic databases of populations will also facilitate studies on distributional range shifts in marine fishes, supported by increasingly precise predictive forecasting in a changing world.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究系统综述了东北大西洋主要商业鱼类四十年来的种群遗传与基因组数据，旨在评估 genetic units 与 assessment units 之间的匹配程度。研究发现遗传数据持续增长，遗传种群结构检测能力提升，Atlantic cod 和 herring 占研究量的46%；遗传学正推动 stock boundaries 的重新划定，遗传单元与评估单元趋于一致，但许多 stock 仍存在不匹配，部分物种和渔业缺乏遗传数据。随着分子分析成本降低和实时应用推广，预计 stock assessment 模型将更多纳入 genomic data，并促进 mixed-stock fisheries 的管理及种群分布范围变化的预测。

papers.title: A multidisciplinary, staged, and minimally invasive surgical approach for aortoesophageal fistula caused by ingested fish bone: a case report
papers.authors: Chen, Zhen; Zhang, Qiang; Liu, Qiuxia; Chen, Hao; Chen, Pengfei
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction and importance Aortoesophageal fistula (AEF) caused by an esophageal foreign body (EFB) is a life-threatening condition with extremely high mortality. There is no consensus on optimal management. This report illustrates a multidisciplinary, staged, and minimally invasive strategy that may improve outcomes in EFB-induced AEF. Case presentation A 70-year-old male presented with hematemesis 5 h after intermittent chest discomfort over two weeks following fish bone ingestion. Diagnosis was confirmed by chest CT, esophagogastroduodenoscopy, and aortography. Emergency thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR) was performed to control bleeding. This was followed by a combined thoracoscopic-laparoscopic procedure to resect the affected esophagus, debride the mediastinum, wrap the aortic fistula with omentum, and reconstruct the digestive tract. The patient recovered well and has remained alive and well with no recurrent symptoms during 10 months of follow-up. Clinical discussion This case demonstrates the efficacy of a staged approach integrating endovascular and minimally invasive surgical techniques. TEVAR provides immediate hemorrhage control as a bridge, while subsequent thoracoscopic-laparoscopic surgery addresses esophageal injury and prevents graft infection through omental wrapping. The strategy may reduce the high mortality associated with traditional open repair, particularly in elderly patients with comorbidities. Conclusion A multidisciplinary, staged, and minimally invasive approach combining TEVAR with thoracoscopic-laparoscopic esophageal resection and reconstruction may be a feasible treatment option for selected patients with EFB-induced AEF. Larger studies and longer follow-up are needed to validate its safety and durability.
papers.summary_cn: 该病例报告描述了一例因误吞鱼骨导致食管异物（EFB）并发主动脉食管瘘（AEF）的70岁男性患者，采用多学科、分期、微创策略进行治疗。急诊先行胸主动脉腔内修复术（TEVAR）控制出血，随后行胸腔镜-腹腔镜联合手术切除受累食管、纵隔清创、带蒂大网膜包裹主动脉瘘口并重建消化道。患者术后恢复良好，随访10个月无复发。该策略对合并基础疾病的老年EFB所致AEF患者可能降低传统开放手术的高死亡率，但需更大样本和更长随访验证。

papers.title: Modelling the financial viability of offshore aquaculture using a case study of a sea bass farm in the Bay of Lion, France
papers.authors: Van Dyken, Jeremy; Habibniya, Houshang; Dsouza, Suzan; Sclodnick, Tyler
papers.journal: Journal of Ocean and Coastal Economics
papers.abstract: The extension of net pen aquaculture to open ocean sites provides many advantages to the industry including opportunity for expansion, utilization of high energy sites, and better resilience to certain near shore or surface-associated stressors. The industry has been slow to develop due to high perceived risks and a lack of operating farms to provide financial information for open ocean farm operations. A model was developed to evaluate the economic viability of a hypothetical sea bass aquaculture venture in the open French Mediterranean Sea that utilizes open ocean submersible farming systems. Advanced open ocean equipment, including submersible net pens, environmental sensors, and camera systems with artificial intelligence can boost farm throughput, decrease personnel costs, reduce feed wastage, and reduce stress from hypoxia events or algal blooms. A spatial analysis considering bathymetry, wave height, current velocity, maritime traffic, and shoreline proximity was used to select an optimal location leading to more realistic financial inputs. The model projects the operation to generate 5,220 tonnes of sea bass per annum (live weight equivalent) and an internal rate of return of 19.43%. An investment of $39,924,456 is required and leads to an aggregate net present value (NPV) of $166,058,739. The model indicates that open ocean aquaculture can provide investment competitive financial returns and offers important insights into the economics of open ocean farming given the unavailability of commercial examples.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究构建经济模型评估法国地中海利翁湾离岸海鲈养殖场的财务可行性，通过整合水深、波高、流速、航运及岸线距离等空间分析选定最优场址，并纳入可潜式网箱、环境传感器及AI摄像系统等先进装备。模型预测年产量5,220吨（活重），内部收益率19.43%，需投资3,992万美元，净现值达1.66亿美元。结果表明离岸 aquaculture 可提供具投资竞争力的财务回报，为缺乏商业运营案例的 open ocean farming 经济性提供了重要参考。

papers.title: Comparative antibacterial activity of Cymbopogon citratus and Cymbopogon winterianus essential oils against Vibrio parahaemolyticus in shrimp aquaculture
papers.authors: dos Santos Filho, Luiz G. A.; dos Reis, Renata B.; Souza, Ana Sheila Q.; Canuto, Kirley M.; Ribeiro, Paulo Riceli V.; Castro, Karina N. C.; Diniz, Fábio Mendonça; Pereira, Alitiene M. L.
papers.journal: Journal of Biologically Active Products from Nature
papers.summary_cn: 比较柠檬草（Cymbopogon citratus）与爪哇香茅（Cymbopogon winterianus）精油对虾类养殖中副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus）的抗菌活性，旨在筛选替代抗生素的天然抗菌剂。
该文为对湖鲟（Acipenser fulvescens）基于成鱼 capture–mark–recapture 数据估算生长与寿命研究的更正说明，无摘要，内容不涉及新的研究数据或结论。

papers.title: Social Processes as Drivers for Empowerment of Sustainable Fisheries Management on Åland
papers.authors: Svels, Kristina; Rønningen, Katrina; Eriksson, Viktor; Sundström, Linda; Spiering, Salina; Bratt, Cecilie H.; Bjørkan, Maiken; Murtagh, Brendan; Flannery, Wesley
papers.abstract: This study analyses and evaluates an early-stage, pre-intervention phase<strong> </strong>in Åland’s small-scale fisheries community and examines the usefulness of a mixed-methods approach. It focuses on how combining three complementary methods supports the development of a grounded and legitimate pilot, rather than assessing pilot outcomes. The study applies a mixed-method approach combining a governance audit, community stakeholder workshops, and Q-methodology to map the social and institutional context prior to pilot implementation. The small-scale fisheries community in Åland represents an important cultural heritage and way of life, but faces increasing vulnerability due to regulatory pressures, ecological challenges, and socio-economic marginalisation. The findings suggest that combining multiple social science methods can contribute to a more nuanced understanding of stakeholder perspectives, power dynamics, and governance constraints, while supporting the identification of locally relevant intervention pathways and creating conditions for more legitimate and inclusive pilot development. However, the results also highlight limitations related to uneven participation and the difficulty of engaging diverse stakeholder groups in practice. The analysis indicates that social science approaches can provide an essential foundation for the later development of ecologically and socially grounded interventions, including nature-based solutions where locally appropriate. Nevertheless, social science contributions are currently less prominent than technical nature-based interventions, suggesting the value of more balanced integration between scientific disciplines in future initiatives. Overall, this article illustrates both the potential and the limits of mixed-method approaches in early-stage co-creation processes, offering insights for the design of participatory governance interventions in coastal communities.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以Åland小型渔业社区为对象，在干预前阶段采用治理审计、社区利益相关者工作坊与Q-methodology相结合的混合方法，旨在映射社会与制度背景并支持合法、包容的试点方案设计。该社区虽具重要文化遗产价值，却面临监管压力、生态挑战与社会经济边缘化。研究发现，多方法整合有助于深入理解利益相关者视角、权力动态与治理约束，并识别本地化干预路径，但参与不均衡与多元群体动员困难仍是实践局限。

papers.title: Searching for a Vanishing Fish: Development of an eDNA-Based Digital PCR Assay and Field Surveys for the Critically Endangered Chinese Bahaba
papers.authors: Pan, Chang; Zhang, Shuai; Huang, Honghui; Yan, Lin; Pei, Ying; Zhao, Wencheng; Li, Hao; Li, Junwei; Li, Min
papers.abstract: The critically endangered Chinese bahaba (Bahaba taipingensis) is difficult to monitor via conventional methods due to its low abundance and estuarine habitat. We developed a species-specific microfluidic digital PCR assay targeting the mitochondrial COI gene for environmental DNA (eDNA) detection. No cross-amplification was observed with seven sympatric non-target sciaenid species. The limit of quantification (LOQ) was 1.313 copies µL−1 and the limit of detection (LOD) was bounded between 0.162 and 1.313 copies µL−1 among the tested concentrations. All 12 aquaculture samples yielded quantifiable eDNA of 3.610 to 2109 copies µL−1, with CVs of 0.53–11.05% among technical triplicates. All putative field detections were below the LOQ and were classified as detected but not quantifiable. Among 21 paired stations, putative target-DNA detection frequencies were 19.05% (4/21) in April and 47.62% (10/21) in September, but the difference was not significant (exact McNemar test, p = 0.070). A stock-enhancement release between surveys confounded the comparison. Thus, the observed difference cannot be confidently attributed to natural seasonal variation. Given that only one water sample was collected per station and each field extract was analyzed in a single dPCR reaction, these field observations should be considered preliminary and require further sampling and analytical replication.
papers.summary_cn: 针对极危物种黄唇鱼（Bahaba taipingensis）因种群稀少且栖息于河口而难以用常规方法监测的问题，开发了靶向线粒体COI基因的物种特异性微流控digital PCR eDNA检测方法。该assay与7种同域石首鱼科非目标物种无交叉扩增，LOQ为1.313 copies µL−1，LOD介于0.162–1.313 copies µL−1。野外21对站位中目标DNA检出率4月为19.05%、9月为47.62%，但差异不显著（McNemar检验，p=0.070），且两次调查间存在增殖放流干扰，加之每站仅采一个水样、每份提取液仅做单次dPCR反应，故野外结果仅为初步性，需进一步采样与分析重复。

papers.title: Effect of Organophosphate Pesticide Dimethoate on Ascorbic Acid Levels in Various Tissues of Freshwater Fish  Channa punctatus
papers.authors: Bhandare, R. Y.; Kharat, A. J.; Paithane, K. T.; Pathan, T. S.
papers.abstract: Pesticide contamination may disturb biochemical homeostasis in freshwater fish; however, tissue-specific responses of antioxidant metabolites to prolonged dimethoate exposure remain poorly understood. In the present study, changes in ascorbic acid levels in the liver, gills, and muscle tissues of Channa punctatus exposed to three sublethal concentrations of dimethoate (53.4, 26.6, and 17.8 ppm) were examined. A colourimetric hydrazine-based technique was used to quantify ascorbic acid in dried tissues, and responses were compared with those of control tissues. Dimethoate caused significant, tissue-specific changes in ascorbic acid. Hepatic concentrations increased significantly from 5.6487 ± 0.4048 mg/100 mg dry weight in controls to 7.6054 ± 0.3092, 7.4705 ± 0.2024, and 7.4300 ± 0.2142 mg/100 mg at 53.4, 26.6, and 17.8 ppm, respectively. Muscle concentrations also increased, reaching 7.2681 ± 0.4048 mg/100 mg at the highest exposure. Gill concentrations, in contrast, decreased significantly and were lowest at 53.4 ppm. These divergent responses demonstrate marked tissue specificity in ascorbate homeostasis during chronic sublethal pesticide stress. The results support the use of tissue-resolved ascorbic acid responses as informative biochemical indicators of dimethoate-induced stress in freshwater fish and suggest their potential inclusion alongside other ecotoxicological assessments of freshwater contamination.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以淡水鱼 Channa punctatus 为对象，检测了亚致死浓度乐果（dimethoate，53.4、26.6、17.8 ppm）暴露后肝脏、鳃和肌肉组织中抗坏血酸水平的变化，采用基于肼的比色法进行定量。结果显示乐果引起显著的组织特异性响应：肝脏和肌肉抗坏血酸浓度升高，而鳃中显著降低，最高浓度组鳃中最低。结果表明组织特异性抗坏血酸响应可作为乐果诱导的淡水鱼胁迫的有效生化指标，适用于淡水污染的生态毒理学评估。

papers.title: Seaweed-Mediated Synthesis of Copper Oxide Nanoparticles and Evaluation of Their Antibacterial and Antibiofilm Activity Against Fish Pathogens
papers.authors: Satheesh, Sathianeson; Prabha, M.; Amran, Ramzi H.; Kumar, Anand Austin Jeya
papers.abstract: Bacterial diseases are one of the major causative factors for fish mortality and economic losses in aquaculture sector. Most of the pathogenic bacteria exists in biofilms, which offer protection from antibiotics and other infection control measures. In the present study, the antibacterial and antibiofilm activities of green synthesized copper oxide nanoparticles were tested against selected fish pathogens. Copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO-NPs) were synthesized using brown seaweed, Sargassum vulgare, extract. The biosynthesized NPs were characterized using UV-visible spectroscopy analysis, Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM) analysis, an energy dispersive X-ray analyzer (EDX) and X-ray diffraction (XRD). The SEM examination of morphology revealed predominantly spherical particles with some degrees of aggregation in CuO-NPs. The polycrystalline nature of CuO-NPs was confirmed in the XRD analysis. Furthermore, CuO-NPs exhibited antioxidant activity against 1,1-diphenyl-2-picrylhydrazyl (DPPH). The prepared NPs also demonstrated antibacterial and biofilm formation inhibition activities against fish pathogens with a maximum biofilm inhibition of 95% against Vibrio anguillarum. Overall, the findings suggest that the S. vulgare mediated CuO-NPs have potential for further investigation in fish disease control in aquaculture due to their antibacterial and biofilm inhibition effects against fish pathogens.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用褐藻 *Sargassum vulgare* 提取物绿色合成 copper oxide nanoparticles (CuO-NPs)，并通过 UV-vis、FTIR、SEM、EDX 和 XRD 对其进行了表征。CuO-NPs 呈球形、多晶结构，具有抗氧化活性，并对多种鱼类病原菌表现出 antibacterial 和 antibiofilm 活性，其中对 *Vibrio anguillarum* 的 biofilm 抑制率高达95%。结果表明，该藻源 CuO-NPs 在水产养殖鱼类病害防控中具有进一步研究潜力。

papers.title: A study on the evolutionary patterns of the acoustic environment of large-scale truss-type deep-sea aquaculture platforms
papers.authors: Wu, Dongwei; Qu, Ke; Yang, Bangchen; Deng, Xiaodong; Chen, Xiahua; Ling, Wenchang; Qi, Yali
papers.abstract: To investigate the impact of large-scale offshore aquaculture platform operations on the acoustic environment of local waters, this study analyzed the observed evolution of the acoustic environment around a large truss-type platform and its surrounding waters based on a continuous 46-hour synchronous multi-channel observation dataset acquired under typical calm sea conditions. The results indicate that the interference caused by platform operations on the underwater acoustic environment is primarily concentrated in the low-frequency band below 500 Hz, and the underwater near-field exhibits a distinct discrete harmonic skeleton, The power spectral density at the characteristic fundamental frequency of 24.41 Hz reached 122.29 dB re 1 μ Pa 2 / Hz (approximately 16 dB higher than under idle conditions). However, in the frequency range above 2 kHz, the signal completely overlaps with the environmental background; the pixel-level temporal synchronization between the deck air and underwater sound fields at the moment of start-up and shutdown, combined with the strong acoustic impedance mismatch at the air-water interface, quantitatively confirms that the dominant path for structural elastic waves excited by the propulsion system is through solid transmission via the rigid truss pile foundation to underwater radiation; Within the observation window, the distant-station acoustic level exhibited an apparent day–night difference, which is consistent with the diurnal variation of the shallow-water sound-speed profile; a 4-m sound-channel axis was observed during the day, whereas a positive gradient with upward refraction prevailed at night, plausibly enhancing sea-surface scattering and contributing to the observed nocturnal decay of the distant-station characteristic sound; Furthermore, Within the 46-hour observation period, the low-frequency soundscape at the distant station appears to be modulated by semi-diurnal tidal dynamics within the observation window; noise peaks lag behind tidal peak levels by approximately 6 hours, and during neap tides (current velocity &lt; 0.3 m/s), the acoustic background drops below –40 dB re 1 μ Pa 2 / Hz , exhibiting macroscopic non-stationary characteristics driven alternately by tidal variations and ocean currents. These findings are derived from a single 46-h campaign under calm conditions and should be regarded as process-level evidence rather than climatological statistics, providing reference data support and scientific methodological references for acoustic environment monitoring, ecological assessment, and the optimized deployment of aquaculture acoustic equipment on similar deep-sea aquaculture platforms.
papers.summary_cn: 基于46小时同步多通道观测，研究了大型桁架式深海养殖平台运行对周边水域声环境的影响。结果表明，平台运行噪声主要集中在500 Hz以下低频段，24.41 Hz特征基频处功率谱密度达122.29 dB，较怠速状态高约16 dB，而2 kHz以上完全淹没于环境背景；启动/停止时甲板空气声与水下声场的时间同步及气-水界面强声阻抗失配证实，推进系统激励的结构弹性波主要通过刚性桁架桩基以固体传导方式向水下辐射。远站声级呈现与浅水声速剖面日变化一致的昼夜差异，并受半日潮调制，噪声峰值滞后潮位峰值约6小时，小潮期间声学背景降至–40 dB以下，表现出潮汐与海流交替驱动的宏观非平稳特征。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Decision-AI for Species-Specific and Non-Lethal Management of Avian Predators in Aquaculture
papers.authors: Serfa Juan, Ronnie; Lansdell, Julia Grace; Gerken, Joseph E.; Gerken, Alison R.
papers.abstract: Avian predation remains a persistent challenge in aquaculture, as conventional deterrents often lose effectiveness due to bird habituation and limited species specificity. Some methods may also unintentionally affect surrounding ecosystems. To address these limitations, this study presents a spatiotemporal Decision-AI approach for species-specific and non-lethal management of avian predators and nuisance birds by integrating visual intelligence with ecological context. The proposed framework integrates a YOLOv8-based detection model with a metadata extraction and spatiotemporal analysis pipeline that records species identity, population count, time, and location. YOLOv8 serves as the visual detection component, while the methodological contribution of the framework lies in transforming these detections into contextual ecological indicators through temporal occurrence analysis, species-specific weighting, and risk-based Decision-AI. This allows the system to transform raw image detections into meaningful ecological indicators that can guide management decisions. The study was evaluated using a dataset of more than 4500 high-resolution images collected from aquaculture sites across multiple U.S. locations. The proposed model achieved an overall classification accuracy of 97.2%, with precision and recall values of 95.8% and 96.4%, respectively. More importantly, the integration of detection results with temporal and spatial metadata enabled the identification of activity patterns, including peak visitation periods, species dominance trends, and location-specific risk levels. These insights can support targeted and non-lethal intervention strategies, such as optimizing deterrent timing and applying species-aware responses, while minimizing disturbance to non-target wildlife. By linking computer vision with ecological decision support, the proposed study moves beyond passive monitoring toward data-informed, adaptive management. This approach provides a scalable and interpretable pathway for improving aquaculture sustainability while maintaining ecological balance.
papers.summary_cn: 针对水产养殖中鸟类捕食防治手段易致鸟类习惯化、物种特异性不足且可能误伤非目标野生动物的问题，本研究提出一种时空 Decision-AI 框架，将基于 YOLOv8 的视觉检测与元数据提取及 spatiotemporal analysis 流程相结合，实现物种特异性、非致死性的鸟类管理。利用美国多个养殖场采集的 4500 余张高分辨率图像评估，模型总体分类准确率达 97.2%，precision 与 recall 分别为 95.8% 和 96.4%。检测结果与时空元数据融合后可识别鸟类活动高峰、物种优势趋势及地点特异性风险水平，为优化驱避时机和物种针对性响应等非致死干预策略提供数据支持。

papers.title: Division of labor and sex (in)equality among the marine hunter-fisher-gatherers of north-central Chile (5500–2000 cal BP)
papers.authors: Alfonso-Durruty, Marta; Misarti, Nicole; Becker, Cristian; Henríquez Urzúa, Mario; Troncoso, Andrés
papers.journal: Journal of Island and Coastal Archaeology
papers.summary_cn: 基于智利中北部海洋狩猎-采集-捕鱼群体的考古遗存，探讨距今5500–2000年间劳动分工与性别不平等问题。

papers.title: A Study on the Probiotic Role of Bacteria Isolated from Wild Marine Shrimp, Penaeus Monodon (Fabricius) to Control Pathogenic Bacteria
papers.authors: M, Alrich Michael.; K, Raghul.; D, Angelin Jebisha.; O, Chellappa.; R, Rishikeshwar.; M, Serine Michael.
papers.abstract: Aquaculture is crucial to global food security and economic stability, garnering substantial research investment. Shrimp farming significantly contributes to the global economy; however, persistent disease outbreaks pose a considerable threat. Probiotics emerge as a viable and promising solution for managing pathogenic diseases in shrimp, fostering a more sustainable aquaculture industry. The aim of the work was to isolate and identify the probiotic bacteria from the naturally collected wild healthy shrimp and to control the shrimp pathogens isolated from the diseased shrimp. The healthy live tiger shrimp, Penaeus monodon of body weight 150.54 ± 10.60 were collected from the fisherman and brought to the laboratory. In the laboratory, the bacteria present in gut, gill and slime were isolated by serial dilution method and identified up to genus level by Bio-chemical tests. The isolated bacteria were tested against the pathogens. Eight bacterial isolates were taken from the wild healthy shrimp. They are Bacillus sp., Acetobacterium sp., Pseudomonas sp., Enterobacter sp., Alteromonas sp, Klesella sp., Proteus sp., and Halobacter sp. Among the eight isolated bacteria, the Bacilus sp, Acetobacterium sp. and Pseudomonas sp., were selected as probiotic bacteria based on their beneficial effect on shrimp and their antagonistic effect on shrimp pathogens. The probiotic bacteria isolated from the gut of shrimp controlled the colonization of pathogens on gut, gill and slime of shrimp. This study highlights potentials of shrimp gut isolated bacteria in controlling the pathogens causing disease in shrimp and providing a significant step forward in antibiotic-free disease management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究从野生健康斑节对虾（Penaeus monodon）的肠道、鳃和体表黏液中分离鉴定细菌，并测试其对患病虾源病原菌的拮抗效果。共获得8株细菌，其中Bacillus sp.、Acetobacterium sp.和Pseudomonas sp.对虾病原菌具有抑制作用，被筛选为候选probiotics。这些益生菌能有效抑制病原菌在虾肠道、鳃和黏液中的定植，为对虾无抗生素疾病管理提供了潜在途径。

papers.title: DriftGuard: an agentic hybrid temporal transformer and graph attention network framework for autonomous calibration drift detection and correction in distributed marine sensor networks
papers.authors: Arshad, Maryam; Matloob, Irum; Safdar, Saria; Rukaiya; Khan Khattak, Muazzam A.; Yu, Changli
papers.abstract: Introduction Undetected calibration drift in autonomous ocean sensors corrupts temperature and salinity records underpinning climate reanalysis, seasonal forecasting, and marine ecosystem assessments. With 15–20% of active Argo floats showing meaningful drift at any time and correction workflows taking three to six months, scalable autonomous quality control is urgently needed. Methods We present DriftGuard, a five-component autonomous framework integrating a physically-informed heterogeneous sensor graph over 135 nodes, a Hybrid Temporal Transformer and Graph Attention Network (HybridTGAT), a cross-sensor consistency loss, a conformal prediction wrapper, and a LangGraph-orchestrated three-stage agentic loop supported by a 2,183-chunk RAG store. Results Evaluated on Argo float profiles (116 floats, North Atlantic, 2021–2024), NDBC buoy time series (15 stations, 2019–2024), and the expert-labelled AdapAD benchmark, DriftGuard achieves a GAT-level ROC-AUC of 0.8376, an AdapAD zero-shot AUC of 0.8423, and detects gradual drift types an average of 84.7 readings earlier than the operational Argo QC Test 16 baseline. Operational fleet evaluation across 131 sensors identifies 13 floats in a CRITICAL state requiring correction within 24 hours. Discussion DriftGuard is the first system in the marine sensor domain to unify graph-based spatial reasoning, temporal modelling, autonomous LLM-driven correction, conformal uncertainty certificates, and closed-loop retraining within a single operational pipeline, demonstrating readiness for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_cn: 针对自主海洋传感器校准漂移难以被及时发现、现有校正流程耗时3–6个月的问题，本研究提出DriftGuard框架，融合异构传感器图、Hybrid Temporal Transformer与Graph Attention Network、跨传感器一致性损失、conformal prediction及LLM驱动的agentic闭环校正流程。基于Argo浮标、NDBC浮标及AdapAD基准的评估显示，其ROC-AUC达0.8376、零样本AUC为0.8423，较业务化Argo QC Test 16平均提前84.7个读数检出渐变漂移，并在131个传感器中识别出13个需24小时内校正的CRITICAL浮标。该框架首次在海洋传感器领域统一了图空间推理、时序建模、自主校正与不确定性认证，具备实际部署能力。

papers.title: Predation on fish early life stages by Mnemiopsis leidyi (Ctenophora) starts before the lobate stage
papers.authors: Sobrero, Lucila; Macchi, Gustavo J.; Chiaverano, Luciano Martin; Schiariti, Agustin
papers.summary_cn: 该研究关注 ctenophore Mnemiopsis leidyi 对鱼类早期生活阶段的捕食行为，指出其捕食能力在 lobate 阶段之前即已开始。由于缺乏摘要，具体方法与结果不详，但该发现提示早期发育阶段的 Mnemiopsis leidyi 可能对鱼卵和仔鱼构成此前被低估的捕食压力。

papers.title: Reflections on the prospects for western Atlantic coral reefs
papers.authors: Jackson, Jeremy B. C.
papers.abstract: Ever more frequent and severe heat waves and resulting coral bleaching threaten to drive reef corals to extinction unless they can rapidly increase resilience against rising temperatures. This is especially true in the Western Atlantic where the unique geographic features of the region and long history of intense exploitation and pollution have made corals especially vulnerable. Fortunately, there is considerable evidence that thermal resilience is increasing through shuffling of relationships among corals and their symbionts, and by natural selection. Moreover, experiments have shown that assisted reproduction can increase the pace of increasing resilience. However, these promising signs will come to naught unless overexploitation, pollution, and development are rapidly and severely reduced.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探讨西大西洋珊瑚礁在日益频繁的热浪与珊瑚白化威胁下的生存前景。该区域独特的地理特征及长期过度开发与污染使珊瑚尤为脆弱，但珊瑚与共生体关系的重组及自然选择正提升其热耐受性，辅助繁殖实验亦可加速这一进程。然而，若不能迅速大幅减少过度捕捞、污染与开发，这些积极迹象将难以奏效。

papers.title: Calibrating Remote Camera Network Retrievals with Boat-Based Recreational Fishing Effort from Traditional Surveys Using a Bayesian Hierarchical Approach
papers.authors: Bradshaw, Stephen Craig; Smallwood, Claire B; Lai, Eva K; Tate, Alissa C; Ryan, Karina Lee
papers.abstract: Effective monitoring of recreational fisheries is increasingly challenged by respondent fatigue and increasing operational resource constraints. While traditional surveys are fundamental to understanding catch and effort, they are commonly spatially and temporally limited. This study evaluates three complementary survey designs, periodic Phone Diary Surveys (PDS) and Boat Ramp Surveys (BRS), and continuous monitoring from a Remote Camera Network (RCN), to generate continuous, spatially resolved estimates of boat-based recreational fishing effort. Long-term datasets from Western Australia were used to compare vessel retrievals and quantify the variable proportion of fishing and general boating traffic. A hierarchical Bayesian model calibrated continuous RCN counts using PDS estimates to impute an uninterrupted time series of vessel retrievals, even where PDS data were unavailable. We highlight variability in spatial coverage of the RCN, and the implications for model uncertainty. The study presents a framework for leveraging existing datasets to maximise information value, without expanding costly monitoring programs, and improve estimation of fishing effort to support more robust stock assessments and responsive fisheries management.
papers.summary_cn: 针对传统休闲渔业调查受受访者疲劳和资源限制、时空覆盖有限的问题，本研究整合西澳的 Phone Diary Surveys (PDS)、Boat Ramp Surveys (BRS) 与 Remote Camera Network (RCN) 三类互补调查设计，构建 hierarchical Bayesian 模型，以 PDS 估计校准 RCN 连续计数，从而插补无 PDS 数据时段的不间断船只回收时间序列。研究量化了 RCN 空间覆盖的变异性及其对模型不确定性的影响，为在不扩大昂贵监测项目的前提下充分利用现有数据、提升 fishing effort 估计精度并支撑更稳健的 stock assessment 与渔业管理提供了框架。

papers.title: Unlocking the potential of aquatic animal telemetry research to advance management and conservation: Barriers and a blueprint for Great Britain and Ireland
papers.authors: Bolland, Jonathan D; Berseth, Valerie; Gregory, Stephen D; Adams, Colin E; Barry, James; Bašić, Tea; Bean, Colin; Beaumont, Will A; Bicknell, Anthony W; Britton, John Robert
papers.abstract: Aquatic animal telemetry research can provide important knowledge for how populations, anthropogenic pressures and, indeed, entire ecosystems are managed. However, the true scale, extent and impact in Britain and Ireland is poorly understood. We surveyed 53 researchers about past and ongoing projects to characterize the British and Irish telemetry landscape and identify barriers to impact. A wide diversity of species (n = 63) have been studied, with Atlantic salmon being the most, while fish passage and hydropower were the most researched anthropogenic pressures. Seventy-three percent of respondents reported personal experiences influencing management and policy decisions. However, we found barriers to telemetry-derived knowledge uptake (e.g. technological limitations) while early engagement and effective communication with policy actors facilitated uptake. Given these findings we make three recommendations: consolidate the research community into coordinated hub, improve data sharing processes, and establish a permanent and interoperable acoustic telemetry receiver array. If delivered, they would represent a step-change in how telemetry-derived knowledge is both gathered and used to provide evidence-based management and conservation of British and Irish aquatic biodiversity and ecosystems.
papers.summary_cn: 通过对53名研究者的调查，梳理了英国和爱尔兰水生动物 telemetry 研究的物种覆盖（63种，以大西洋鲑为主）及主要人为压力研究焦点（鱼类通道与水电），发现73%的受访者有影响管理决策的经验，但技术限制等障碍仍制约知识转化。研究提出三项建议：建立协调化研究枢纽、完善数据共享流程、建设永久性互操作声学 telemetry 接收阵列，以推动 telemetry 知识在基于证据的管理与保护中的应用。

papers.title: Unraveling dark diversity patterns of freshwater fish to inform conservation planning
papers.authors: Chen, Qiyue; Tao, Juan; Wang, Jie; Tao, Jianshuang; Guo, Fen; Tun, Nyo Nyo; Vannaphon, Anousith; Du, Tingqi; Ding, Chengzhi
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨淡水鱼类暗多样性（dark diversity）的空间格局，以期为保护规划提供依据。由于缺乏摘要，具体方法与结果无法概述，但核心目标是将暗多样性概念应用于淡水鱼类保护优先区识别。

papers.title: The spawning hum in the reproductive sequence of the boxfish Ostracion meleagris
papers.authors: Parmentier, Eric; Husson, Capucine; Koide, Yuki
papers.abstract: Abstract Boxfishes possess one of the most diverse acoustic repertoires described among teleosts, including sounds emitted during spawning, agonistic interactions and handling. However, the reproductive component of this repertoire remains poorly documented. By analysing synchronized video and acoustic recordings from 13 spawning events involving three Ostracion meleagris Shaw 1796, we quantitatively characterize the spawning hum, place it within the reproductive behavioural sequence and show that it differs fundamentally from the disturbance‐induced hum previously described in hand‐held individuals.
papers.summary_cn: 通过对3尾 Ostracion meleagris 的13次产卵事件进行同步视频与声学记录，定量刻画了箱鲀产卵过程中发出的 spawning hum，并将其置于繁殖行为序列中。研究发现，该产卵鸣声与此前在手持个体中描述的 disturbance-induced hum 存在本质差异，表明箱鲀繁殖声学信号具有独特特征。

papers.title: A deeper look into the diversity of suckermouth catfishes (Mochockidae: Chiloglanis Peters 1868) of southern Africa, with the description of four new species
papers.authors: Mutizwa, Tadiwa Isaac; Ntokoane, Tholoana; Chakona, Albert
papers.abstract: Abstract Suckermouth catfishes of the genus Chiloglanis Peters 1868 are small and predominantly rheophilic fishes endemic to Africa. This genus is quite diverse, with over 70 species distributed across most river systems on the continent, except for the Cape Fold ecoregion and most of northern Africa. The present study undertook detailed genetic and morphological examination of suckermouth catfishes collected from multiple localities across the Zambezi River system. Results from this study support preliminary field observations that had identified considerable morphological and colour pattern variation among specimens collected from this system, which were all previously lumped together into the ‘basket’ name, Chiloglanis neumanni . Herein, we describe four new species: Chiloglanis imberbis sp. nov., Chiloglanis shirensis sp. nov., Chiloglanis lapidis sp. nov. and Chiloglanis brevispina sp. nov. based on a combination of molecular differentiation and distinctive morphological traits. We discuss additional diversity within this group that will be addressed in a future follow‐up study of this group. Accurate species identification within widely distributed model taxa is fundamental to reconstructing historical biogeographic processes. In the case of suckermouth catfishes, a genus with a pan‐African distribution, resolving taxonomic diversity and clarifying distributional boundaries will provide future biogeographic studies with the important ingredients to unravel historic patterns of drainage evolution and connectivity patterns across the continent. Additionally, the urgent need for conservation of habitats such as montane streams that not only play a pivotal role in providing water resources but also harbour high levels of endemic biodiversity is highlighted.
papers.summary_cn: 对非洲南部赞比西河水系的吸盘鲶属（Chiloglanis）鱼类进行了遗传与形态学系统研究，发现此前被归入 Chiloglanis neumanni 的标本存在显著形态与色斑变异，据此描述四个新种：C. imberbis、C. shirensis、C. lapidis 和 C. brevispina。研究强调，广泛分布类群的准确物种鉴定是重建历史生物地理过程的基础，并指出山地溪流等栖息地兼具水资源供给与高度特有生物多样性，亟需保护。

papers.title: Global conservation additionality hindered by persisting fishing pressure in marine protected areas
papers.authors: Ohanna, Millenne; Jacquemont, Juliette; Claudet, Joachim
papers.abstract: Marine protected areas (MPAs) are the cornerstone of global marine conservation strategies. Yet, their capacity to achieve conservation gains (i.e., conservation additionality) hinges on the decrease in human threats to biodiversity within their boundary, a feature rarely measured or reported. Here, we test a central but underexamined question in global conservation policy: Have MPA implementations actually reduced within-boundary fishing pressure, currently the main direct human threat to marine biodiversity? Using a stratified before-after-control-impact approach, we investigated 861 MPAs of varying levels of protection across all ocean basins, representing half of global MPA coverage, and found that most implementations were not followed by decreases in industrial fishing effort. Protection levels strongly predicted the direction and magnitude of relative changes in fishing effort after implementation. Only fully protected areas were associated with significant decreases in fishing effort within boundaries. Highly protected areas were only associated with lower rates of increase in fishing effort within compared to outside boundaries. Both fully and highly protected areas were implemented in areas experiencing initial low fishing effort, reducing the overall abatement in fishing effort achieved. Conversely, areas with higher initial fishing effort tended to be attributed to MPAs with low levels of protection, also limiting abatement. Larger MPAs were associated with greater decreases in fishing effort, while time since implementation had no significant effect. Complementing targets of protection coverage and protection levels with conservation additionality targets, such as pressure abatement, could shift incentives from quantity to effectiveness of interventions and ensure positive biodiversity conservation outcomes.
papers.summary_cn: 研究采用分层前后对照-影响评估方法，覆盖全球所有海盆861个不同保护级别的MPA（占全球MPA覆盖面积一半），检验MPA设立是否实际降低了边界内工业捕捞努力量。结果显示多数MPA实施后捕捞压力并未下降，保护级别强烈预测捕捞努力量相对变化的方向与幅度：仅完全保护区间内捕捞努力量显著下降，高保护级别仅表现为边界内捕捞努力量增速低于边界外。完全与高保护区多设于初始捕捞压力较低海域，而初始捕捞压力较高海域多对应低保护级别MPA，二者均限制了捕捞压力的总体削减幅度；较大面积MPA与捕捞努力量下降幅度更大相关，实施年限无显著影响。

papers.authors: Haddock, Janey B.; Rodríguez‐Jiménez, Edna Karina; Beristain‐Cardoso, Ricardo; González‐Blanco, Gehovana; Manjarrez‐Silva, Javier; Ruiz‐Gómez, María de Lourdes
papers.abstract: Abstract Nitrate pollution is one of the most widespread forms of contamination, and in high concentrations has adverse effects on aquatic ecosystems. Fish are susceptible to this contaminant and are known to modify their behaviour in a variety of ways when exposed, but most information regarding changes in behaviour pertains only to long‐term or chronic exposure. Therefore, this study aimed to use zebrafish ( Danio rerio ) as a model fish species to create a specialized ethogram relevant to acute nitrate contamination and identify any immediate changes in behaviour (within the initial 10 min of exposure). Three water treatments were created in a laboratory setting: water with optimum conditions to support D. rerio , and water with two levels of nitrate concentration: 11 mg/L NO 3 − ‐N and 100 mg/L NO 3 − ‐N. Fish were filmed in each treatment group, and visual review of the footage identified nine unique behaviours. These behaviours were measured in frequency, duration and latency per fish, and the values were compared between treatments. From those, repetitive long movement, repetitive short movement and freezing increased in occurrences in conjunction with sweeping decreasing in occurrence when fish were exposed to higher concentrations of nitrates. The findings suggest that four behaviours (repetitive long movement, repetitive short movement, freezing and sweeping), which immediately change in the presence of high concentrations, may be relevant in indicating exposure to acute nitrate contamination.
papers.summary_cn: 以斑马鱼（Danio rerio）为模型，构建适用于急性硝酸盐污染的专属行为谱，并检测暴露最初10 min内的即时行为变化。实验设置对照、11 mg/L NO₃⁻-N和100 mg/L NO₃⁻-N三组，通过录像分析9种行为的频率、时长和潜伏期。结果显示，高浓度硝酸盐暴露下重复性长距离运动、重复性短距离运动和 freezing 频率增加，sweeping 减少，提示这4种行为可作为急性硝酸盐污染的指示指标。

papers.title: Contrasting Effects of Chitosan Molecular Modifications on the Properties of Fish Gelatin Hydrogels
papers.authors: Nikiforova, Alena A.; Abramov, Vladislav; Skvortsova, Polina V.; Akhmadiyarov, Aydar A.; Rakipov, Ilnaz T.; Sorokin, Andrey V.; Lavlinskaya, Maria S.; Zueva, Olga S.; Holyavka, Marina G.; Derkach, Svetlana R.
papers.abstract: The limited water solubility of chitosan, which necessitates acidic conditions for its dissolution, restricts its application in food and pharmaceutical systems. To overcome this limitation, we chemically modified a chitosan molecule by introducing hydrophilic groups and compared three chitosan forms—unmodified chitosan, its quaternary ammonium derivative, and a graft copolymer with poly-N-vinylpyrrolidone, with respect to their effect on the structural and mechanical properties of fish gelatin hydrogels. An experimental study combining NMR relaxometry and water self-diffusion measurements, scanning electron microscopy, and rheology revealed a distinct supramolecular architecture of gelatin–chitosan hydrogel network for different chitosan modifications. The NMR data gave information on the molecular mobility of water as a marker of hydrogel structure to elucidate molecular basis for the observed rheological properties. Unmodified chitosan maximally reinforces gelatin network and enhances its thermorheological stability. Chitosan grafting with poly-N-vinylpyrrolidone produces a fine-pored xerogel structure with higher thermorheological stability, possibly through a non-cooperative reinforcement mechanism. The quaternary ammonium derivative results in a heterogeneous xerogel morphology with weak mechanical strength and low gel–sol transition temperature. These findings establish the structure–property correlation, demonstrating that chitosan modification governs the molecular network architecture and macroscopic performance of gelatin-based hydrogels, providing molecular-level insights into the behavior of fish gelatin–chitosan systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过引入亲水基团对壳聚糖进行化学改性，比较了未改性壳聚糖、季铵盐衍生物及聚-N-乙烯基吡咯烷酮接枝共聚物对鱼明胶水凝胶结构与力学性能的影响。结合NMR弛豫测量、水自扩散测定、扫描电镜和流变学分析，揭示了不同壳聚糖改性下明胶-壳聚糖水凝胶网络的不同超分子结构。未改性壳聚糖最大程度增强明胶网络并提升其热流变稳定性；接枝共聚物形成细孔干凝胶结构且热流变稳定性较高；季铵盐衍生物则导致非均质干凝胶形态、力学强度弱且凝胶-溶胶转变温度低。

papers.title: Combined deodorization of dry protein products from secondary fish raw materials
papers.authors: Arabova, Z. M.; Nugmanov, A. Kh-Kh.; Aleksanyan, I. Yu.; Odintsova, A. I.; Osmolovsky, P. D.; Fomenko, E. V.
papers.abstract: Introduction. The fish processing industry annually produces a significant amount of secondary raw materials – caviar and roe complex, liver, and other organs of ordinary fish species. This raw material is a promising source for obtaining valuable food ingredients, including fractionated lecithin and isolated protein products. However, their widespread use is limited by the presence of a persistent fishy odor, which significantly reduces the organoleptic properties and consumer appeal of the final product. The goal of the research was to investigate the mechanisms of formation of volatile compounds responsible for the undesirable odor in dried catfish liver and raffinate after the extraction of lecithin-containing substances from fish roe, as well as to develop an effective and cost-effective deodorization method. The objects and methods of the research were dried catfish liver and raffinate after lecithin extraction. The paper provides a comparative analysis of physicochemical deodorization methods, including treatment with organic acids and natural antioxidants. Volatile compound concentrations were determined using gas chromatographymass spectrometry. The results and discussion. The research confirmed that the main sources of undesirable odors were three groups of volatile compounds: nitrogenous (trimethylamine, ammonia), carbonyl (hexanal, nonanal), and sulfur-containing (dimethyl sulfide, methyl mercaptan). A comparative analysis substantiated the effectiveness of combined treatment with organic acids and natural antioxidants. Experiments confirmed that a combination of 1% citric acid and 0.3% rosemary extract reduced trimethylamine content by 70%, hexanal by 45%, and improved organoleptic properties by 3 points. Conclusion. The proposed method is technologically feasible, does not require significant capital investment, and can be recommended for the implementation in the food industry. It opens up prospects for expanding the use of secondary protein products in the production of food ingredients with improved organoleptic properties.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在探究鲶鱼肝脏干制品及鱼卵卵磷脂提取后残液中不良腥味挥发性化合物的形成机制，并开发高效经济的脱臭方法。通过GC-MS分析确认主要异味来源为含氮类（三甲胺、氨）、羰基类（己醛、壬醛）和含硫类（二甲基硫醚、甲硫醇）化合物。结果表明，1%柠檬酸与0.3%迷迭香提取物联合处理可使三甲胺降低70%、己醛降低45%，感官评分提升3分，该方法工艺可行且无需大量资本投入。

papers.title: Development of Rice-Fish Farming in Enhancing Economic and Seasonal Benefits: A Case Study from Bangladesh
papers.authors: Tabassum, Tahmina; Bashar, Abul; Haque, Mohammad Mahfujul; Alam, Md. Mehedi; Rahman, Md Yeaminur; Hasan, Neaz A.
papers.abstract: Integrated rice-fish farming can enhance the efficiency of land use, diversify production with varied foods, and support smallholder income security. However, pathways to adoption, economic viability, and seasonal advantages related to integrated rice-fish farming need more documentation in northwest Bangladesh. To fill this knowledge gap, this exploratory study investigated the process of adoption, farm attributes, comparative productivity, and seasonal livelihood benefits of integrated rice-fish farming among selected farmers in the Dinajpur Sadar subdistrict. This study analyzed the data collected from 30 rice-fish farms that also had rice-only fields, making comparison possible between rice-fish and rice-only agriculture. Several participatory rural appraisal techniques, such as historical timeline analysis, transects, focus group discussion, and questionnaire survey, were used to collect the data. The majority of rice-fish farmers were young and educated farmers practicing in medium lowland irrigated rice farming systems. Commonly cultured fish species were carps and Tilapia, stocked at a density of 24,700 ± 3250 individual ha−1. While rice production did not vary significantly between rice-fish and rice-only field practices, additional fish production raised gross income, net income, and benefit-cost ratio. Gross income in rice-fish farming was Bangladesh Taka BDT 506,632 (≈USD 6247.00) and BDT 212,600 (≈USD 2621.45) in rice-only practice, whereas net income was BDT 373,243 (≈USD 4602.25) and BDT 126,667 (≈USD 1561.86), respectively.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在填补孟加拉国西北部稻渔综合种养在采用路径、经济可行性与季节性收益方面的资料空白，通过参与式农村评估方法对Dinajpur Sadar分区的30个稻渔田块及其对照稻田进行比较分析。结果表明，稻渔模式主养鲤鱼和罗非鱼（放养密度约24,700尾/ha），水稻产量与单作无显著差异，但额外鱼产量显著提高了总收入和净收入，稻渔模式净收入（BDT 373,243）约为单作水稻（BDT 126,667）的三倍，效益成本比亦更优。

papers.title: Accidental Petroleum Hydrocarbon Exposure in Farmed Rainbow Trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss): Effects on Tissues, Water Quality, and Fish Muscle
papers.authors: Cala-Delgado, Daniel Leonardo; Duarte-Rodriguez, Luz Zoraya; Rivera Robayo, Fredy; Crosby Granados, Rene Alejandro; Navas-Rodriguez, Juan Carlos
papers.abstract: Accidental petroleum contamination can affect fish health and food safety in aquaculture, yet evidence from commercial production systems remains limited. This study evaluated the effects of an accidental diesel spill on a rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) farm operating under a continuous flow-through system in Santander, Colombia. Water and fish muscle were analyzed for petroleum hydrocarbons, and exposed fish were examined by histopathology and immunohistochemistry. Following the rollover of a diesel tanker truck, the producer reported a diesel-like odor, an oily surface film, and reduced feed intake, although no spill-related mortality was observed and water quality remained within acceptable ranges for trout culture. Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons were detected in production water, with 2-methylnaphthalene quantified at 21.2 μg/L. Fluorene, 2-methylnaphthalene, phenanthrene, and acenaphthene were quantified in muscle. Histopathology revealed lesions in the kidney, liver, gills, skeletal muscle, and intestine, including interstitial nephritis, hepatocellular lipidosis, branchial degeneration, myonecrosis, and villous atrophy. Melan-A immunoreactivity and negative Perls’ Prussian blue staining supported melanin-associated renal pigmentation. These findings indicate that accidental diesel exposure in a commercial flow-through rainbow trout farm can cause detectable PAH contamination and multisystemic tissue injury without acute mortality. Integrated chemical and histopathological monitoring is therefore advisable for aquaculture toxicology and food safety surveillance.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了哥伦比亚一商业流水式虹鳟（Oncorhynchus mykiss）养殖场在柴油泄漏事故后的污染影响，检测了水体与鱼肌肉中的石油烃含量，并对暴露鱼体进行组织病理学和免疫组化分析。水体中检出多环芳烃（PAHs），其中2-甲基萘浓度为21.2 μg/L，鱼肌肉中检出芴、2-甲基萘、菲和苊。组织病理学显示肾脏、肝脏、鳃、骨骼肌和肠道均出现病变，但未发生急性死亡，水质指标仍处于虹鳟养殖可接受范围。结果表明，意外柴油暴露可在无急性致死的情况下导致可检测的PAH污染和多系统组织损伤，建议将化学分析与组织病理学监测整合应用于水产养殖毒理学与食品安全监管。

papers.title: Antimicrobial Use in European Aquaculture and the Aquatic Environment: From Regulatory Transformation to Sustainable Disease Management
papers.authors: Wojnarowski, Konrad; Zhao, Dongqing; Cholewinska, Paulina; Hou, Kangwei; Moniuszko, Hanna
papers.abstract: European aquaculture is increasingly shaped by regulatory efforts to reduce unnecessary antimicrobial use and limit antimicrobial resistance risks across the human–animal–environment interface. These efforts are necessary, especially where antimicrobials are used routinely or as a substitute for husbandry or a remedy for biosecurity failures. However, stewardship in aquaculture cannot be reduced to legal restriction or lower antimicrobial input alone. Fish diseases occur in heterogeneous systems, including recirculating systems, flow-through farms, ponds, hatcheries and marine cages, with different patterns of pathogen entry, treatment delivery and environmental exposure. This review examines antimicrobial use in European aquaculture through the conditions required to make reduction clinically and environmentally workable. Its central argument is that regulatory transformation depends on implementation capacity. Aquatic veterinarians are expected to justify and reduce antimicrobial use while responding to bacterial disease events that may progress rapidly, affect populations and threaten welfare. This decision space becomes difficult where diagnostic access, authorised medicinal products, vaccines, records, surveillance systems or aquatic veterinary expertise are limited. Prevention, biosecurity, diagnostics and surveillance are discussed as decision-enabling infrastructure rather than generic sustainability measures. They reduce preventable disease pressure, help distinguish bacterial from non-bacterial morbidity, support justified treatment and provide feedback on health and environmental outcomes. The aquatic environment is treated not only as a recipient of residues, resistant bacteria and resistance genes but also as a source of risk, exposure and governance information. Responsible antimicrobial reduction is, therefore, not simple minimisation. Sustainable disease management depends on connecting regulatory ambition with veterinary decision-making, therapeutic feasibility, diagnostic support and environmental feedback.
papers.summary_cn: 欧洲水产养殖正面临减少抗菌药物使用与遏制耐药性风险的双重监管压力，但单纯限制用药难以实现可持续疾病管理。本文综述指出，抗菌药物减量在临床和环境层面的可行性取决于实施能力，包括诊断可及性、授权药物、疫苗、监测系统及水生兽医专业力量等决策支撑条件。预防、biosecurity、诊断与surveillance应被视为赋能决策的基础设施，而非泛泛的可持续性措施；水生环境既是残留物和耐药基因的受体，也是风险与治理信息的来源。

papers.title: ESG performance and financing constraints in aquaculture and fishery listed companies: Evidence from China
papers.authors: Wang, Litao; Yin, Danni
papers.abstract: This paper uses Chinese A-share fishery-listed companies from 2009 to 2025 as the research sample, comprising 14 companies and 197 annual panel observations. Using a two-way fixed-effects model, it empirically tests the impact, transmission path, and heterogeneity of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance on the financing constraints of fishery companies. The ESG indicators are measured using a comprehensive rating of 0 to 100 points on the Huazheng Index, with higher scores indicating better overall levels of environmental compliance, social responsibility fulfillment, and internal governance of the company. Financing constraints are calculated using the KZ index, with a higher index value indicating greater financing constraints for the company. The study found that the regression coefficient of the comprehensive ESG score of companies is -0.069, which is significantly negative at the 5% statistical level, indicating that good ESG performance can significantly alleviate the financing constraints of fishery companies. Mechanism testing shows that subsidy acquisition and supply chain relationship governance are the two core transmission channels through which ESG mitigates effects. Heterogeneity analysis shows that the environmental dimension is the core driver of ESG in improving the financing environment for companies, and that the financing slow-release effect of ESG is more pronounced in aquaculture and fishery companies with low export dependence. This study is based on the local characteristics of China’s fisheries industry policies and industrial chain, and examines the economic effects of ESG in the agricultural sector. It can provide local empirical evidence to optimize green finance policies in the fisheries industry and to lay out ESG practices for listed aquatic companies.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以2009—2025年中国A股14家渔业上市公司197个年度面板数据为样本，采用双向固定效应模型检验ESG表现对渔业企业融资约束的影响、传导路径及异质性。结果显示，ESG综合评分回归系数为-0.069（5%水平显著），表明良好ESG表现可显著缓解渔业企业融资约束；补贴获取与供应链关系治理是两条核心传导渠道。异质性分析表明，环境维度是ESG改善融资环境的核心驱动因素，且该缓释效应在低出口依赖型水产养殖与渔业企业中更为明显。

papers.title: Draft genome sequence of emerging Salmonella enterica serovar Kentucky ST198 isolated from broiler litter at an integrated poultry-aquaculture marketplace in Bangladesh
papers.authors: Amena, Bibi; Islam, Mohimanul; Rana, Eaftekhar Ahmed; Momin, Md. Moksedul; Miah, Gous; Uddin, Gazi Md. Noor; Bilkis, Tahmina
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Integrated live poultry-aquaculture marketplaces represent high-risk One Health interfaces where environmental circulation of zoonotic Salmonella poses a threat to public health. Using Illumina NovaSeq, this study delineates genomic features of a Salmonella Kentucky ST198 strain, providing insight into a globally disseminated lineage and a resource for future surveillance and epidemiological investigations.
papers.summary_cn: 研究对孟加拉国一个家禽-水产综合市场肉鸡垫料中分离的 Salmonella enterica serovar Kentucky ST198 进行全基因组测序（Illumina NovaSeq），旨在解析这一全球传播谱系的基因组特征。该菌株来源于活禽-水产综合市场这一高风险 One Health 界面，其基因组数据可为沙门氏菌监测与流行病学研究提供参考。

papers.title: Distribution and New Fish Host for the Parasitic Isopod Livoneca redmanii Leach, 1818 (Crustacea: Cymothoidae) Collected in Northeastern Brazilian Coast
papers.authors: Nery, Saulo Felipe Souza; de Carvalho Paiva, Ricardo José; Martins, Déborah Elena Galvão; de Almeida Alves-Júnior, Flavio
papers.journal: Thalassas: An International Journal of Marine Sciences
papers.abstract: Abstract Isopods of the family Cymothoidae Leach, 1814 are frequently found as fish parasites in continental and marine environments, distributed in tropical and subtropical environments. The presence of these parasites causes histological and morphological damage to the health of their hosts, in addition to economic impacts on fishing. The isopod species Livoneca redmanii Leach 1818 occurs throughout the Atlantic Ocean, with a distribution that includes the Caribbean Sea, Brazil and, recently, the Mediterranean Sea (Egypt), parasitizing a wide range of estuarine/marine fish. In Brazil, this species is found mainly parasitizing fishes of the families Scombridae Rafinesque 1815 and Carangidae Rafinesque 1815. Thus, this study reports L. redmanii parasitizing a new host, the smallscale weakfish Cynoscion microlepidotus (Cuvier, 1830) (Sciaenidae), both collected on the coast of Maranhão, thereby expanding its list of hosts and geographic distribution in Brazil. The specimens of C. microlepidotus and their ectoparasites were collected in the municipality of Cedral (Maranhão, 02°00’34.8"S 044°30’30.3"W) by local artisanal fishermen, in June and July 2025. We analyzed 10 specimens of C. microlepidotus , containing 19 individuals of L. redmanii (4 males and 15 females) occupying the gill chambers. This report reinforces the need for studies on parasite-host interactions in coastal and estuarine ecosystems of Northeast Brazil, aiming to better understand their ecological and economic impacts. We also provide a host list for L. redmanii , showing its generalist and opportunistic nature. Furthermore, future research should investigate the dynamics of infestation in species of commercial interest.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究报道了等足类寄生虫 Livoneca redmanii 在巴西东北部海岸寄生新宿主——小鳞犬牙石首鱼（Cynoscion microlepidotus, Sciaenidae）的首次记录。2025年6–7月于马拉尼昂州Cedral采集的10尾宿主鳃腔中共检出19个L. redmanii个体（4雄15雌），扩展了该寄生虫的宿主谱与地理分布。文章同时提供L. redmanii宿主名录，指出其广宿主与机会主义特性，并强调需加强巴西东北部沿海及河口生态系统中寄生虫-宿主互作及其对商业鱼种侵染动态的研究。

papers.title: Cross hybridization Inference for Phylogenetic Resolution (CIPHR)-FISH enables microbiome imaging with strain level taxonomic resolution
papers.authors: Adade, Emmanuel E; Wang, Ruogu; Henneberry, Colin M; Lemus, Alex A; Stevick, Rebecca J; Perez-Pascual, David; Audrain, Bianca; Orsino, Alexa J; Farnsworth, Dylan R; Ghigo, Jean-Marc
papers.abstract: Abstract The spatial organization of microbial communities is a critical determinant of host-microbe interactions, yet species-level mapping remains challenging due to high 16S rRNA sequence homology and spectral crosstalk in multiplexed fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH). To address this challenge, we developed Cross-hybridization Inference for Phylogenetic Resolution (CIPHR)-FISH, a pipeline that integrates strategic probe design with supervised machine learning. CIPHR-FISH transforms probe cross-hybridization, traditionally viewed as experimental noise, into informative molecular signatures. Using a gnotobiotic zebrafish model colonized with a defined mix of 10 zebrafish bacterial strains, we trained a support vector machine (SVM) on empirical hybridization patterns from pure bacterial cultures. CIPHR-FISH achieved 99.2 % macro-averaged accuracy, significantly outperforming standard linear unmixing (62.5 %), and successfully discriminated strains with 99.7% sequence homology. Applying this tool to gnotobiotic zebrafish larvae revealed distinct biogeographies: the intestinal bulb hosted highly structured, multi-layered polymicrobial aggregates, while the skin exhibited sparse, uniformly dispersed individual bacterial cells. Notably, we observed significant variation in spatial community structure that was obscured by traditional bulk 16S rRNA sequencing. CIPHR-FISH provides a robust framework for high-resolution spatial biology by converting the limitations of molecular labeling into a rich data source for taxonomic classification. This approach enables the quantification of micro-scale ecological and stochastic forces that shape the microbiome across hosts.
papers.summary_cn: 开发了CIPHR-FISH方法，通过将探针交叉杂交信号转化为分子特征并结合支持向量机（SVM）分类，实现菌株级分类分辨率的微生物组空间成像。在定菌斑马鱼模型中，该方法对10株细菌的宏平均准确率达99.2%，显著优于传统线性解混（62.5%），并可区分16S rRNA序列同源性高达99.7%的菌株。应用于斑马鱼幼鱼后揭示了肠道球部与皮肤上截然不同的微生物空间分布格局，展现了传统bulk 16S rRNA测序无法捕捉的空间群落结构差异。

papers.title: Contrasting fish and phytoplankton community structure along a seasonally dynamic regulated Afro-tropical river
papers.authors: Ugbor, Ogechi Nnabuchi; Amoutchi, Amien Isaac; Uka, Anyaele; Omoigberale, Michael Osasele; Mehner, Thomas
papers.abstract: Abstract River regulation alters environmental conditions and hydrological connectivity, yet these influences are embedded within natural longitudinal and seasonal variation. We examined fish and phytoplankton community structure across 15 sites along the Lower Niger River, regulated by two dams, during dry and rainy seasons. We evaluated compositional differences among upstream, inter-dam and downstream sections, partitioned taxonomic β-diversity into turnover and nestedness, and assessed environmental, spatial and dam associated positional contributions to community variation. Both assemblages differed among river sections defined by their position relative to the dams, although differentiation was stronger for phytoplankton. Taxonomic β-diversity was consistently dominated by species turnover, accounting for approximately 90% of fish and 72–74% of phytoplankton β-diversity. Fish showed weak correspondence with measured environmental, spatial and fragmentation gradients, despite stronger compositional differentiation during the rainy season. Phytoplankton showed stronger environmental and dam-associated spatial structuring, with dam separation being particularly important during the rainy season. Environmental, spatial and dam-associated positional components were strongly shared, particularly for rainy-season phytoplankton community composition, showing that these components are closely intertwined along the regulated river continuum. Overall, community structure reflected high taxonomic replacement and assemblage-specific responses to interconnected environmental, spatial and river-regulation-associated patterns, with actively dispersing fish showing weaker structuring than the smaller, passively dispersed phytoplankton. This contrast emphasizes the value of considering multiple biological groups with different dispersal characteristics when assessing biodiversity patterns in regulated tropical rivers.
papers.summary_cn: 研究比较了受两座大坝调节的尼日尔河下游15个样点在旱季与雨季的鱼类和浮游植物群落结构，通过β多样性分解及环境、空间与大坝位置因素的贡献分析，揭示河流调节对群落的影响。两种群落在坝上、坝间和坝下区段间均存在分化，浮游植物分化更强；分类β多样性以物种周转为主（鱼类约90%，浮游植物72–74%）。鱼类与所测环境、空间及破碎化梯度对应较弱，而浮游植物受环境和坝相关空间结构影响更强，且各因素高度交织；主动扩散的鱼类受结构化影响弱于被动扩散的浮游植物，表明评估受调节热带河流生物多样性需兼顾不同扩散特性的生物类群。

papers.title: Upstream distribution and dam passage of native Sea Lamprey (Petromyzon marinus) following improved basin connectivity in the Penobscot River, Maine
papers.authors: Dillingham, Cody; Katz, Lara Sophie; York, Geneva; Frechette, Danielle; Zydlewski, Joseph D.
papers.abstract: Sea Lamprey are a native species in Maine’s rivers and have been in steep decline due to habitat fragmentation. Recent river connectivity improvements in the Penobscot River increased habitat access, but the effects of these changes are still being assessed. We used eDNA and radio telemetry to assess the current habitat use and dam passage for Sea Lamprey in the Penobscot River. We then compared these results with previous studies and historical data to quantify changes in Sea Lamprey distribution through time. Our results show that the distribution of Sea Lamprey decreased by 84% between the 1800’s and 2007. Restoration efforts have increased the species’ distribution by 45% between 2007 and 2023, but the species remains limited to only 23% of its historical range. Extant dams continue to prevent the expansion of Sea Lamprey. Many Penobscot River dams lack fish bypasses and passage performance is highly variable among dams with bypasses (0%-96% overall passage success between 2020 and 2023). Improved passage at dams remains an important direction for restoration of these native fish.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用eDNA与radio telemetry评估了Penobscot River中native Sea Lamprey的栖息地利用与dam passage现状，并结合历史数据量化其分布变化。结果显示，1800年代至2007年间该物种分布缩减84%，2007至2023年恢复努力使分布扩大45%，但仍仅占历史范围的23%。现存dam持续阻碍其扩散，且有无鱼道及鱼道性能差异显著（2020–2023年passage success为0%–96%），改善dam passage仍是该native fish恢复的关键方向。

papers.title: Multi-trophic insights into size-dependent biodiversity patterns in a human-impacted semi-enclosed gulf
papers.authors: Chen, Wenjian; Li, Yusen; Lin, Muwen; Lin, Jingping; Deng, Huihuang; Liu, Li; Guo, Chuanbo; Wang, Dapeng; Zhou, Lei
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 该研究关注受人类活动影响的半封闭海湾中，生物多样性随体型变化的跨营养级格局，但摘要缺失，具体方法、对象与结论无法确定。

papers.title: Multifaceted freshwater fish α-diversity exhibits discordant spatial patterns and distinct environmental associations across the United States
papers.authors: Xu, Congjun; Chen, Zheng; Li, Jiping; Li, Yingxin; Du, Chenggong; Liu, Naisen; Xu, Jun; Su, Guohuan
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 该研究基于美国全国尺度数据，探讨淡水鱼类α多样性的多个维度（如分类、功能、系统发育多样性）是否存在空间格局分异及其环境关联差异。由于缺乏摘要，具体方法未知，但推测采用空间分析与统计模型比较各多样性维度的分布模式。标题提示不同维度的α多样性呈现不一致的空间格局，且各自关联不同的环境因子。
