papers.title: Strategic directions for the sustainable development of the Astrakhan region’s fisheries sector in the context of digitalization
papers.authors: Sviridova, Elena Viktorovna; Mordovtceva, Svetlana Olegovna; Zhuravleva, Kira Sergeevna; Petrosyan, Artem E.
papers.journal: Vestnik of Astrakhan State Technical University. Series: Economics
papers.abstract: The strategic role of the fisheries sector (FS) in ensuring the country’s food security has been noted, and the need to overcome the structural constraints hindering the sector’s development has been identified: the obsolescence of the fishing fleet, infrastructure deficits, the territorial fragmentation of the FS entities, and dependence on natural and climatic factors. Based on the analysis of industry data from Rosrybolovstvo, a set of specific problems of the Astrakhan region FS (investment, environmental, economic, structural, infrastructural and socio-cultural) has been identified, the solution of which is proposed to be implemented within the framework of four strategic directions: diversification of the raw material base, expansion of deep processing and assortment of fish products, optimization of logistics processes, formation of consumer demand. demand. As the main tool for the implementation of strategic directions for the sustainable development of the regional agricultural complex, the creation of a logistics center based on a single digital platform is defined, ensuring the digital universalization of interaction between subjects. To substantiate recommendations for the digitalization of the regional FS, a case study was conducted of implemented projects in the Republic of Karelia, the Yamalo Nenets Autonomous Okrug, and the Kaliningrad region. The study showed that, in addition to the expected economic effect, digitalization unintentionally performed a number of hidden functions: it fa-cilitated adaptation to the shortage of imported feed after the imposition of sanctions in 2022, enabled the implementation of energy saving practices, stimulated staff mobility, and contributed to building the reputational capital of enterprises. Based on the identified patterns, a conceptual model has been developed for transferring digital solutions from the Northwestern region to the Astrakhan region, taking into account regional specifics. It has been established that a mechanical transfer of practices from the Northwest is ineffective without considering the transboundary nature of the river system and the characteristics of sturgeon species. A reorientation of the functional purpose of the digital platform is proposed – from a tool for calculating feed rations to a system for early warning of environmental and economic losses, integrated with the infrastructure of state monitoring of aquatic biological resources and reclamation measures.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究旨在探讨数字化背景下俄罗斯阿斯特拉罕地区渔业部门的可持续发展战略方向。基于Rosrybolovstvo行业数据分析，识别出投资、环境、经济、结构和基础设施等问题，并提出原材料基础多元化、深加工扩展、物流优化和消费需求培育四大战略方向，核心工具为基于统一数字平台的物流中心。通过对卡累利阿共和国、亚马尔-涅涅茨自治区和加里宁格勒州的案例研究发现，数字化除预期经济效应外，还产生了适应制裁后进口饲料短缺、节能实践、员工流动性和企业声誉资本建设等隐性功能。研究提出将数字平台功能从饲料配给计算转向环境与经济损失预警系统，并与水生生物资源国家监测基础设施整合。

papers.title: Environmental relationships with Silver Carp population ecology across the Mississippi River basin
papers.authors: Stevens, Jeffery N; Barshinger, Cooper E; Althoff, Andrew L; Owens, Derek K; Kindschuh, Jamie L; Spurgeon, Jonathan J; Eggleton, Michael E; Lochmann, Steve E
papers.journal: North American Journal of Fisheries Management
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Silver Carp Hypophthalmichthys molitrix are of special concern to fisheries management agencies across the Mississippi River basin, but effective control of the species is challenging. Our objectives were to (1) identify spatial and environmental patterns among key Silver Carp demographic rates that could be exploited by removal programs and (2) develop predictive models of Silver Carp demographic rates using readily available environmental data that could potentially be used to quantify population ecology without expending the resources to conduct population assessments. Methods We collected Silver Carp from six rivers within the lower Mississippi River subbasin (i.e., Arkansas, Cache, Mississippi, St. Francis, White, and Yazoo rivers) and compiled raw data from populations in the upper Mississippi, Missouri, and Ohio River subbasins to estimate demographic rates (i.e., growth, mortality, and recruitment variability). We compared the demographic rates among subbasins and between main stems and tributaries using standard nonparametric tests. We used information-theoretic model selection to evaluate relationships among demographic rates, environmental conditions, and invasion stage. Results In general, lower Mississippi River subbasin populations exhibited faster growth and lower mortality than did those from the upper Mississippi River subbasin. Populations in main-stem rivers did not differ from those in tributaries. More established populations in warmer, free-flowing rivers (e.g., White River) generally experienced faster growth, lower mortality, and more stable recruitment than less established populations in cooler, impounded rivers (e.g., Illinois River). Conclusions The results indicated that variability in Silver Carp populations was related to environmental conditions and invasion stage. Our results suggested that the effectiveness of removal programs might be ­improved by targeting populations in warm hydrologically variable rivers, as they may have increased reproduction capacities and emigration rates. The equations provided here may be used to estimate population ­demographics for Silver Carp and help determine their potential sensitivity to management actions, without expending the resources that are required to collect population-specific biological data.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在识别密西西比河流域鳙（Silver Carp）关键种群统计参数（growth、mortality、recruitment variability）的空间与环境格局，并利用易获取的环境数据建立预测模型，以替代高成本的种群评估。研究采集了下密西西比河亚流域六条河流的样本，并整合上密西西比河、密苏里河和俄亥俄河亚流域的原始数据，采用非参数检验和信息论模型选择进行分析。结果表明，下密西西比河种群生长更快、死亡率更低；干流与支流间无显著差异；温暖、自由流动河流中定殖较久的种群生长更快、死亡率更低且补充更稳定。研究建议将清除计划重点 targeting 温暖且水文多变的河流中的种群，并提供可用于估算种群统计参数的方程。

papers.title: Detection of NTRK1/2/3 rearrangements in pigmented spindle cell naevus of Reed: a comparative study of optimized pan‐ TRK immunohistochemistry, FISH  and  RNA ‐ NGS
papers.authors: Ricci, Costantino; Corti, Barbara; Coluccelli, Sara; Calafato, Giulia; Anconelli, Debora; Vasuri, Francesco; Lambertini, Martina; Venturi, Federico; Scotti, Biagio; Grillini, Alessia
papers.abstract: Aims Pigmented spindle cell naevus of Reed (PSCN) is mainly characterized by MYO5A::NTRK3 fusion. However, the prevalence of NTRK fusions/rearrangements in PSCNs ranges from 15.8% to 57% in the literature, and the agreement among techniques for detecting these alterations has not been analysed. Here, we analysed NTRK fusions/rearrangements in a series of PSCNs using an optimized pan‐TRK protocol, RNA‐NGS fusion panel and FISH ( NTRK1/2/ 3). Methods and results Seventy‐nine PSCNs were collected, reclassified (2025 WHO criteria and negative for BRAF V600E/RAS Q61R stains), and stained with a modified version of a recently proposed pan‐TRK protocol (additional amplification steps and Red chromogen). In 64 and 57 cases with available material, we performed RNA‐NGS and FISH ( NTRK1/2/3 ) analyses, respectively. Pan‐TRK was positive in 16 (20.3%) cases, all showing diffuse, granular, cytoplasmic staining of moderate intensity. In 59 cases with evaluable RNA‐NGS data, 33 (55.9%) harboured MYO5A::NTRK3 fusion, 3 (5.1%) had NTRK3 imbalance, and 1 (1.7%) case each showed MYO5A::ROS1 and ESR1::CCDC170 fusion. In 51 cases with evaluable FISH ( NTRK3 ) data, 33 (64.7%) were positive for NTRK3 rearrangement. Both the comparison of pan‐TRK versus RNA‐NGS and versus FISH ( NTRK3 ) revealed high values of specificity (SP) and positive predictive value (PPV) (92.3%–96.2%) for the detection of NTRK3 fusions/rearrangements, despite a limited sensitivity (SE) of 36.4%. In the comparison of pan‐TRK versus RNA‐NGS and FISH ( NTRK3 ), both SP and PPV were 100%, with a SE of 33.3%. Conclusions Our ‘optimized’ pan‐TRK protocol achieved high SP and PPV for the detection of NTRK3 fusions/rearrangements in PSCNs, despite a limited sensitivity compared to molecular assay. These results suggest that this protocol may serve as a diagnostic tool in routine practice, effectively guiding molecular testing and refining the diagnostic workflow for PSCNs.

papers.title: Freshwater fish species in the “Fish pastes” preservation technology
papers.authors: Yusubova, Anastasia Pavlovna; Tsibizova, Maria Evgenievna
papers.journal: Vestnik of Astrakhan State Technical University. Series: Fishing industry
papers.abstract: An important technological direction in the food industry of the Astrakhan region is the production of fish products. According to the results of the study of the dynamics of catch and cultivation, the most promising objects for deep processing are crucian carp and carp. During the study of the chemical composition and functional and technological properties of the objects of research, it was found that carp and crucian carp belong to protein-rich medium-fat fish species, to the group of slightly ripening raw materials, therefore, when obtaining canned products from them, it is necessary to use a biotechnological approach, i.e. to activate its own enzyme system of raw materials. Short-term fermentation of raw materials is a promising method for targeted modification of the muscle tissue and bone system of fish, which allows not only to effectively soften and dissolve small bones, but also to break down proteins into polypeptides and peptides, which improves the consistency, bioavailability of nutrients and enriches the flavor characteristics of the final product. To establish rational modes of carrying out the process of short-term auto-proteolysis of minced meat from carp and crucian carp muscle tissue at natural pH, the effect of temperature and duration on the the process of autoproteolysis to the depth of hydrolysis of muscle tissue proteins of crucian carp and carp. According to the results of the research, it was shown that the recommended duration of the short-term fermentation of minced fish from carp and crucian carp is 90 minutes at a temperature of 40 °C with a natural pH value of 6.2 and without using water as a reaction medium. The change in the dynamics of accumulation of formally titrated nitrogen in minced meat from carp and crucian carp muscle tissue practically does not differ, which confirms the possibility of using these fish in the technology of canned pastes both separately and in a mixture at different ratios.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在优化鲤鱼和鲫鱼在鱼酱（fish pastes）罐头加工中的短时自溶（autoproteolysis）工艺参数。通过测定鱼肉化学组成及功能特性，发现两者均属高蛋白中脂鱼类且成熟度低，需借助内源酶系统进行定向修饰。结果表明，在自然pH 6.2、40 °C条件下短时发酵90 min，可有效软化细骨、降解蛋白为多肽，改善质构与风味；鲤、鲫鱼肌肉组织的自溶氮积累动态基本一致，可单独或按不同比例混合用于鱼酱罐头生产。

papers.title: Study of oxidative stability of fish oil in different conditions
papers.authors: Makarova, Nadezhda Viktorovna; Voronina, Marianna Sergeevna
papers.journal: Vestnik of Astrakhan State Technical University. Series: Fishing industry
papers.abstract: The oxidation of lipids containing unsaturated fatty acids in their structure represents a large-scale and mul-tifaceted challenge for modern food chemistry and nutrition science. This process is the primary cause of spoilage in fat-containing products, leading to a significant reduction in their biological value and safety. The degradation of key fatty acid molecules, such as oleic, linoleic, and alpha-linolenic acids-characteristic of vegetable oils-as well as long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), primarily eicosapentaenoic and docosahexaenoic acids-typical of fish oil, marine hydrobionts, and certain microbiological sources-is examined in detail. Particular attention is paid to the dynamics of the accumulation of volatile organic compounds that form the specific, often unpleasant taste and odor characteristic of rancidity. The initial mechanism of autoxidation, initiated by the formation of free radicals and hydroperoxides, may appear predictable in its early stages. However, as the chemical reactions progress, the processes evolve into a complex cascade of transformations. The composition of the final and intermediate breakdown products, including aldehydes, ketones, alcohols, and furans, is difficult to predict and directly depends on the physicochemical nature of the substrate, as well as on environmental conditions: temperature, oxygen availability, the presence of transition metal ions, and exposure to light. An analysis was conducted on the influence of various heat treatment methods (boiling, frying, pasteurization) on the intensity of destructive processes. It was established that thermal stress not only accelerates primary reactions but also triggers specific peroxide decomposition pathways that are characteristic of high-temperature regimes. To prevent premature oxidative spoilage and preserve the native organoleptic characteristics of oils, the use of a wide range of antioxidants, both synthetic and natural in origin, is substantiated. Current understanding of the pathways for stabilizing lipid systems is systematized, and approaches to optimizing technological processes in the production of functional food products enriched with PUFAs are proposed.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究系统分析了鱼油中长链多不饱和脂肪酸（EPA、DHA）在不同条件下的氧化稳定性，重点考察了加热方式（煮沸、油炸、巴氏杀菌）对脂质氧化进程及挥发性有机物生成的影响。研究发现热胁迫不仅加速初级自氧化反应，还触发高温特异的过氧化物分解路径，最终产物组成受温度、氧气、金属离子和光照等因素共同调控。文章进一步综述了合成与天然抗氧化剂在延缓鱼油氧化酸败、保持其感官品质方面的应用，并提出了富含PUFA功能性食品加工工艺的优化方向。

papers.title: Physiological and adaptive aspects of post-winter resistance  in the hybrid of Russian sturgeon and Lena sturgeon  (Acipenser gueldenstaedtii × A. baeri) and Russian sturgeon  (Acipenser gueldenstaedtii) under cage aquaculture conditions
papers.authors: Sergeeva, Olesya Stanuslavovna; Ponomarev, Sergey Vladimirovich; Akhmedzhanova, Aliya Baimuratovna; Fedorovykh, Yulia Viktorovna
papers.journal: Vestnik of Astrakhan State Technical University. Series: Fishing industry
papers.abstract: The present study provides a comparative analysis of hematological and physiological-biochemical blood parameters in females of the hybrid of Russian sturgeon (Acipenser gueldenstaedtii) and Lena sturgeon (Acipenser baeri) designated as RsLs and the pure species Russian sturgeon (Acipenser gueldenstaedtii) during the post-winter period under cage rearing conditions in a fish farm located in the Astrakhan region. The objects of the study were 14-year-old females of the RsLs hybrid and the pure Russian sturgeon. The research material comprised blood samples collected from specimens after the completion of wintering. In the blood samples, hematological parameters (hemoglobin concentration, erythrocyte sedimentation rate) and biochemical parameters (total protein, glucose, cholesterol, and albumin content) were determined using standard analytical methods. Statistically significant intergroup differences (p < 0.05) were established for two key parameters: erythrocyte sedimentation rate in the RsLs hybrid was lower (3.3 ± 0.2 mm/h vs. 4.5 ± 0.4 mm/h in Russian sturgeon), while glucose level was higher (7.3 ± 0.3 g/L vs. 6.3 ± 0.3 g/L), reflecting differentiated stress reactivity of the compared groups (hybrid and pure species). For the remaining parameters studied (hemoglobin, total protein, albumin, cholesterol), the revealed intergroup differences did not reach statistical significance. All studied parameters in both groups remained within the physiological reference ranges established for sturgeon species. The revealed differences are interpreted as evidence of enhanced adaptive plasticity of the RsLs hybrid, presumably conditioned by the genetic contribution of the Lena sturgeon, which is characterized by high tolerance to temperature fluctuations and variations in oxygen regime.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了网箱养殖条件下，俄罗斯鲟（Acipenser gueldenstaedtii）与列纳鲟（A. baeri）杂交种（RsLs）及纯种俄罗斯鲟14龄雌鱼越冬后的血液生理生化指标。结果显示，杂交种红细胞沉降率显著低于纯种（3.3 vs. 4.5 mm/h），而血糖水平显著较高（7.3 vs. 6.3 g/L），其余指标（血红蛋白、总蛋白、白蛋白、胆固醇）组间无显著差异，且均处于鲟鱼生理参考范围内。上述差异反映了杂交种与纯种在应激反应性上的分化，提示RsLs杂交种具有更强的适应可塑性，可能源于列纳鲟对温度波动和溶氧变化的耐受性遗传贡献。

papers.title: Quantifying exposure and residence time of migrating Atlantic salmon post-smolts at aquaculture sites in a region of extreme tides
papers.authors: Wilson, Brent M.; McKindsey, Christopher W.; Hardie, David C; Daniels, Jason M; Carr, Jonathan W.; Hawkes, James P; Trudel, Marc
papers.journal: Canadian Journal of Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences
papers.abstract: Aquaculture production now exceeds capture fisheries, but concerns persist regarding environmental impacts. Salmon farms within Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) migratory corridors may create hotspots of predation, parasites, or disease that could affect out-migrating post-smolts. However, residence time near farm sites remains poorly characterized. We used acoustic telemetry to quantify survival and residency of 60 post-smolts moving through the estuarine and coastal waters of Passamaquoddy Bay, New Brunswick, Canada, an area with concentrated aquaculture and extreme tidal range. Of the 53 individuals reaching marine waters, 23 (43%) were recorded within the ~400 m detection range of at least one monitored farm across 55 events. Median residence time per farm ranged from 4.5 to 32.5 min, with a cumulative median of 31.2 min across all four farms. Tides strongly influenced movements, increasing residence time and farm exposure by reversing seaward migration. Post-smolts were incidentally present near farms, without evidence of attraction or elevated predation. Although indirect or latent effects were not assessed, offshore mortality played a greater role in recruitment than apparent mortality associated with aquaculture sites.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究利用 acoustic telemetry 追踪 60 尾 Atlantic salmon post-smolt 在加拿大 Passamaquoddy Bay 高潮差、集约化养殖海域的迁移，量化其在三文鱼养殖场附近的暴露与滞留时间。53 尾进入海水后，23 尾（43%）在至少一个养殖场约 400 m 检测范围内被记录，单场中位滞留时间 4.5–32.5 min，四场累计中位 31.2 min。潮汐通过逆转向海迁移显著延长滞留时间，但未发现 post-smolt 被养殖场吸引或捕食率升高的证据，离岸死亡率对补充量的影响大于养殖场相关的表观死亡率。

papers.title: Sequentially Conditioned Screening for Marine Aquaculture Siting in Contested Tropical Coastal Waters: Framework Formulation and a Worked Example
papers.authors: Muktiarni, M.; Widiaty, Isma; Widaningsih, Lilis; Yulia, Cica
papers.abstract: Marine aquaculture siting in tropical coastal waters is usually treated as a scoring problem: criteria are weighted, cells are ranked, and constraints enter as low scores that a high score elsewhere can offset. Where the sea is already allocated to tourism, conservation, shipping and customary fishing, this treatment misrepresents the decision, because prior claims are not weak preferences. This paper formulates a screening framework built on the opposite premise. Six stages are applied in sequence, each operating only on what survives the stage above it: biophysical suitability by weighted overlay; a spatial union of non-compensatory exclusions; an operational feasibility screen; a nitrogen and phosphorus mass balance that sets a production ceiling; system-specific discounted cash-flow analysis at scales appropriate to each technology; and a composite evaluation reported under four weighting schemes. The framework is specified completely by ten governing equations, four pairwise comparison matrices with consistency ratios between 0.017 and 0.026, membership functions for every criterion, and a sixteen-parameter mass-balance set and is demonstrated through a worked example for a stipulated four-zone tropical island setting of 9,184 km2. In the demonstration, 68.6% of the evaluated area is biophysically suitable; exclusions and the operational screen remove a further 3,456 km2, and 31.0% remains developable; two-thirds of the excluded area is attributable to competing use rather than to biophysical unsuitability. Nitrogen binds in only one of the four zones, and the two-dimensional composite ranks the zones identically at first and last place under every weighting scheme tested, with only the middle two positions being weighting-dependent. The worked example uses stipulated geometry and stated parameter values throughout and is not an assessment of any actual location.
papers.summary_cn: 针对热带沿海水域海水养殖选址中既有用海主张不可补偿的问题，提出以序贯筛选替代传统加权评分框架。该框架依次执行六阶段筛选：生物物理适宜性加权叠加、非补偿性排除区空间并集、运营可行性筛选、氮磷质量平衡设定产量上限、系统特定折现现金流分析及四种权重方案下的综合评价，由十组控制方程和十六参数质量平衡集完整定义。以9,184 km²四区热带岛屿设定为例，68.6%区域生物物理适宜，排除与运营筛选后31.0%可开发，三分之二排除面积源于竞争性用海而非生物物理限制；氮仅在四区之一成为限制因子，二维综合评价在首末位排序上不受权重方案影响。

papers.title: Bacterial Contamination and Public Health Risks Associated with Aquaculture and Wild-caught Fish in Urban Water Bodies, in Southern Nigeria
papers.authors: Nnaemeka-Erickson, Abigail Chinyere; Nosa, Okunbor Hilary; Chika, Okangba; Uche, Ikechi Amarachi; Udeani, Theophilus K.
papers.abstract: Background: Fish is an important dietary component in Nigerian riverine communities, but bacterial contamination may constitute a significant food safety and public health concern. Objective: This study evaluated the prevalence and diversity of pathogenic bacteria associated with Clarias gariepinus, Oreochromis niloticus, and Mugil cephalus obtained from creeks, aquaculture ponds, and open markets in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, Nigeria. Methods: Forty-two fish samples, comprising 24 fresh and 18 smoked specimens, were collected from three creeks, three ponds, and three markets. Skin surfaces, skin tissues, gills, and intestines were sampled, yielding 168 specimens. Bacterial isolation was performed using MacConkey, Salmonella-Shigella, and thiosulphate-citrate-bile salts-sucrose (TCBS) agar. Isolates were identified using colony morphology, Gram staining, and standard biochemical tests. Results: Bacterial growth occurred in 163/168 (97.0%) specimens. Thirteen bacterial species were recovered, including Bacillus cereus, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella spp., Proteus spp., Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Salmonella spp., Staphylococcus aureus, Vibrio cholerae, and Vibrio parahaemolyticus. Proteus spp. (17.5%), P. aeruginosa (14.9%), and E. coli (13.2%) predominated. Pond-cultured catfish had the highest bacterial load (36.5 × 10⁵ CFU/g), exceeding the reported recommended limit of 5 × 10⁵ CFU/g. Creek fish contributed 40.4% of isolates, followed by market fish (35.7%). Faecal indicators, including E. coli, Klebsiella spp., and Salmonella spp., indicated possible environmental and handling-related contamination. Conclusion: Fish in Port Harcourt harbour diverse potentially pathogenic bacteria, highlighting foodborne disease risks and the need for improved aquaculture hygiene, environmental sanitation, food handling, surveillance, and consumer education.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚哈科特港溪流、养殖池塘和市场来源的三种鱼类（*Clarias gariepinus*、*Oreochromis niloticus*、*Mugil cephalus*）中致病菌的流行与多样性。共采集42份鱼样（24份鲜鱼、18份熏鱼），从皮肤表面、皮肤组织、鳃和肠道分离细菌，168份样本中163份（97.0%）检出细菌，共鉴定出13种，以 *Proteus* spp.（17.5%）、*Pseudomonas aeruginosa*（14.9%）和 *Escherichia coli*（13.2%）为主，并检出 *Salmonella* spp.、*Vibrio cholerae* 和 *Vibrio parahaemolyticus* 等致病菌。池塘养殖鲶鱼细菌载量最高（36.5 × 10⁵ CFU/g），超过推荐限值（5 × 10⁵ CFU/g），且 *E. coli*、*Klebsiella* spp. 和 *Salmonella* spp. 等粪便指示菌的存在提示环境与操作环节污染。结果表明该地区鱼类携带多种潜在致病菌，存在食源性疾病风险，需加强水产养殖卫生、环境治理及食品监管。

papers.title: Organic aquaculture in the semiarid climate  of the temperate latitudes of the Eurasian ecoregion
papers.authors: Lagutkina, Lina Yurievna; Martyanov, Alexander Sergeevich; Sokolova, Ekaterina Vladimirovna; Svirina, Svetlana Alekseevna; Tolstov, Nikita Vasilevich
papers.journal: Vestnik of Astrakhan State Technical University. Series: Fishing industry
papers.abstract: Modern reality dictates the need to develop innovative methods of the traditional agricultural sector that ensure the sustainable development of organic aquaculture in a semi-arid climate of temperate latitudes of the Eurasian ecoregion. Projects for the development of fish production by the method of organic aquaculture are becoming more and more attractive for conditions of a semi-arid climate of temperate latitudes. In the context of the greening of the industry and a number of restrictive measures in the organization of organic aquaculture, successful methods form advanced technologies that allow for efficient production. The authors assessed the prospects of approaches to growing organic products based on aqua crop rotation technology and aquaponics, taking into account the possibility of implementing temperate latitudes in a semi-arid climate. Integration of the processes of growing plant crops and hydrobionts through technologies of combined and alternating cultivation by methods of aqua rotation and aquaponics is proposed. The methods meet strict criteria for organic farming and aquaculture, ensuring a high level of environmental safety and preparing products for international certification as organic food. Insufficient development of scientific foundations for such farms significantly hinders the process of developing effective organic aquaculture. The key limiting factors for the introduction of such technologies are the lack of organic feed, namely certified formulations, highly efficient structures, integrated cultivation systems for aquatic organisms and plants.
papers.summary_cn: 在半干旱温带气候条件下发展有机水产养殖面临有机饲料短缺、高效设施不足等限制。作者评估了基于aqua crop rotation和aquaponics的有机水产品生产方式，提出通过水产轮作与鱼菜共生技术整合植物与水生生物养殖过程。该方法符合有机养殖严格标准，可实现环境安全并推动国际有机认证，但相关科学基础薄弱制约了高效有机aquaculture的发展。

papers.title: Imaging Sonar Detection and Occlusion-Corrected Abundance Estimation in High-Density Aquaculture
papers.authors: Zhao, Tianhao; Zhang, Xiaolong; He, Yuhang; Ma, He; Liu, Ying; Ma, Zhihong
papers.abstract: Real-time numerical abundance monitoring in high-density recirculating aquaculture systems (RASs) faces severe bottlenecks due to target occlusion saturation and spatial sampling mismatch. This study establishes an acoustic–statistical framework coupling deep learning detection with spatial statistical theory across sequential detection, correction, and scale expansion stages. To resolve systematic counting underestimation caused by target occlusion and acoustic shadowing, a Poisson coverage model incorporating morphological eccentricity (e) is formulated to statistically correct visual detection biases. To extrapolate localized acoustic observations to whole-pond fish abundance, a spatial-scale expansion model is developed based on localized roaming behavior and spatial stratification, parameterizing horizontal (α) and vertical (ν) distribution coefficients. Under controlled density gradients (20–100 individuals), the framework achieves a minimum relative estimation error of 9.58%. In commercial pond validation trials (6000–6500 individuals), post-correction global relative errors drop to 1.38–16.43%, substantially improving upon uncorrected visual detections (38.77–53.12%). This framework offers an automated, frame-level acoustic sensing workflow for monitoring fish abundance, providing foundational numerical data for feeding optimization and stock tracking in intensive aquaculture facilities.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对高密度循环水养殖系统（RAS）中目标遮挡饱和与空间采样不匹配导致的鱼类数量实时监测难题，构建了耦合深度学习检测与空间统计理论的声学-统计框架，包含序列检测、偏差校正和尺度扩展三个阶段。通过引入形态偏心率（e）的Poisson覆盖模型校正遮挡与声影造成的计数低估，并基于局部游动行为与空间分层建立水平（α）和垂直（ν）分布系数的空间尺度扩展模型。在20–100尾密度梯度下最低相对估计误差为9.58%，商业池塘验证（6000–6500尾）中校正后全局相对误差降至1.38–16.43%，显著优于未校正的视觉检测（38.77–53.12%）。

papers.title: Beyond production: understanding aquaculture narratives, public engagement, and visibility on TikTok and Instagram
papers.authors: Goel, Mansi; Pandey, Sujita; Budhathoki, Mausam
papers.summary_cn: 该研究探讨水产养殖在TikTok和Instagram上的叙事方式、公众参与及可见度，旨在超越生产视角理解社交媒体的传播作用。

papers.title: Wave-Motion-Induced Photovoltaic Efficiency Correction for a Hybrid Wind–Solar Power Buoy in Offshore Cage Aquaculture: Modeling and Sensitivity Analysis
papers.authors: Zhang, Yifei; Mu, Gang; Cao, Hui; Duan, Fuhai
papers.abstract: Photovoltaic panels on a floating platform are tilted by wave-induced roll and pitch, and a tilted panel collects less light. This loss is usually neglected when hybrid wind–solar systems are sized. This paper estimates the loss for a small wind–solar buoy that powers offshore fish cages in the Yellow Sea. The buoy is modeled in ANSYS AQWA to obtain its roll and pitch response to waves, and the response is converted into a factor that corrects the calculated PV output. The factor depends on the square of the tilt amplitude and on the direct-beam fraction of the sunlight, so it can be evaluated directly once the wave response of the platform is known. Three buoy forms were compared, and a hemispherical buoy of 1.8 m diameter was selected. Its roll and heave natural periods, 2.86 s and 2.50 s, are shorter than the dominant wave period of 4.5–4.8 s, so the roll amplitude in the working sea state is only about 3° and the loss is only 0.1%. This is one to two orders of magnitude smaller than the 4–6% loss caused by the module temperature, so the static model is adequate for this buoy; the same factor gives 2–5% for a platform that rolls 15–25°, which shows when the wave motion has to be included in the energy balance. Wind speed and irradiance dominate the output, and a full-scale prototype confirmed the hydrodynamic and static power models to within 4%.
papers.summary_cn: 针对海上网箱养殖混合风—光供电浮标，该研究量化了波浪引起的横摇与纵摇导致光伏板倾斜、进而降低发电量这一常被忽略的损失。采用ANSYS AQWA模拟浮标波浪响应，将横摇/纵摇幅值转换为光伏出力修正因子，并比较三种浮标型式，最终选用直径1.8 m的半球形浮标。该浮标横摇与垂荡固有周期（2.86 s、2.50 s）短于主导波周期（4.5–4.8 s），工作海况下横摇幅值仅约3°，发电损失仅0.1%，比组件温度造成的4–6%损失低1–2个数量级，表明该浮标可用静态模型；但横摇15–25°的平台损失达2–5%，需在能量平衡中计入波浪运动。风速与辐照度主导出力，全尺寸原型验证了水动力与静态功率模型误差在4%以内。

papers.title: Depth-Prior-Guided Detection and Turning-Aware Association for Multi-Object Tracking of Marine Fish in Aquaculture Tanks
papers.authors: Li, Zhao; Yan, Feifan; Huang, Guangpeng; Qiu, Longhua; Yan, Yunrong; Zhou, Siwei
papers.abstract: Continuous tracking of individual fish provides a basis for movement analysis and visual monitoring in marine aquaculture. Underwater image degradation, similar appearance, and non-rigid motion complicate fish detection and identity preservation. This study develops a tracking framework for golden pompano (Trachinotus ovatus) and large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea) recorded in a land-based aquaculture tank. The framework combines a depth-structure-prior-enhanced RT-DETRv4 detector with the Scale-aware and Unscented Tracker (SU-T). A frozen Depth Anything 3 (DA3) model provides supervision based on physics-inspired structural cues derived from relative depth during training, while a lightweight student head predicts the prior without online teacher inference. Fish Turning–Deformation Coupling Consistency (FTDC) uses the empirical relationship between short-term motion-direction change and observable bounding-box variation in trajectory association. On the self-collected dataset, the final detector increased average precision over intersection-over-union thresholds of 0.50–0.95 (AP50:95) from 0.837 to 0.851. With identical detection inputs, SU-T+FTDC achieved 88.3% multiple-object-tracking accuracy, 77.4% identification F1 score, and 62.8% higher-order tracking accuracy; identity switches decreased from 66 to 60 and trajectory fragmentations from 86 to 78 relative to SU-T. These results support improved fish localization and identity continuity, providing a trajectory basis for subsequent movement and behavior analyses in aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究针对水产养殖池中金鲳（Trachinotus ovatus）和大黄鱼（Larimichthys crocea）的个体连续追踪需求，开发了融合深度结构先验增强RT-DETRv4检测器与SU-T（Scale-aware and Unscented Tracker）的多目标跟踪框架，并引入基于转向-形变耦合一致性（FTDC）的轨迹关联策略。在自建数据集上，检测器将AP50:95从0.837提升至0.851；相同检测输入下，SU-T+FTDC实现88.3% MOTA、77.4% IDF1和62.8% HOTA，ID switches由66降至60，轨迹碎片化由86降至78。结果表明该框架可有效提升养殖鱼类定位与身份连续性，为后续运动与行为分析提供轨迹基础。

papers.title: Special issue in the journal “Nature Conservation” (Pensoft): biology and conservation of wetland fishes in Europe
papers.authors: Wanzenböck, Josef; Šmejkal, Marek; Kalous, Lukáš; Klefoth, Thomas; Geist, Juergen; Takács, Péter
papers.abstract: N.a.
papers.summary_cn: 本期特刊聚焦欧洲湿地鱼类的生物学与保护研究，涵盖其生态习性、种群现状及保护策略。

papers.title: Remote shores: Shellfish gathering in the Kodiak Archipelago, Gulf of Alaska
papers.authors: Buckley, Jessica; West, Catherine F.
papers.journal: Journal of Island and Coastal Archaeology
papers.summary_cn: 基于标题推测，该研究关注阿拉斯加湾Kodiak群岛的贝类采集活动，可能涉及采集物种组成、时空分布或管理政策。因无摘要，具体方法与发现无法确认。

papers.title: Design, Modeling, and Experimental Evaluation of a Bistable Shape Memory Alloy—Actuated Biomimetic Robotic Fish for Low-Noise Underwater Propulsion
papers.authors: Prakash, Amal; Harilal, Arunav; Chandran Jayachandran, Amal; Tawk, Charbel; Shankar, Karthik Venkitaraman; Subbaiah, Arunkumar
papers.abstract: This work presents the design, modeling, and experimental evaluation of a biomimetic robotic fish actuated by shape memory alloy (SMA) wires integrated with a bistable polyethylene terephthalate glycol (PETG) caudal mechanism. Inspired by the general morphology and sub-carangiform-type swimming motion of Atlantic salmon, the robot employs a bistable elastic structure and a flexible caudal fin to convert SMA contraction into bidirectional tail motion through snap-through deformation. The kinematics, dynamics, and hydrodynamic characteristics of the robotic fish were investigated to evaluate the feasibility of mechanically amplifying the relatively slow SMA actuation into larger-amplitude tail motion. Water-tank experiments were conducted using a tethered prototype with a body length of 280 mm. Over 20 trials, the robot traveled 0.42 m with an average travel time of 39 s, corresponding to an average forward speed of 0.0108 m/s (0.038 BL/s), while the best observed trial required 31 s, corresponding to 0.0135 m/s (0.048 BL/s). The bistable mechanism produced approximately ±30° tail deflection, with a peak-to-peak oscillation frequency of approximately 1 Hz under the selected actuation condition. The measured acoustic output was approximately 45 dBA for the SMA-based system compared with 68 dBA for the motor-driven system, indicating a substantially lower measured acoustic output under the present experimental configuration. The swimming experiments also resulted in a high Strouhal number, primarily associated with the low forward speed and tether-induced drag. Overall, the results demonstrate the functional operation of bistable SMA-based actuation for compact robotic-fish propulsion and highlight its potential for reduced actuator-associated acoustic output. Further optimization of the SMA thermal response, bistable mechanism, tail kinematics, and untethered configuration is required to improve swimming performance and enable more complete evaluation of the propulsion system.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究设计并评估了一种由形状记忆合金（SMA）丝驱动、结合双稳态PETG尾鳍机构的仿生机器鱼，灵感来源于大西洋鲑的亚鲹科游泳模式，旨在实现低噪声水下推进。通过运动学、动力学及水动力学建模，并开展水槽拖缆样机实验（体长280 mm），验证了双稳态结构可将SMA收缩经snap-through变形转化为双向尾部摆动，产生约±30°尾摆幅和约1 Hz摆动频率。20次试验中平均前进速度为0.0108 m/s（0.038 BL/s），SMA驱动系统噪声约45 dBA，显著低于电机驱动系统的68 dBA，表明该双稳态SMA驱动方案在紧凑型机器鱼低噪声推进方面具有潜力，但游泳性能仍需通过优化SMA热响应、双稳态机构及无缆化设计进一步提升。

papers.title: Fault-tolerant control of bionic robotic fish based on a hybrid Bayesian-Northern Goshawk Optimization framework
papers.authors: Pan, Sida; Wang, Ming; Wang, Xinqi; Liu, Xinyang; Sun, Haifeng
papers.journal: Transactions of the Institute of Measurement and Control
papers.abstract: When bionic robotic fish operate in complex environments, central pattern generator units are prone to lock-up faults, which can severely degrade locomotion controllability. To address these issues, this study proposes a bio-inspired fault-tolerant proportional–integral–derivative control framework for bionic robotic fish by integrating the Northern Goshawk Optimization algorithm with Bayesian Optimization. First, a Luenberger observer is constructed to enable online state estimation and fault inference. By augmenting the yaw dynamics with an equivalent disturbance term and monitoring its estimate against a decision threshold, it provides a real-time basis for fault-tolerant control decisions. Second, the Northern Goshawk Optimization algorithm is adopted for preliminary adaptive tuning. This algorithm can rapidly explore proportional–integral–derivative parameters over a wide range, enabling preliminary adaptation to model changes caused by faults. Third, an online optimization strategy is designed based on the Northern Goshawk Optimization-Bayesian Optimization Framework. The Bayesian Optimization algorithm is employed for sample-efficient local refinement, thereby achieving accurate compensation and robust tuning of proportional–integral–derivative parameters under fault awareness and effectively regulating the central pattern generator output. Finally, through simulation and experimental analysis, the proposed fault-tolerant control strategy demonstrates superior performance in both posture control of the bionic fish and handling central pattern generator lock-up faults, highlighting its effectiveness in complex and fault-prone underwater environments.
papers.summary_cn: 针对仿生机器鱼在复杂水下环境中CPG单元易发生锁死故障导致运动可控性下降的问题，提出了一种融合Northern Goshawk Optimization与Bayesian Optimization的仿生容错PID控制框架。该方法通过Luenberger观测器实现状态估计与故障推断，利用Northern Goshawk Optimization进行PID参数全局预调，再借助Bayesian Optimization实现样本高效的局部精细补偿。仿真与实验表明，该策略在仿生鱼姿态控制及CPG锁死故障处理方面均表现优越，适用于复杂故障多发的水下环境。

papers.title: Understanding spatial heterogeneity of rocky reef demersal fish assemblages: Links to conservation plans in the Juan Fernández Archipelago Marine Protected Area in the Southeastern Pacific
papers.authors: Tapia, Braulio; Ernst, Billy; Gauthier, Stéphane; Monnahan, Cole C.; Parada, Carolina; Rivara, Pablo; Hendrix, Noble
papers.abstract: Spatial heterogeneity linked to fish assemblages has been key to advancing conservation plans and assessing marine resources in remote ecosystems. The Juan Fernández Archipelago is a remote and highly heterogeneous geologic hotspot located on the Nazca plate (SE Pacific), comprising three islands, numerous seamounts and guyots, and a highly rugged coastal marine shelf. Hundreds of rocky reefs of various sizes characterize this insular coastal shelf, supporting diverse finfish populations of interest for the Robinson Crusoe Island artisanal fishing fleet. Two hydroacoustic surveys were conducted on the insular shelf of Robinson Crusoe and Santa Clara Islands. Reef distribution and morphometric attributes (length, height, depth strata, and geographic zones) were characterized across the shelf seascape. To identify traits that correlated with the presence and acoustic backscatter of demersal fish aggregations, a set of statistical models was implemented. Results indicate that reefs were present up to ~200 meters in depth around the islands, with the northern region hosting small and tall reefs, while the southern region had the fewest reefs but the largest. The findings indicated that 75% of the fish aggregations observed outside of reefs were within 280 m of them. Also, there was a higher probability of fish aggregations occurring in depths up to 150 m (~90%) given the presence of reefs, compared to the relatively flat seafloor (~20%). Reef–scale analysis showed that the longer and taller the reef, the higher the acoustic backscatter from fish. These findings highlight the ecological value of reefs for fish populations throughout the insular shelf seascape. In addition, this study highlights the usefulness of small–scale hydroacoustic surveys as a monitoring tool to assess the association between ocean–floor spatial heterogeneity and demersal fish assemblages, and the implementation of effective periodic surveys within the Juan Fernández Marine Protected Area.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于两次水声学调查，刻画了Juan Fernández群岛（SE Pacific）Robinson Crusoe与Santa Clara岛陆架礁石的分布及形态特征（长度、高度、深度、区域），并利用统计模型分析其与底层鱼类聚集声学回散射的关联。结果显示，礁石分布可达约200 m水深，北部以小而高的礁石为主，南部礁石最少但体型最大；75%的礁外鱼类聚集出现在距礁280 m范围内，有礁石存在时150 m以浅鱼类聚集概率约90%，远高于平坦海底的约20%，且礁石越长越高，鱼类声学回散射越强。研究凸显了礁石对陆架海景中鱼类种群的生态价值，并表明小尺度水声学调查可作为评估海底空间异质性与底层鱼类聚集关系的有效监测工具，服务于该MPA的保护规划。

papers.title: Temporal patterns in species richness and occupancy in mountain-prairie transitional watersheds
papers.authors: Lothian, Angus; Kissinger, Ben; Bell, Donovan A; Post, John R.
papers.abstract: Our understanding of biodiversity loss and change in many regions, especially riverine headwaters, remains limited. Using multi-species occupancy models, we investigate the temporal trends in species richness, species turnover and occupancy probability across the mountain-prairie transitional watersheds of several major Canadian rivers in southern Alberta, Canada, over a 25-year period (1996-2020; years binned into 5-year periods). Forty-five species were identified in 12,863 backpack electrofishing surveys across 382 unique watersheds. Jaccard’s similarity index showed an overall similarity of 0.87 across the 25 years (a change of five species). Of the 45 species observed, 39 of those were observed in multiple time periods. The trend in occupancy probability showed 9 species increasing in occupancy probability and 12 declining. The largest declines in occupancy probability were observed for cold water fishes, with Arctic grayling, longnose sucker and mountain whitefish showing the largest declines. Optimal temperature for species occupancy ranged from 5 °C to 18 °C. Where conservation recovery action has targeted specific species, such as bull trout and westslope cutthroat trout, positive trends in occupancy probability are observed.
papers.summary_cn: 基于25年（1996–2020）多物种 occupancy 模型，分析了加拿大阿尔伯塔省南部山地-草原过渡流域鱼类的物种丰富度、周转率与占有概率的时间趋势。45个物种中，9种占有概率上升、12种下降，冷水鱼类（Arctic grayling、longnose sucker、mountain whitefish）下降最为显著。针对 bull trout 和 westslope cutthroat trout 的保护恢复行动显示出占有概率的积极趋势。

papers.title: Seasonal dynamics of fish diversity and assemblage composition in temporary pools of a protected Atlantic Forest area
papers.authors: de Souza, Gabriel Gonçalves; Selinger, Amanda; Mosna, Esli Emanoel Domingues; Langeani, Francisco; Domingues, Rodrigo Rodrigues; da Costa, João Henrique Alliprandini
papers.abstract: Abstract The Atlantic Forest is one of the top five biodiversity hotspots on the planet and is considered a global priority for conservation, largely due to extensive human‐driven deforestation. Temporary pools in the Atlantic Forest harbour unique and vulnerable fish assemblages, yet remain poorly studied, particularly within protected areas. In this study, we assessed fish diversity, composition and environmental drivers in 34 temporary pools sampled across dry and wet hydrological periods in the Serra do Mar State Park, southeastern Brazil. A total of 574 individuals representing eight species were recorded, indicating low regional richness, with estimates not exceeding 10 species. Fish abundance, richness, effective number of species, Margalef's K and species composition did not differ between periods. Habitat availability and isolation influenced fish abundance only during the dry period, reflecting contrasting ecological strategies of dominant species. In the wet period, the assemblage structure showed no association with environmental predictors, suggesting a stronger influence of stochastic processes driven by unpredictable flood dynamics. Shrimp abundance had no detectable effect on fish assemblage metrics. Our results indicate that temporary pools are shaped by a combination of historical environmental filtering acting on the regional species pool and contemporary stochastic processes. These findings highlight the ecological dynamics of temporary aquatic habitats, often overlooked in conservation planning, and also reinforce the role of protected Atlantic Forest areas as microclimatic refugia in a rapidly changing world.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究评估了巴西东南部Serra do Mar州立公园34个临时性水塘在大西洋森林保护区内旱季与雨季的鱼类多样性、群落组成及其环境驱动因子。共记录鱼类574尾、8种，区域物种丰富度较低（估计不超过10种），且丰度、丰富度、有效物种数、Margalef's K及物种组成在两个水文时期之间无显著差异。生境可用性和隔离度仅在旱季影响鱼类丰度，而雨季群落结构与环境预测因子无关联，提示随机过程（不可预测的洪水动态）的主导作用。结果表明，临时性水塘鱼类群落受历史环境过滤与当代随机过程的共同塑造，凸显了此类常被保护规划忽视的生境在变化环境中的生态意义。

papers.title: Sea surface temperature and cold-water treatment shape post-release recapture of red snow crab Chionoecetes japonicus in the Sea of Japan: a tagging study
papers.authors: Maegawa, Ryunosuke; Yamashita, Fujio; Yamamoto, Takeo; Kodama, Koji; Motobayashi, Hirohito
papers.summary_cn: 本研究通过标志放流实验，探究了日本海红雪蟹（Chionoecetes japonicus）放流后重捕率与海表温度及冷水处理的关系。结果显示，海表温度和放流前的冷水处理共同影响其放流后的重捕情况。

papers.title: Landscape transcriptomics reveals ecological constraints on fish under anthropogenic coastal change
papers.authors: Gairin, Emma; Miura, Saori; Chamot, Zoé; Sautereau, Camille A.; Zwahlen, Jann; Takamiyagi, Hiroki; Gibert, Yann; Herrera, Marcela; Laudet, Vincent
papers.abstract: Abstract Urban zones are rapidly expanding worldwide, exposing organisms to complex and multidimensional stressors. However, linking organismal responses to environmental change at ecologically relevant scales remains a major challenge. To investigate the constraints imposed on fish living in coastal urban environments, we apply a landscape-scale framework to identify molecular signatures associated with human activities. Using transcriptomes from a common coral reef fish, Chrysiptera cyanea , sampled across 18 coastal sites in Okinawa, Japan, we implement scalable analytical and visualisation tools and identify coordinated shifts in metabolic, immune, and inflammatory pathways. By integrating field data with a fasting-feeding experiment, we find that transcriptomes of adult fish from urbanised sites resemble those of well-fed experimental fish, suggesting that these areas provide an energy-rich diet while imposing chronic stress. Our findings reveal how anthropogenic activities reshape organismal resilience and demonstrate the power of landscape transcriptomics as a link between molecular signatures and ecological outcomes across changing environments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以日本冲绳18个沿海样点的珊瑚礁鱼类 Chrysiptera cyanea 为对象，采用 landscape transcriptomics 方法，结合野外采样与禁食-投喂实验，解析沿海城市化对鱼类分子响应的影响。结果显示，城市化样点成鱼的转录组特征与实验饱食组相似，代谢、免疫和炎症通路发生协同变化，提示城市海域虽提供高能量食物，但同时造成慢性胁迫。研究表明，landscape transcriptomics 可有效连接分子特征与生态结果，揭示人为活动对鱼类适应力的重塑机制。

papers.title: Chromatin interaction landscape of epimorphic regeneration in teleost fish
papers.authors: Jia, Xiaohui; Zhang, Xianglei; Lin, Weifeng; Ren, Tengfei; Liu, Shiqi; Lou, Yufei; Wang, Wei
papers.abstract: Reorganization of chromatin architecture—including chromatin loops, topologically associating domains (TADs), and A/B compartments—has been increasingly linked to development and cell differentiation. However, how chromatin architecture reorganizes during the shift from homeostasis to regeneration remains poorly characterized. Here, we used zebrafish fin regeneration as a model to systematically investigate, via micro-C, the chromatin architecture associated with blastema formation. Our analyses unveiled that the alteration of chromatin looping upon amputation was dominant compared with that of TADs and compartments. Genes directly linked to injury-altered loop interactions, including essential regeneration regulators, were mainly related to morphogenesis and cell division. A side-by-side comparison between zebrafish and African killifish uncovered conserved and species-specific chromatin reorganization following injury. Notably, perturbing injury-altered loop interactions at the il11a locus suppressed its expression and impaired fin regeneration efficiency. Further, CTCF/CTCFL and Atf7 binding motifs were the top shared motifs enriched in regeneration-altered loop anchors. Our study uncovers the landscape of chromatin interactions during fin regeneration.
papers.summary_cn: 以斑马鱼尾鳍再生为模型，利用micro-C系统解析了再生过程中染色质三维结构（chromatin loops、TADs、A/B compartments）的重组特征。研究发现，断肢后染色质环（loops）的改变较TADs和compartments更为显著，且与损伤相关的loop互作基因主要富集于形态发生和细胞分裂过程。斑马鱼与非洲鳉鱼的比较揭示了损伤后保守及物种特异的染色质重组，干扰il11a位点损伤改变的loop互作可抑制其表达并削弱再生效率。CTCF/CTCFL和Atf7结合基序为再生改变的loop锚点中最富集的共享基序。

papers.title: Establishment and Characterization of a Spermatogonial Stem Cell-like Line with Potential for Meiotic Differentiation in the Endangered Fish Rhinogobio nasutus
papers.authors: Wang, Yue; Liu, Yanbin; Jawad, Muhammad; Xu, Haijing; Wu, Qinjun; Gui, Lang; Hong, Ni; Lian, Zongqiang; Li, Mingyou
papers.abstract: Rhinogobio nasutus, a freshwater fish belonging to the family Cyprinidae, is primarily distributed in the upper and middle reaches of the Yellow River. However, overfishing and habitat degradation have resulted in a marked decline in its wild populations, and the species was listed as a Class II nationally protected aquatic wildlife species in China in 2021. Spermatogonial stem cells (SSCs) provide a valuable resource for fish germplasm conservation and reproductive biotechnology. In this study, we successfully established a long-term cultured germ-cell population with spermatogonial stem cell-like characteristics derived from R. nasutus (RnSSCs). These cells exhibited a morphology consistent with an undifferentiated spermatogonial phenotype and showed a diploid chromosome number of 2n = 50. Alkaline phosphatase (AP) staining showed strong positive activity, while RT-PCR detected the expression of germ-cell- and stem-cell-associated markers, with only weak expression of the somatic-cell-associated marker. Immunofluorescence staining revealed strong signals for both proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) and the germ cell-specific protein Vasa. After more than four months of in vitro culture, the cells continued to proliferate and retained expression of germ-cell- and stem-cell-associated markers. Following transplantation into zebrafish blastulae, fluorescently labelled cells were detected in the gonadal region of a small number of recipient embryos. Following hormonal induction, some cells developed a sperm-like morphology, accompanied by the expression of the meiotic-associated markers rec8 and dmc1. The establishment of the RnSSC line provides a renewable cellular resource for studying spermatogenesis and germ cell transplantation in R. nasutus. These findings provide a useful cellular resource for studying the reproductive biology of R. nasutus.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究建立了濒危鱼类 Rhinogobio nasutus 的精原干细胞样细胞系（RnSSCs），细胞呈未分化精原细胞表型，染色体数 2n=50，表达 AP、Vasa、PCNA 及生殖细胞/干细胞相关标记。移植至斑马鱼囊胚后可在性腺区检出，激素诱导下出现精子样形态并表达减数分裂标记 rec8 和 dmc1。该细胞系为 R. nasutus 的精子发生研究、生殖细胞移植及种质资源保护提供了可再生细胞资源。

papers.title: Early marine migration of Atlantic salmon kelts, wild smolts and hatchery smolts
papers.authors: Kennedy, R. J.; Del Villar‐Guerra, D.; Allen, M.; Bolland, J. D.
papers.abstract: Abstract This study used acoustic tags in conjunction with an extensive offshore marine receiver array to compare the migration speed, directionality and overall detection rate (as a proxy for survival) between three distinct batches of Salmo salar (kelts, wild smolts and hatchery smolts) from the same river, the river Bush in Northern Ireland, tagged during spring 2021. Minimum survival rates through the river were higher for kelts (>95%) and wild smolts (84%) than for hatchery smolts (50%), while all three groups exhibited relatively high early marine survival (71%, 58% and 60%, respectively). Marine ground speed was significantly higher for kelts (>52 km day −1 ) than for wild (>25 km day −1 ) and hatchery (>31 km day −1 ) smolts. The initial marine trajectory was similar between all three groups, with a mean bearing of 318° for kelts, 311° for wild smolts and 309° for hatchery smolts. Similarities between fish origins (wild and hatchery) and life stages (smolts and kelts) were suggestive of common drivers influencing early marine migration.
papers.summary_cn: 利用声学标签与近海接收阵列，比较了北爱尔兰Bush河大西洋鲑（Salmo salar）的kelts、野生smolts和孵化场smolts三组个体在2021年春季的早期海洋迁移速度、方向性及检测率（作为存活率代理）。河流段最低存活率以kelts（>95%）和野生smolts（84%）高于孵化场smolts（50%），但三组早期海洋存活率均较高（分别为71%、58%和60%）。kelts海洋迁移速度（>52 km/d）显著高于野生（>25 km/d）和孵化场smolts（>31 km/d），而初始海洋迁移方向三组相似（平均方位角309°–318°），提示野生与孵化场来源及smolts与kelts生活史阶段间存在共同的早期海洋迁移驱动因素。

papers.title: Recent Anomalously Warm Ocean Conditions and Changes in the Migration and Spawning Distribution of Chub Mackerel ( Scomber japonicus ) in the Western North Pacific
papers.authors: Ito, Daiki; Kamimura, Yasuhiro; Furuichi, Sho; Yukami, Ryuji; Watai, Mikio; Yasuda, Tohya; Ambe, Daisuke
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Extreme ocean warming has become increasingly pronounced in the western North Pacific in recent years. Coincident with this, both the egg abundance and the catch per unit effort (CPUE) of chub mackerel ( Scomber japonicus ) in fisheries targeting southward‐migrating adults have decreased. In this study, we examined recent variations in major ocean currents such as the Kuroshio, the Kuroshio Extension (KE), and the Oyashio, together with regional warming conditions characterized by marine heatwave metrics derived from satellite observations. We then investigated their impacts on the changes in migration patterns and spawning distribution of chub mackerel using egg and larval/juvenile sampling and logbook. Warmer conditions off eastern Japan (EJ) were associated with lower CPUE in this region and lower egg abundance in the traditional spawning grounds. In addition, particle‐tracking experiments based on juvenile samples suggested the spawning distribution outside the region traditionally recognized as the main spawning grounds during periods of northward meander of the KE off EJ. These candidate spawning grounds were located within favorable temperature ranges along the periphery of the KE and an anticyclonic eddy and were also consistent with the offshore egg occurrences observed by egg surveys in this region. These results suggest that recent anomalously warm ocean conditions off EJ may influence the southward migration and spawning distribution of adult chub mackerel.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于卫星观测的海洋热浪指标、海流数据及卵仔鱼采样与渔捞日志，分析了西北太平洋黑潮、黑潮延伸体（KE）和亲潮变动对日本鲭（Scomber japonicus）洄游与产卵分布的影响。结果显示，日本东部海域（EJ）异常偏暖与南下成鱼CPUE下降及传统产卵场卵丰度降低相关；基于幼鱼样本的粒子追踪实验表明，KE在EJ海域北向蛇行期间，产卵场可扩展至传统产卵场之外的KE边缘及反气旋涡附近适宜温度区。研究提示近期异常暖海洋条件可能改变了日本鲭成鱼的南下洄游与产卵分布。

papers.title: Thermal and chlorophyll fronts along the west coast of India and their relationship with marine fisheries
papers.authors: George, Grinson; Babu, Ananth C.; Akash, S; Shah, Phiros; Shafeeque, Muhammad; Padua, Shelton; Ranith, R; Joseph, Ajith K.; Menon, Nandini N.; Inwati, Lalima
papers.summary_cn: 研究印度西海岸热锋与叶绿素锋的时空分布特征，并探讨其与海洋渔业的关系。摘要缺失，具体方法、数据及结论无法概述。

papers.title: A Triple Bottom Line Assessment of Ecological, Social and Economic Sustainability of Red Sea Fisheries
papers.authors: Sarhan, Mahmoud; Tawfik, Rady; Hamed, Yousria; Alzahrani, Fahad
papers.abstract: This study applies a Triple Bottom Line (TBL) framework to assess ecological, social, and economic dimensions of the fisheries in Hurghada, Egypt, using spatial habitat mapping and official statistics. Time-series ecological analysis of stock-status data confirms monotonic deterioration across all exploitation categories, with the developing stock proportion declining at −1.04 percentage points per year (CSS) and −1.39 (NSS). Quantitative survey analysis documents that 80% of Hurghada fishing households derive less than 25% of income from fishing, with mean operational costs of USD 454 per trip. Socio-economic analysis shows that Hurghada’s 343-vessel fleet supports approximately 1720 registered fishers, of whom 69% report deteriorating stock conditions. Economic analysis shows that the direct-use value of the fisheries is estimated at USD 26.51 million with multiplier effects; the net present value of fisheries benefits over 2025–2050 ranges from USD 375 million to USD 679 million. These findings indicate that co-management interventions, including effort reduction, stronger enforcement against illegal fishing, expanded habitat protection, and integration of fisher knowledge into governance offer the most credible literature-supported pathway toward long-term fisheries sustainability.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究运用三重底线（TBL）框架，结合空间栖息地制图与官方统计数据，评估埃及Hurghada渔业的生态、社会与经济可持续性。生态时间序列分析显示各开发类别种群状态持续恶化，发展中种群比例分别以每年−1.04（CSS）和−1.39（NSS）个百分点下降。社会经济调查表明80%渔民家庭渔业收入占比不足25%，单次作业平均成本454美元，343艘渔船支撑约1720名注册渔民，其中69%反映资源状况恶化；渔业直接使用价值约2651万美元，2025–2050年净现值介于3.75亿至6.79亿美元。研究认为共同管理干预（包括削减捕捞努力量、强化非法捕捞执法、扩大栖息地保护及纳入渔民知识）是文献支持的最可行可持续路径。

papers.title: Socioeconomic Impacts of Coastal Reclamation Activities on the Fisheries Community in Penang, Peninsular Malaysia
papers.authors: Jasni, Soleha; Mahamud, Mohd Amirul; Ramli, Muhammad Wafiy Adli; Mohd Shafie, Siti Haslina; Abu Bakar, Mohd Azmeer
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以马来西亚槟城沿海填海活动为对象，探讨其对渔业社区的社会经济影响。基于标题，该研究关注填海工程对当地渔民生计、收入及社区结构的冲击。

papers.title: Beyond historical catch: developing a climate-adaptive fisheries allocation framework for transboundary fish stocks under international law
papers.authors: Akkuş, Berkant
papers.abstract: Climate change is rapidly altering the geographical distribution of transboundary fish stocks, challenging the legal and institutional assumptions upon which international fisheries governance has traditionally been based. Existing allocation systems, largely founded on historical catch records and relatively stable stock distributions, are becoming increasingly inconsistent with ecological realities, generating disputes among coastal States and undermining the effectiveness of Regional Fisheries Management Organisations (RFMOs). This article examines whether the existing framework of international fisheries law is capable of accommodating climate-driven redistributions of fish stocks and facilitating more adaptive allocation mechanisms. Employing a doctrinal legal methodology, supported by a comparative analysis of selected RFMO practices, the study analyses the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), the 1995 United Nations Fish Stocks Agreement (UNFSA), relevant FAO instruments, and selected soft-law frameworks. It argues that the existing legal regime already contains sufficient normative foundations—including cooperation, sustainability, the precautionary principle, ecosystem-based management, equity, and climate justice—to support adaptive fisheries governance. However, institutional rigidity, consensus-based decision-making, and continued reliance on historical allocation principles significantly hinder effective adaptation. Drawing upon case studies including the Northeast Atlantic mackerel dispute, Pacific tuna governance, CCAMLR, and emerging Arctic fisheries governance, the article demonstrates the limitations of current allocation practices under changing climatic conditions. As its principal contribution, the article proposes a Climate-Adaptive Fisheries Allocation Framework (CAFAF), operationalised through a Climate-Adaptive Allocation Index (CAAI), which integrates contemporary stock distribution, historical participation, ecosystem sustainability, climate vulnerability, food security, and equitable allocation into fisheries decision-making. The proposed framework offers a legally grounded and institutionally feasible pathway for enhancing the resilience, legitimacy, and long-term sustainability of international fisheries governance in an era of accelerating climate change.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在评估现有国际渔业法框架能否应对气候变化导致的跨界鱼类种群分布变迁，并推动更具适应性的 allocation 机制。采用法理分析方法，结合 RFMO 实践比较，系统分析了 UNCLOS、UNFSA、FAO 相关文书及软法框架。研究认为现行法律体系已具备合作、可持续性、precautionary principle、生态系统管理等规范基础，但制度刚性、共识决策及对历史捕捞原则的依赖严重制约适应能力。文章提出 Climate-Adaptive Fisheries Allocation Framework (CAFAF) 及配套 Climate-Adaptive Allocation Index (CAAI)，将当前种群分布、历史参与、生态系统可持续性、气候脆弱性、粮食安全与公平分配纳入决策。

papers.title: How does climate risk affect fisheries? New evidence from the operating cash flows of Chinese listed firms
papers.authors: Zou, Qinqin; Lin, Shixuan; Wu, Yujing; Yang, Lei
papers.abstract: Listed fisheries companies depend heavily on natural conditions, leaving their operations particularly exposed to climate change. Using Chinese listed fisheries companies as the research sample, this study examines the effect of regional climate risk on operating cash flow and investigates potential mitigating mechanisms. The results show that regional climate risk significantly reduces operating cash flow. Further analysis indicates that extreme heat, cold, rainfall, and drought all weaken corporate cash flow, demonstrating the multidimensional nature of climate exposure in fisheries. Government subsidies and stronger internal governance mitigate these adverse effects and therefore serve as important buffers against climate shocks. By documenting the cash-flow consequences of climate risk, this study provides new firm-level evidence on how environmental shocks affect fisheries operations and offers practical implications for strengthening climate resilience in the sector.
papers.summary_cn: 以中国上市渔业企业为样本，研究了区域气候风险对经营现金流的影响及缓解机制。结果表明，区域气候风险显著降低经营现金流，极端高温、严寒、强降雨和干旱均削弱企业现金流，体现气候暴露的多维性。政府补贴和更强的内部治理可缓解上述负面影响，为增强渔业气候韧性提供了企业层面的证据。

papers.title: Editorial: Ecocentric fisheries management in European Seas, volume II: e-tools, management scenarios, and capacity building to support decision making in fisheries and ecosystems
papers.authors: Gal, Gideon; Briguglio, Marie; Scarcella, Giuseppe; Heymans, Johanna J.; Steenbeek, Jeroen; Tsikliras, Athanassios C.
papers.summary_cn: 该社论属于“欧洲海域生态中心型渔业管理”系列第二卷，聚焦电子工具、管理情景与能力建设，以支持渔业及生态系统决策。因无摘要，仅据标题可知其旨在推动以生态系统为中心的渔业管理决策支持手段的发展与应用。

papers.title: Evaluation of Multi Type Mineral Mixture Additive in Fish Feed and Its Efficacy Thereof Under Varied Agro-climatic Conditions of Punjab, India
papers.authors: Kaur, Rajinder; Singh, Gulgul; Sahil, Sahil; Singh, Prabjeet
papers.abstract: Mineral nutrition plays an important role in supporting fish growth, feed utilisation, health, and flesh quality in aquaculture. However, the comparative effectiveness of fish-specific and livestock mineral mixtures in carp feed under different agro-climatic conditions of Punjab has not been adequately evaluated. Therefore, this study assessed the effects of these mineral supplements on growth performance, production, flesh composition, and economic returns in pond-based carp culture. A 120-day field experiment was conducted at nine pond sites across Mohali/SAS Nagar, Tarn Taran, and Barnala districts of Punjab to evaluate the efficacy of mineral-mixture supplementation in carp feed under varied agro-climatic conditions. Three dietary treatments were assessed: the farmers’ control diet (T1), the control diet supplemented with 1.5 per cent fish-specific mineral mixture (T2), and the control diet supplemented with 1.5 per cent livestock mineral mixture (T3). Growth performance, feed utilisation, water quality, fish production, flesh proximate composition, and economic returns were evaluated. Water-quality variables remained within the reported suitable range for carp culture. Mineral-supplemented treatments showed improved growth and feed-use performance compared with the control, with T2 recording the highest average length gain (11.00±0.38 cm), net weight gain (376.00±16.41 g), and total production (23.1567±2.76 quintals per acre), together with the lowest feed conversion ratio (1.51±1.43). Proximate analysis showed the highest protein content (35.50±0.62%) and ash content (14.56±0.40%) in T2, while moisture and fat contents did not differ significantly among treatments. T2 also recorded the highest total return and net profit. Within the conditions of this trial, supplementation with a 1.5 per cent fish-specific mineral mixture was associated with improved carp growth, production, flesh composition, and farm-level economic performance compared with the control and livestock-mineral-mixture treatments.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究在印度旁遮普邦三种农业气候条件下的九个池塘开展120天田间试验，比较对照饲料（T1）、添加1.5%鱼类专用矿物混合物的饲料（T2）及添加1.5%畜禽矿物混合物的饲料（T3）对鲤鱼生长、饲料利用、鱼肉成分及经济效益的影响。结果表明，T2组平均增重（376.00±16.41 g）、总产量（23.1567±2.76 quintals/acre）及饲料转化率（1.51±1.43）均最优，鱼肉蛋白（35.50±0.62%）和灰分（14.56±0.40%）含量最高，总收益与净利润亦最高。添加1.5%鱼类专用矿物混合物可显著改善鲤鱼生长、产量、鱼肉品质及养殖经济效益。

papers.title: First occurrence of a parasitic isopod, Braga nasuta (Schioedte & Meinert, 1881) on ornamental fish in Europe
papers.authors: Hoitsy, Márton; Gál, János; Sós, Endre; Nagy, Antal; Hornok, Sándor; Takács, Nóra; Keve, Gergő
papers.abstract: Abstract Isopods of the genus Braga (Cymothoidae) are haematophagous parasites of neotropical fish, causing anaemia, tissue damage and mortality. Braga nasuta , endemic to Brazil, has been reported from various hosts, including ornamental species exported worldwide. During a routine examination of imported cardinal tetra ( Paracheirodon axelrodi , Schultz, 1956), the authors detected a fish harbouring an adult male isopod (6.21 mm long, 2.66 mm wide) attached anterior to the dorsal fin. Based on morphological identification, the parasite was B. nasuta . No secondary pathogens were observed in the affected fish specimen. Given the global trade in ornamental species, the introduction of B. nasuta into non-native regions underscores the importance of quarantine and parasite monitoring. Phylogenetic analysis has revealed that B. nasuta is most closely related to other freshwater parasitic isopods. While the potential ability of this parasite to establish populations in Europe requires further studies, vigilance is warranted to prevent potential spread and ecological damage.
papers.summary_cn: 首次在欧洲进口观赏鱼（红绿灯鱼 Paracheirodon axelrodi）体上检出寄生等足类 Braga nasuta（Cymothoidae），该虫为巴西特有种，吸血寄生可致贫血、组织损伤及死亡。研究基于形态学鉴定确认虫种，并指出观赏鱼全球贸易增加了该寄生虫传入非原生区域的风险，系统发育分析显示其与淡水寄生等足类亲缘最近。作者强调需加强检疫与寄生虫监测，以防范其潜在定殖与生态危害。

papers.authors: Wangchen; Daoruang, Krisada

papers.title: Intra-annual dynamics of larval fish assemblages and their environmental associations in the central Southern Black Sea
papers.authors: UYGUN, ORÇIN
papers.abstract: Larval fish assemblages are crucial indicators for monitoring marine ecosystem dynamics and the recruitment potential of fishery stocks. This study investigates the spatiotemporal dynamics of larval fish assemblages in the central Southern Black Sea (Sinop) and the environmental parameters shaping these patterns. An intra-annual monthly sampling survey identified 35 species across 20 families; the assemblage structure was dominated by Engraulis encrasicolus, Gobius niger, Sprattus sprattus, Mullus barbatus and Trachurus mediterraneus. Multivariate analyses revealed a clear temporal structuring of larval fish assemblages due to intra-annual variation. However, no significant spatial separation was observed among the stations. Distance-based Linear Models (DistLM) indicated that assemblage variability was primarily associated with salinity, chlorophyll a and temperature, as well as light transmission and current velocity. Species-specific responses of dominant taxa to environmental variables were examined using Generalized Additive Models (GAMs), revealing distinct environmental partitioning among species. Model results indicated that E. encrasicolus abundance was primarily associated with chlorophyll a and low salinity gradients, whereas G. niger exhibited a response to multiple variables, including low salinity, low light transmission, and a wide thermal range. Conversely, the distribution of S. sprattus was strictly limited by low temperatures and specific ranges of light transmission. These findings suggest that larval fish assemblages in the Southern Black Sea are structured by a complex combination of physical forcing (such as mesoscale hydrological features) and biological interactions, in which differentiated environmental responses facilitate species coexistence.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于黑海南部中部（Sinop）为期一年的月度采样，调查了仔稚鱼群落的时空动态及其环境关联，共记录20科35种，优势种为 *Engraulis encrasicolus*、*Gobius niger*、*Sprattus sprattus* 等。多元分析显示群落结构呈显著时间分异而无明显空间分异，DistLM表明盐度、叶绿素a和温度是群落变异的主要关联因子。GAM分析揭示优势种间存在明显的环境生态位分化，如 *E. encrasicolus* 主要关联叶绿素a和低盐，*S. sprattus* 则严格受限于低温和特定透光范围，表明物理强迫与物种差异化环境响应共同促进了群落物种共存。

papers.title: Spatial variation shapes gut microbiome composition and functional potential in an Afrotropical fish
papers.authors: Atofarati, Olabisi Tawakalt; Oladipo, Segun Olayinka; Nneji, Ifeanyi Christopher; Adelakun, Kehinde Moruf; Asiamah, Maame Kobe; Everett, Amaya; Nneji, Lotanna Micah
papers.abstract: Abstract Host-associated microbiomes are shaped by environmental heterogeneity across spatial gradients. However, the extent to which site-level variation structures gut microbial communities in Afrotropical fishes remains poorly resolved. In this study, we employed high-throughput 16S rRNA gene sequencing to characterize the gut microbiome of the African forktail catfish ( Chrysichthys nigrodigitatus ) encompassing two contrasting habitat types, with the aim of assessing spatial patterns in microbial composition and predicted functional potential. Across all sites, gut microbial communities were dominated by Firmicutes, Proteobacteria, Bacteroidota, and Fusobacteriota, with a conserved core microbiome shared among populations. Alpha diversity metrics (Observed richness, Shannon, Simpson, and Chao1 indices) did not differ significantly among sites, indicating comparable levels of microbial richness and evenness. In contrast, beta diversity analysis based on Bray–Curtis dissimilarity revealed pronounced site-specific structuring and clear differentiation between habitat types. Differential abundance and indicator taxa analyses identified distinct bacterial assemblages associated with specific habitats, reflecting localized environmental influences. Functional predictions indicated enrichment of pathways related to xenobiotic degradation, oxidative stress response, and aromatic compound metabolism in lagoon habitat. The concordance between taxonomic composition and predicted functional profiles underscores the role of site variation in shaping gut microbiome structure. Collectively, these findings demonstrate that spatial variation is a key determinant of gut microbiome composition and predicted functional capacity in this widely distributed Afrotropical fish species, providing new insights into host-microbiome-environment interactions in tropical aquatic systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以非洲叉尾鲶（*Chrysichthys nigrodigitatus*）为对象，采用高通量16S rRNA基因测序，比较两种对比栖息地类型下肠道微生物组的组成与预测功能潜力，以评估空间变异对微生物群落结构的塑造作用。结果显示，尽管各站点间alpha多样性无显著差异且存在保守的核心微生物组，但基于Bray–Curtis距离的beta多样性分析揭示了明显的站点特异性结构及栖息地类型间分化，差异丰度与指示类群分析识别出与特定栖息地相关的细菌类群。功能预测表明潟湖栖息地中异生物质降解、氧化应激响应及芳香化合物代谢通路富集，表明空间变异是该广布性非洲热带鱼类肠道微生物组组成与功能潜力的关键决定因素。

papers.title: Nutritional Quality and Food Safety of Indigenous Foods: An Integrated Assessment of Dry Fish and Fermented Oil Bean Seed (Ukpaka)
papers.authors: Nwachukwu, Ujunwa Felicia; Onyia, Ikechukwu Jude
papers.journal: American Journal of Food Science and Technology
papers.abstract: Indigenous foods are widely consumed because of their nutritional importance, availability and affordability. However, some factors, including inadequate processing, handling, and storage, may compromise their nutritional quality and safety. Therefore, this study assessed the nutritional quality and food safety of dry fish and fermented oil bean seed (Ukpaka) obtained from Eke Agbani Market, Enugu State, Nigeria. The dry fish and fermented oil bean seed collected from different vendors were respectively inoculated into Nutrient Agar (NA), MacConkey Agar, Salmonella-Shigella Agar (SSA), de Man Rogosa Sharpe (MRS) agar and Sabouraud Dextrose Agar (SDA). The inoculated plates were incubated at 37°C for 24–48 h, except for SDA plates which were incubated at 28°C for 7 days. The isolates were identified using phenotypic characterization (colony appearance, Gram reaction, and biochemical properties) and molecular characterization (PCR, 16S rRNA gene sequencing and ITS sequencing). Aflatoxin analysis, and proximate composition assessment were carried out on the indigenous foods. The total viable bacterial counts were 3.2 × 10⁴ CFU/g for dry fish and 7.8 × 10⁵ CFU/g for fermented oil bean seed, while coliform counts for bot foods were 1.4 × 10³ and 3.5 × 10⁴ CFU/g, respectively. Lactic acid bacteria count in fermented oil bean seed recorded as 6.4 × 10⁵ CFU/g while none was detected in dry fish. The isolates were Staphylococcus aureus and Escherichia coli (from dry fish), Lactobacillus plantarum, (from fermented oil bean seed) and Aspergillus niger (from both food samples). Aflatoxin analysis revealed the presence of aflatoxins B₁, B₂, G₁, and G₂ in both indigenous foods with aflatoxin B₁ recording the highest concentrations of 0.178214 µg/kg and 0.52841 µg/kg in dry fish and fermented oil bean seed samples respectively. The fermented oil bean seed had a moisture content of 59.283%, protein (26.950%), fat (3.029%), crude fibre (3.117%), ash (2.089%), and carbohydrate (5.532%). The dry fish had a moisture content (11.25%), protein (58.4%), fat (0.83%), crude fibre (0.9%), ash (11.15%), and carbohydrate (18.15%).The findings demonstrate that dry fish and fermented oil bean seed are nutritional importance but may also harbor several microorganisms which may be beneficial or pathogenic and also aflatoxins. Therefore, improved hygienic handling, processing, and storage practices are essential to preserve the nutritional quality of these indigenous foods and to ensure consumers’ safety.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了尼日利亚埃努古州市场销售的干鱼和发酵油豆籽（Ukpaka）的营养品质与食品安全，通过微生物培养、PCR及16S rRNA/ITS测序鉴定菌群，并检测黄曲霉毒素和营养成分。干鱼中检出金黄色葡萄球菌和大肠杆菌，发酵油豆籽中检出植物乳杆菌，两者均含黑曲霉及黄曲霉毒素B₁、B₂、G₁、G₂（以B₁浓度最高）。干鱼蛋白质含量高达58.4%，发酵油豆籽水分含量59.283%、蛋白质26.950%。结果表明这两种本土食品营养丰富但存在微生物和mycotoxin污染风险，需改善卫生加工与储存条件以保障消费者安全。

papers.title: Financial Viability of Red Sea Urchin (Mesocentrotus franciscanus) Aquaculture: A Comprehensive Analysis of Risk, Production Costs, and Market Dynamics under Macroeconomic Scenarios
papers.authors: Soriano-Suárez-Del-Real, J. F.; Morales-Zamorano, L. A.; Correa-Reyes, J. G.; Holguín-Moreno, O.
papers.abstract: This study investigates the financial viability of red sea urchin (Mesocentrotus franciscanus) aquaculture, addressing key economic factors such as production costs (CAPEX and OPEX), larval prices, and market dynamics. Through a comprehensive literature review and the development of a dual financial model (deterministic and stochastic), critical parameters influencing profitability are identified. While a baseline deterministic model suggests an Internal Rate of Return (IRR) of 22.4%, the incorporation of stochastic variables based on historical inflation and Mexican CETES rates reveals significant vulnerability (negative NPV given a 6.14% discount rate). The results demonstrate that optimizing the larval phase and reducing initial investment (CAPEX) are crucial for mitigating macroeconomic risk. This study provides a robust risk assessment framework for investors and policymakers.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估红海胆（Mesocentrotus franciscanus）养殖的财务可行性，构建确定性与随机性双重财务模型，纳入CAPEX、OPEX、幼体价格及市场动态等关键经济参数。确定性模型显示基准IRR为22.4%，但引入历史通胀率和墨西哥CETES利率等随机变量后，在6.14%折现率下NPV转为负值，表明项目对宏观经济波动高度敏感。优化幼体培育阶段和降低初始投资（CAPEX）是缓解宏观风险的关键。

papers.title: Dietary supplementation with giant African land snail  Achatina fulica meat improving growth performance and feed efficiency in Asian Swamp Eel Monopterus albus  aquaculture
papers.authors: Tran Thi, Phuong Lan; Pham Thi, Hai Ha; Tran Thi, Hong To; Vo Thi, Tuyet Minh; Nguyen, Thanh Luan
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective This study evaluated the effects of incorporating giant African land snail Achatina fulica meat into feed formulations on the growth performance, feed efficiency, biochemical composition, hematological indices, and economic efficiency of Asian Swamp Eels Monopterus albus. Methods Eels were reared in a controlled system and assigned to diets with 0 (control), 5, 10, or 15% inclusion of dried giant African land snail meat powder (DSMP) as partial replacement for fish meal. Growth parameters, feed utilization, muscle composition, hematological profiles, and economic returns were assessed over a 90-d feeding trial. Results Eels that were fed DSMP-supplemented diets exhibited significantly higher muscle protein content, with no significant differences in moisture, ash, lipid, or energy content across groups. Among DSMP-supplemented groups, the 10% DSMP diet significantly improved daily length gain, specific growth rate, feed intake, and feed conversion ratio compared with both the 5% and 15% DSMP inclusion levels. Hematological analysis revealed elevated white blood cell, neutrophil, monocyte, and lymphocyte counts in DSMP-fed eels, particularly at the 15% inclusion level, suggesting potential modulation of immune cell populations. Conclusions Incorporating giant African land snail meat at a 10% inclusion level in feed formulations as a partial replacement for fish meal enhances growth performance, health status, and profitability in Asian Swamp Eel aquaculture. This approach offers a sustainable, cost-effective alternative protein source, reducing dependence on fish meal and contributing to the development of more resilient aquaculture systems.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了在饲料中添加非洲大蜗牛（*Achatina fulica*）肉粉（DSMP）部分替代鱼粉对黄鳝（*Monopterus albus*）生长性能、饲料效率、生化组成、血液指标及经济效益的影响。90 d投喂试验表明，10% DSMP添加水平显著提高日增体长、特定生长率、摄食量和饲料转化率，且各添加组肌肉蛋白含量显著升高；15%添加组白细胞、中性粒细胞、单核细胞和淋巴细胞数量升高，提示免疫细胞群体可能受到调控。结果表明，10%非洲大蜗牛肉粉部分替代鱼粉可提升黄鳝养殖的生长性能、健康水平和盈利能力，是一种可持续且经济的替代蛋白源。

papers.title: Sustainable shift from fishmeal to insect meal towards a new era of aquaculture: a review
papers.authors: Ismat, Nida; Hussain, Majid; Hayat, Sikandar; Kazmi, Abeer; Islam, Md. Fakhrul; Amir, Imrana; Nijabat, Aneela; Siddiqa, Ayesha; Miraidys Brito Molina, Susana; Luna-Arias, Juan Pedro
papers.journal: Journal of Insects as Food and Feed
papers.abstract: Abstract Aquaculture has gained attention as fastest-growing food production sectors globally. However, it is dependent on expensive aquatic sources such as fishmeal that raises concerns regarding sustainability of aquatic operations. Recent researches conducted by scientific community have been focused on replacement of protein ingredients. So far insect meals have been acknowledged as one of the most promising alternatives. The preferential reasons are their favorable nutritional profile and lesser environmental footprint. This review comprehensively classifies insect meals into established, emerging and underexplored protein sources for aquaculture. The review critically evaluates their nutritional properties, production potential, processing methods and applications in aquafeeds. It has been demonstrated by evidences from feeding trials that the efficacy of insect meal is extremely species-specific. Different factors including insect species, processing technique, inclusion level, overall diet formulation and the nutritional requirements of the target aquatic species influence the performance of insect meal. This alternative source has proven to be more effective without any compromise on growth performance, feed utilisation or fish health under optimised conditions. But the suitability of insect meals could not be generalised across all aquatic operations despite their significant potential as partial replacement of fishmeal. Contemporary challenges associated with nutritional variability, digestibility, large-scale production, economic practicability, regulatory frameworks and consumer acceptance have been highlighted in this review. Future studies should address standardised processing methods and long-term feeding evaluations. Optimisation of inclusion strategies and life cycle sustainability assessments will provide critical evidence for large-scale adoption of insect-derived ingredients in sustainable aquafeed formulations.
papers.summary_cn: 本综述旨在评估昆虫粉作为鱼粉替代蛋白源在水产饲料中的应用潜力，将其分为成熟、新兴及未充分开发三类，并系统评价其营养特性、生产潜力、加工方法及饲喂效果。饲喂试验表明，昆虫粉的效果具有高度物种特异性，受昆虫种类、加工工艺、添加水平、饲料配方及目标水产物种营养需求等因素影响；在优化条件下，其可在不影响生长性能、饲料利用或鱼体健康的前提下有效替代部分鱼粉。然而，营养变异性、消化率、规模化生产、经济可行性、监管框架及消费者接受度等挑战仍限制其广泛推广，未来需聚焦标准化加工工艺、长期饲喂评估及生命周期可持续性评价。
