papers.authors: Spence, Isla N.; Stuart, Courtney E.; Wedding, Lisa M.; Pittman, Simon J.; Serafy, Joseph E.; Blondeau, Jeremiah; Green, Stephanie J.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究比较了具有栖息地转换习性的掠食性与草食性礁鱼在海景利用上的空间格局。尽管两类鱼共享相似的生物物理驱动因子，但它们在空间上仍表现出明显的分区（spatial partitioning）。

papers.title: Impact of artificial stocking and its intensity on genetic diversity, genetic structure, and effective number of breeders in masu salmon Oncorhynchus masou
papers.authors: Kitanishi, Shigeru; Yamamoto, Toshiaki; Urabe, Hirokazu; Shimoda, Kazutaka
papers.abstract: Artificial stocking, an important tool in fishery resource enhancement and wildlife management, exerts negative effects on wild conspecifics. However, the factors determining the magnitude of these effects remain unclear. Here, we investigated how stocking influences genetic diversity, genetic structure, and effective number of breeders (N_b) in masu salmon Oncorhynchus masou and how these effects vary with the stocking intensity, such as the number of fish stocked and proportion of non-native fish. We examined 15 microsatellites in 1989 individuals from 33 masu salmon populations and four hatchery stocks in Hokkaido, Japan. Stocking increased the allelic richness (Ar); however, this effect decreased with increasing stocking intensity. Lower genetic differentiation (F_ST) was observed among populations affected by stocking than among native populations. N_b correlated positively with the number of fish stocked and proportion of juveniles, but negatively with the proportion of non-native fish. Overall, this study shows that the genetic impact of stocking depends on various factors, such as the origin of stocked fish and stocking intensity.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究基于日本北海道33个野生群体和4个孵化场群体共1989尾马苏大麻哈鱼（*Oncorhynchus masou*）的15个微卫星标记，分析了人工放流及其强度对遗传多样性、遗传结构和有效繁殖群体大小（N_b）的影响。结果表明，放流提高了等位基因丰富度（Ar），但该效应随放流强度增加而减弱；受放流影响群体间的遗传分化（F_ST）低于原生群体。N_b与放流数量和幼鱼比例呈正相关，与非本地鱼比例呈负相关，说明放流的遗传影响取决于放流鱼来源和放流强度等多种因素。

papers.title: Global length–weight relationships of deep‐pelagic fishes: Coverage, biases and variability
papers.authors: Martins, Júlia R.; Kurtz, Yan R.; Mincarone, Michael M.; Bertrand, Arnaud; Villarins, Bárbara T.; Lucena‐Frédou, Flávia; Frédou, Thierry; Morais, Maria F.; Eduardo, Leandro N.
papers.abstract: Abstract Length–weight relationships (LWRs) are morphometric tools that allow body mass to be estimated from fish length, providing input for fisheries, ecological and biodiversity studies. For deep‐pelagic fishes, however, LWR data remain fragmented and unavailable for most species. Here, we present a global synthesis of LWRs for deep‐pelagic fishes, consolidating available data into a single harmonised dataset and mapping taxonomic and geographic gaps. We provide the first LWR estimates for seven species and provide additional morphometric information, including extensions of previously reported size ranges and revised estimates based on freshly collected specimens for 23 species. With these additions, 427 LWRs are now available for 227 species, about 15% of recognised deep‐pelagic diversity. Coverage remains strongly biased. Small‐bodied, vertically migrating species dominate, especially within the Myctophidae, whereas resident species with stable vertical distributions, slower growth and longer lifespans are poorly represented. Geographic coverage is likewise uneven, with the North Atlantic extensively sampled, but the South Atlantic, Indian Ocean and large areas of the Pacific still severely undersampled. On average, the allometric exponent b was close to isometry (median 3.09), though most individual relationships departed significantly from it, and it was only weakly structured across taxa. Variation among families and body shapes was modest and broadly overlapping because the apparent body‐shape gradient in b largely tracked taxonomy. The dominant signal was intraspecific. Within a species, b varied almost as much as it did among species, often by more than a full unit across independent studies. Consequently, a single LWR should not be regarded as a fixed species trait. Length‐to‐mass conversion should preferentially rely on locally derived relationships wherever they exist, and when relationships must be borrowed from elsewhere, this additional uncertainty should be explicitly acknowledged.
papers.summary_cn: 该研究整合了全球深海大洋性鱼类的 length–weight relationships (LWRs) 数据，构建统一数据集并评估其分类与地理覆盖偏差。研究新增7个物种的LWR估算，并为23个物种补充形态学信息，使LWR总量达227种427条，但仅覆盖已知深海大洋性鱼类多样性的约15%。覆盖度严重偏向小型垂直洄游物种（尤其 Myctophidae）和北大西洋，而南大西洋、印度洋及太平洋大部分区域仍严重缺乏采样。异速指数 b 中位数接近等速生长（3.09），但种内变异几乎与种间变异相当，表明单一LWR不宜视为物种固定特征，建议优先使用本地推导的关系式。

papers.title: Assessment of Gear Design Influence on Catch Composition and Juvenile Bycatch in Dolnet Fisheries of Maharashtra, India
papers.authors: Sharma, S.K.; Remesan, M.P.; Landge, A.T.; Madhu, V.R.; Jha, P.N.; Ramteke, K.K.; Donadkar, R.R.
papers.abstract: Background: The dolnet fishery is a vital component of Maharashtra’s marine economy, significantly contributing to coastal livelihoods and seafood production. This study addresses the gap by investigating gear design variations and their influence on catch composition, juvenile bycatch and environmental parameters such as tidal amplitude across Maharashtra’s dolnet operations. Methods: Field experimental studies were conducted over an 18 month period (January 2023 to October 2024) in Raigad district of Maharashtra. Dolnet gear specifications, including net length, mesh gradation, materials, operational procedure and codend design were systematically recorded. Catch composition data were collected and arranged seasonally and species were identified to the lowest taxonomic level. Statistical analyses including descriptive study of temporal catch composition, comparisons of catch per unit effort (CPUE) and correlation analysis between tidal amplitude and total catch. Result: A total of 91 species from 44 families and 19 orders were identified, with maximum species abundance observed during the post-monsoon season. Catch diversity was lowest during the monsoon due to restricted fishing operations. Harpadon nehereus (64%) dominated catches, particularly during post-monsoon, when tidal amplitudes peaked. A strong positive correlation (r = 0.84) was observed between tidal amplitude and catch per boat. Juvenile bycatch exceeded 20% during August to September, indicating low gear selectivity. The introduction of 40 mm square mesh codends is recommended to mitigate juvenile retention. This measure aligns with FAO guidelines and can enhance ecological sustainability in dolnet based fisheries.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在评估印度马哈拉施特拉邦dolnet渔业的渔具设计差异对渔获组成、幼鱼兼捕及潮差等环境因素的影响。通过2023年1月至2024年10月在Raigad地区的18个月实地实验，系统记录了网具规格并分析了CPUE与潮差的相关性。共鉴定出19目44科91种，Harpadon nehereus占主导（64%），潮差与单船渔获量呈强正相关（r=0.84），8—9月幼鱼兼捕率超过20%，表明渔具选择性较低。建议采用40 mm方形网目codend以减少幼鱼滞留，符合FAO准则并有助于提升dolnet渔业的生态可持续性。

papers.title: Organic carbon mineralization, stock, and sequestration in an unvegetated mud flat and adjacent Suaeda japonica marsh of Garolim Bay, Yellow Sea: insights from δ13C–DIC
papers.authors: An, Sung-Uk; Kim, Hye Seon; Oh, Taek-Kwan; Yi, Chang-Ho; Bae, Seongjun; Jo, Chaeryeong; Yu, Cheol; Lee, Yeonjung; Mok, Jin-Sook; Jeong, Hyun-Jeong
papers.abstract: To elucidate the biogeochemical linkage between organic carbon (OC) mineralization and sequestration in coastal wetlands, we investigated sediment and pore-water biogeochemistry, 210 Pb-derived sedimentation rates, and δ 13 C–DIC (Keeling plot) signatures in an unvegetated mud flat (UMF) and an adjacent Suaeda japonica -vegetated marsh (SJ). OC mineralization (OC min ) was consistently higher at SJ than that at UMF in both seasons, with a pronounced summer surface hotspot coinciding with peak root biomass, whereas Keeling-plot intercepts diverged more strongly from bulk δ 13 C–TOC at UMF, indicating that the DIC produced there was isotopically more distinct from bulk sedimentary OC. Dissolved Ca 2+ measured during the incubations constrained carbonate dissolution to less than 2% of depth-integrated DIC production in summer, indicating that this isotopic offset does not arise primarily from carbonate dissolution. OC stocks and sequestration rates at both sites were well below global blue carbon means, and OC min exceeded sequestration at both sites in both seasons, corresponding to burial efficiencies of 8.8-23.8%. These results indicate that the presence of S. japonica was associated with a higher supply and microbial turnover of OC relative to the adjacent unvegetated mud flat, and that carbon stock inventories alone are insufficient to characterize the carbon balance of vegetated and unvegetated tidal flats.
papers.summary_cn: 研究对比了黄海Garolim Bay无植被泥滩（UMF）与邻近Suaeda japonica盐沼（SJ）的有机碳矿化、储量与埋藏过程，结合沉积物及孔隙水生物地球化学、210Pb定年沉积速率和δ13C–DIC（Keeling plot）分析。SJ的有机碳矿化速率在两个季节均高于UMF，夏季表层出现与根系生物量峰值吻合的高值热点；UMF的Keeling截距与 bulk δ13C–TOC偏离更大，且溶解Ca2+显示碳酸盐溶解对DIC贡献不足2%，表明同位素偏移并非主要源于碳酸盐溶解。两站点有机碳储量与埋藏速率均低于全球blue carbon均值，矿化量超过埋藏量，埋藏效率仅8.8–23.8%，说明S. japonica植被促进了有机碳供给与微生物周转，仅凭碳储量清单不足以刻画植被与无植被潮滩的碳收支。

papers.title: Development of an acid–enzymatic hydrolysis technology for producing food-grade protein hydrolysate (peptone) from fish and meat processing by-products for food biotechnology applications
papers.authors: Sydykova, Gulzhamal; Smagulova, Zauresh; Kamil, Derbyshev; Zhumanova, Gulnara
papers.abstract: Valorising protein-rich by-products from the meat and fish processing industries is an important approach to sustainable food biotechnology. This study aimed to develop and evaluate an acid–enzymatic hydrolysis technology to produce a protein hydrolysate (microbiological peptone) from meat and fish processing by-products, with potential application as a nitrogen source for microbial cultivation and food biotechnology processes. We investigated secondary meat by-products (bovine rumen, lung, rennet, and meat-and-bone materials), porcine gastric mucosa and pancreas as enzyme sources, and fish by-products (bream, perch, skin, fins, and bones). A total of 72 experimental hydrolysate samples were analysed, including 18 acid, 18 alkaline, and 36 enzymatic hydrolysis variants. We optimised hydrolysis conditions by evaluating the raw material ratio, reagent concentration, pH, temperature, enzyme dosage, and processing time. The optimum process used acid–enzymatic hydrolysis with 3% orthophosphoric acid, followed by enzymatic treatment with 2% porcine pancreas and 8% porcine gastric mucosa at 45–50 °C and pH 6.9, with a fish-to-meat raw material ratio not exceeding 30%. Under these conditions, the hydrolysate contained 15.2% total nitrogen, 4.5% amino nitrogen, 13.5 ± 0.5% dry matter, and a hydrolysis coefficient of 0.94. Drying at an inlet air temperature of 180 ± 1 °C produced microbiological peptone with a final moisture content below 7%, meeting the requirements of GOST 13805-76. The obtained microbiological peptone exhibited satisfactory physicochemical, organoleptic, and microbiological quality characteristics. The proposed acid–enzymatic process demonstrates the potential for converting protein-rich meat and fish processing by-products into microbiological peptone and may represent a promising nitrogen source for microbial cultivation and selected food biotechnology applications. Further studies are required to confirm industrial scalability and broader food-related applications
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在开发酸-酶水解技术，以肉类和鱼类加工副产物为原料制备食品级蛋白水解物（微生物蛋白胨），用作微生物培养的氮源。通过优化原料配比、试剂浓度、pH、温度、酶用量及处理时间等条件，确定了最佳工艺：3%正磷酸酸解后，以2%猪胰和8%猪胃黏膜在45–50 °C、pH 6.9条件下酶解，鱼与肉原料比不超过30%。最优条件下水解物总氮15.2%、氨基氮4.5%、水解系数0.94，经180 °C干燥后所得蛋白胨水分低于7%，符合GOST 13805-76标准，理化及微生物指标合格，显示出工业化转化鱼、肉加工副产物的潜力。

papers.title: From Exposure to Effect: Oxidative Stress Biomarkers as Chemical–Biological Indicators of Heavy Metal Toxicity in Freshwater Fish
papers.authors: Qazi, Adnan Ahmad
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Heavy metal–induced toxicity in freshwater fish is driven at the cellular level by reactive oxygen species (ROS) generated through Fenton chemistry, mitochondrial electron transport chain disruption, and competitive displacement of essential metals at sulfhydryl‐bearing antioxidant molecules and enzymes. The enzymatic antioxidant battery (superoxide dismutase, catalase, glutathione peroxidase) together with the lipid peroxidation end‐product malondialdehyde has been shown in this review to provide a mechanistically grounded and temporally sensitive measure of toxic effect that tracks the Keap1–Nrf2–ARE adaptive cascade far more directly than conventional tissue concentration endpoints can. Subcellular metal partitioning and metallothionein‐mediated sequestration, rather than total tissue burden, are demonstrated to govern which fraction of the internal metal pool is biologically reactive; antioxidant responses integrate this bioavailability information automatically. The biphasic dose–response of enzymatic antioxidants, reflecting early Nrf2‐driven induction followed by direct metal inactivation at higher exposures, is examined as the mechanistic signature that distinguishes adaptive from damage phases at the individual level. Complementary pro‐inflammatory and immunological readouts, including IL‐6, TNF‐α, NF‐κB activation, and altered cytokine balance, are reviewed as second‐tier effect markers that broaden the diagnostic envelope beyond pure redox endpoints. Drawing on evidence from industrially impacted river systems, with Pakistan's Indus Basin serving as a representative developing‐country case, the Adverse Outcome Pathway paradigm is integrated with classical biomarker science, and a three‐stage Bioavailability–Effect Monitoring Framework (BEMF) is proposed as a practical, transferable pathway from exposure measurement to effect‐based environmental assessment. The transition from exposure metrics to effect indicators is argued to constitute a necessary conceptual advance for applied toxicology in the protection of aquatic ecosystems under Anthropocene multistressor conditions.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了重金属对淡水鱼氧化应激毒性机制，指出ROS经Fenton反应、线粒体电子传递链损伤及必需金属竞争置换产生，酶促抗氧化系统（SOD、CAT、GPx）与丙二醛比传统组织浓度终点更能直接反映Keap1–Nrf2–ARE适应性通路。亚细胞金属分配与metallothionein螯合而非总组织负荷决定生物活性金属比例，抗氧化响应的双相剂量效应可区分适应期与损伤期。作者整合Adverse Outcome Pathway框架，以巴基斯坦Indus Basin为案例，提出三阶段Bioavailability–Effect Monitoring Framework（BEMF），推动从暴露指标向效应指标的环境评估转变。

papers.title: Rabbitfish Integration in Offshore Gilthead Seabream Polyculture: Improving Growth Performance, Reducing Disease Burden, and Mitigating Biofouling in Tropical Aquaculture
papers.authors: Mansour, Nabil; Ismail, Ahmed G.; Alhmoudi, Sabhah; Lamghari, Fouad
papers.abstract: Abstract Gilthead seabream ( Sparus aurata ) is one of the most commercially significant species in the Mediterranean and Middle Eastern marine aquaculture, yet intensified production systems expose this species to persistent challenges, including net biofouling, parasitic disease, and reduced growth efficiency. This case study is based on research conducted over two full production cycles (2023–2024) in open-sea cages at Omega Fish Farm, Dadna, Fujairah, United Arab Emirates. The study compared six cages of seabream monoculture with six cages of polyculture incorporating white-spotted rabbitfish ( Siganus canaliculatus ), a herbivorous species with well-documented grazing activity on algal and invertebrate fouling organisms. Key production indicators, including growth rate (GR), specific growth rate (SGR), feed conversion ratio (FCR), feeding rate, and mortality, were assessed throughout the production cycles using area under the curve (AUC) analysis. Biofouling biomass, annelid abundance, and seabream net-biting frequency were evaluated during the first six months of each production cycle. Overall, polyculture significantly improved seabream production performance compared with monoculture and significantly reduced net biofouling biomass, annelid abundance, and seabream net-biting frequency. Enteromyxum leei infection prevalence and severity were also reduced in polyculture cages. During the highest-risk period, peak prevalence was 29.4%, with a median infection degree of 2.5, compared with 49.8% and 4.0, respectively, in monoculture cages. In addition, net replacement intervals were extended to 344 days under polyculture compared with 196 days under monoculture. These findings demonstrate that integrating rabbitfish into offshore seabream production can simultaneously improve production performance, reduce biofouling and parasitic disease burden, and extend net service life, providing a biologically sound and operationally practical strategy for enhancing the sustainability of marine aquaculture in tropical environments. papers.summary_cn: 在阿联酋Fujairah外海网箱中开展两个完整生产周期的案例研究，比较金头鲷（Sparus aurata）单养与混养白斑篮子鱼（Siganus canaliculatus）对生产性能、生物污损及疾病负担的影响。混养显著提高了金头鲷的生长速率、SGR和FCR等生产指标，同时降低了网衣生物污损量、环节动物丰度及金头鲷咬网频率。混养组Enteromyxum leei感染率与感染强度均降低（峰值感染率29.4% vs 49.8%，中位感染度2.5 vs 4.0），换网周期由196天延长至344天。结果表明，篮子鱼混养可同步改善养殖生产、减轻生物污损与寄生虫病负担并延长网衣使用寿命，为热带海水养殖可持续发展提供了实用策略。

papers.title: Geothermal Energy and Circular Economy: A Community Empowerment Model through the KANYAAH (Kamojang Agri-Aquaculture Energized by Geothermal for Harmony) Programme
papers.authors: Purwono, A. Novi; Yanto, Erwandi; Hariyesa, Ovinda; Ramadhany, Al Firqa; Sajida, Reyhana Rashel
papers.abstract: Communities surrounding geothermal operational areas continue to face challenges related to agricultural productivity, post-harvest losses, dependence on chemical inputs, limited utilization of organic waste, and vulnerability to climate change. This study aims to analyze the contribution of the KANYAAH Program as a community empowerment model that integrates direct geothermal utilization with circular economy principles to improve productivity, environmental sustainability, economic resilience, and community well-being. The research employed a qualitative descriptive approach using observations, in-depth interviews, documentation studies, and program performance analysis. The findings indicate that the program successfully transformed geothermal energy into an enabling resource for organic fertilizer production, sustainable farming, food processing, and aquaculture through four integrated sub-programs: Geothermal Organic Fertilizer, Geothermal Farming, geothermal foods, and Geothermal Fishery. This integrated model increased production efficiency, optimized organic and non-hazardous waste utilization, strengthened local economic activities, reduced environmental impacts, and enhanced community capacity and welfare. The novelty of this study lies in the development of an integrated community empowerment framework that combines geothermal direct use technology with a circular economy approach, demonstrating that renewable energy can serve not only as an energy source but also as a catalyst for sustainable rural development.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在分析 KANYAAH 项目作为社区赋权模式，如何将地热能直接利用与循环经济原则相结合，以提升地热作业区周边社区的生产力、环境可持续性与经济韧性。采用定性描述方法，通过观察、深度访谈、文献研究及项目绩效分析进行评估。结果表明，该项目通过地热有机肥、地热种植、地热食品和地热渔业四个子项目，将地热能转化为有机肥生产、可持续农业、食品加工和水产养殖的支撑资源，提高了生产效率、优化了有机废弃物利用并改善了社区福祉。

papers.title: Epidemiology of <i>Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei</i> (EHP) in East Java: Spatiotemporal Distribution and Risk Factors in Shrimp Aquaculture
papers.authors: Jalasena, Bayu; Munjayana, Munjayana; Setiyowati, Evi Dwi; Ramadiansyah, Febry; Fasha, Rodderick Sandro Paundra
papers.abstract: Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei (EHP) remains a persistent challenge in shrimp aquaculture because it severely reduces growth rates. This study investigated the spatio-temporal dynamics of EHP infection in East Java, Indonesia, and identified key risk factors relevant to local production systems. Over one year, 990 samples were collected, comprising 523 from shrimp and 467 from pond water, across five major regions: Banyuwangi, Jember, Madura, Probolinggo, and Situbondo. Statistical analyses commenced with Chi-square tests to assess associations, followed by multivariate logistic regression to identify significant predictors of infection. The overall EHP prevalence was 27.07%, with substantial variation by sample type and region. Infection rates were significantly higher in shrimp (40.54%) than in water samples (11.99%), and Banyuwangi exhibited the highest prevalence at 32.50%. The regression model demonstrated that water samples were significantly less likely to test positive than shrimp, and that Jember, Madura, and Situbondo had lower odds of infection compared to Banyuwangi. Seasonal trends were evident, with July representing a period of elevated risk and September a period of reduced transmission. These findings indicate that biological, spatial, and seasonal factors influence EHP infection dynamics in East Java. Targeted monitoring of shrimp tissues in high-risk regions such as Banyuwangi during mid-year months is recommended for effective disease management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究旨在明确印尼东爪哇地区虾类养殖中 Enterocytozoon hepatopenaei（EHP）感染的时空动态及其关键风险因素。研究历时一年，在五大主产区采集990份样品（虾523份、池塘水467份），采用卡方检验和多因素logistic回归分析。结果显示总体EHP流行率为27.07%，虾样品感染率（40.54%）显著高于水样（11.99%），Banyuwangi流行率最高（32.50%）；7月为高风险期，9月传播减弱。建议在高风险区域（如Banyuwangi）年中重点监测虾组织以实施有效疾病管理。

papers.title: Medicinal Plants in Aquaculture: A Bibliometric and Narrative Review of Mechanisms and Applications
papers.authors: Li, Peng-Shuai; Zhu, Mei-Hua; Mao, Xiao-Jiang; Liu, Man; Li, Dong-Li; Shao, Jian-Chun; Huang, Wen-Shu; Huang, Bei
papers.abstract: The rapid expansion of aquaculture has increased the demand for sustainable strategies to improve animal performance and control infectious diseases while reducing reliance on conventional chemotherapeutics. Medicinal plants have attracted increasing interest because their bioactive compounds can influence host physiology and exert activities against a broad range of pathogens. These effects involve both direct pathogen inhibition and modulation of host defense, including immune responses, inflammation, apoptosis, and intestinal homeostasis. However, their application is constrained by incomplete mechanistic understanding, species- and dose-dependent efficacy, and inconsistent standardization of plant materials and formulations. This review summarizes recent advances in the use of medicinal plants in aquaculture, with emphasis on growth promotion and antiviral, antibacterial, antiparasitic, and antifungal activities. We examine the mechanisms underlying these effects, including nutritional regulation, microbiota, immune responses, and direct effects on pathogens. We also discuss major challenges in dose optimization, species-specific responses, mechanistic validation, and plant–microbiota interactions, and highlight the need for standardized evaluation and multi-omics approaches to support their safe and consistent application in sustainable aquaculture.
papers.summary_cn: 该综述通过文献计量与叙述性分析，系统总结了药用植物在水产养殖中促进生长及抗病毒、抗菌、抗寄生虫和抗真菌的应用。其作用机制涉及营养调控、肠道微生物群、免疫应答调节及对病原体的直接抑制。当前应用受限于机制认识不足、物种与剂量依赖性效果差异以及植物材料和制剂标准化缺乏，亟需标准化评价体系与多组学方法支撑其安全一致的应用。

papers.title: Widespread Microplastic Burden in the Endemic Freshwater Fish Squalius pursakensis Sarısu Stream, Türkiye: Evidence of Chronic Environmental Pressure and One Health Implications
papers.authors: Nurlu Aydogdu, Nurten; Can, Tuğba; Aydoğdu, Ali; Üstün, Gökhan E Erdem
papers.abstract: Abstract Microplastic (MP) pollution is increasingly recognized as a pervasive environmental stressor in freshwater ecosystems. This study evaluated the occurrence, characteristics, and ecological implications of MPs in the gastrointestinal tract of the endemic freshwater fish Squalius pursakensis from Sarısu Stream (Sakarya River Basin, Türkiye). MPs were detected in all examined individuals (n = 23), indicating a 100% prevalence. MP abundance ranged from 6 to 51 particles per individual, with a mean ± SD of 27.65 ± 11.49 MP/individual. Fibers were the dominant morphological type (48.5%), followed by fragments (33.5%), while particle sizes ranged from 0.1 to 0.3 mm and approximately 50% of the particles were transparent. Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy identified six polymer types, with Nylon (PA6+PA66) as the predominant polymer (46.7%), followed by polypropylene and polyvinyl chloride A significant positive correlation between total length and MP abundance was observed in bivariate analysis (rs = 0.41, p = 0.004); however, this association was not retained in multivariate negative binomial modeling, suggesting that biometric traits did not independently predict MP burden. These findings provide baseline evidence of widespread MP exposure in an endemic freshwater fish from a semi-rural Anatolian watershed. Although potential textile- and wastewater-related inputs may contribute to the observed contamination, specific sources cannot be confirmed without environmental source-tracking. The findings, therefore, highlight the value of endemic freshwater species in MP monitoring and provide a basis for further investigation of the ecological implications of persistent MP exposure.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究评估了土耳其Sarısu溪（Sakarya河流域）特有淡水鱼Squalius pursakensis胃肠道中微塑料（MP）的赋存特征及生态意义。所有样本（n=23）均检出MP，丰度为6–51 particles/individual（均值27.65±11.49），以纤维（48.5%）为主，粒径0.1–0.3 mm，Nylon（PA6+PA66）为优势聚合物（46.7%）。双变量分析显示体长与MP丰度显著正相关（rs=0.41, p=0.004），但多变量负二项模型未保留该关联，表明生物计量特征不能独立预测MP负荷。研究为特有淡水鱼MP监测价值提供了基线证据，并提示需进一步开展环境源追踪以确认纺织及废水相关输入。

papers.title:
Sodium Alginate
Modification as a Promising Strategy
for Inducing Oral Immune Tolerance to Fish Gelatin-Based Cell Scaffolds
to Control Allergenic Risks
papers.authors: Wang, Shuya; Shi, Mengqing; Li, Ya; Qin, Lei; Jia, Shuqi; Chen, Xiuhan; Hou, Siqi; Lin, Songyi; Sun, Na
papers.journal:
Journal of Agricultural
and Food Chemistry
papers.abstract: Abstract The allergenic risks of fish gelatin-based cell scaffolds remain an unresolved issue. The study proposed a sodium alginate modification strategy to solve allergenic risks by inducing oral immune tolerance. The strategy significantly reduced antibody production, mast cell degranulation, inflammatory mediator release, and Th2 immune response. Peptidomics and bioinformatics prediction revealed that the strategy protected CD4+ T cell epitopes (FTGASGLPG) and CD8+ T cell epitopes (e.g., GATGPTGL). Additionally, intestinal barrier function, integrity, and Th1/Th2/Th17/Treg immune balance were restored. Notably, compared with the positive control group, RORγt expression was suppressed by 73.42%, and FOXP3 expression was increased by 5.34-fold in the 1% group. Gut microbiota analysis suggested that sodium alginate modification significantly downregulated the abundance of Faecalibaculum and Lactobacillus, while increasing Prevotella. It regulates the intestinal microbiota, thereby contributing to immune tolerance induction. Overall, sodium alginate modification represents a promising strategy to promote immune tolerance.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在解决鱼明胶基细胞支架的致敏风险，提出海藻酸钠修饰策略以诱导口服免疫耐受。该策略显著降低了抗体产生、肥大细胞脱颗粒、炎症介质释放及Th2免疫应答，并保护了CD4+和CD8+ T细胞表位，同时修复肠道屏障功能及Th1/Th2/Th17/Treg免疫平衡。肠道菌群分析表明，海藻酸钠修饰通过调节肠道微生物组成（下调Faecalibaculum和Lactobacillus、增加Prevotella）促进免疫耐受诱导。

papers.title: Bacteriophage Bioimmobilisation: Current Methods and Applications with Future Perspectives for Fish Supplementation
papers.authors: Jankowski, Wojciech; Nawrotek, Paweł; Miastowska, Anna; Mizielińska, Małgorzata
papers.abstract: This review addresses methods and conditions for the bioimmobilisation of bacterio-phages, focusing on strategies that will preserve phage activity and enable their effective and/or controlled release in target environments. Key advances in this field are discussed, with particular emphasis on a bibliometric analysis of primary source data. In this context, future directions will include the encapsulation of previously unstudied bacteriophages, particularly those targeting fish pathogens, as well as the optimization of bioimmobilisation processes to develop stable dietary supplements. Attention is also given to identifying suitable systems for the safe incorporation of phages into feed and/or supplement formulations.
papers.summary_cn: 本文综述了噬菌体生物固定化（bioimmobilisation）的方法与条件，重点探讨在目标环境中保持噬菌体活性并实现有效或可控释放的策略，并基于文献计量分析梳理该领域主要进展。未来方向包括封装尚未研究的噬菌体（尤其是靶向鱼类病原菌者），以及优化生物固定化工艺以开发稳定的膳食补充剂，同时关注将噬菌体安全纳入饲料或补充剂配方的适宜体系。

papers.title: Spatial and temporal variability of Honduran benthic communities and reef functionality throughout the fourth global coral bleaching event
papers.authors: Paden, Gianna; Muñiz-Castillo, Aaron Israel; Núñez-Vallecillo, Mayra; Guerrero, Claudia Alejandra; Ortega, Pamela; Brady, Gisselle; Green, Rebecca H.; Molina Mendoza, Fiama Valeska; Rivera, Antonella
papers.abstract: Mass coral bleaching events are intensifying under climate change, yet their ecological consequences remain highly context dependent. We quantified shifts in benthic community structure, coral diversity and reef functionality during the 2023–2025 Fourth Global Mass Coral Bleaching Event (GCBE) in Tela Bay and Roatán, Honduras, two traditionally high-cover reef systems within the Mesoamerican Reef (MAR). Following three years of elevated heat stress (maximum DHW of 18 °C-weeks and 12 °C-weeks) both locations exhibited marked declines up to 60% in live coral cover, accompanied by increases of up to 58% in fleshy macroalgae cover, indicating shifts toward more algal-dominated benthic states. These shifts were accompanied by declines in coral diversity and reef functional index (RFI), suggesting reduced contribution of structurally important coral assemblages to key ecological processes. However, benthic community responses to bleaching were not uniform across sites. Increased multivariate dispersion following the event revealed substantial site-level heterogeneity, particularly in Tela Bay, where some sites retained greater coral cover and higher post-disturbance diversity indices, suggesting localized differences in resistance or early recovery potential. Coral community shifts were also strongly associated with declines in historically abundant taxa such as Agaricia tenuifolia , indicating that prolonged thermal stress can reduce the functional contribution of common and previously persistent coral taxa, not only structurally complex reef-building species. Our results show that even reef locations with high coral cover remain vulnerable to bleaching-driven reorganization of benthic communities and associated functional declines. Nevertheless, strong spatial variability among sites suggests that local environmental conditions and early-bleaching assemblage structure may mediate severity and recovery potential. These findings highlight the need to prioritize site-specific monitoring and management strategies in the MAR that identify and protect reefs with greater persistence potential under accelerating climate stress.
papers.summary_cn: 2023—2025年第四次全球珊瑚白化事件期间，研究量化了洪都拉斯Tela Bay与Roatán两处高珊瑚覆盖度礁区的底栖群落结构、珊瑚多样性与礁体功能性变化。结果显示，两地活珊瑚覆盖度下降达60%、肉质大型藻类覆盖度上升达58%，珊瑚多样性与reef functional index (RFI)同步下降，且群落变化与*Agaricia tenuifolia*等历史优势种的衰退密切相关。白化响应存在显著空间异质性，Tela Bay部分站点保留了较高珊瑚覆盖度与灾后多样性，提示局部环境条件与白化前群落结构可调节受损程度与恢复潜力，强调需在Mesoamerican Reef (MAR)推行站点特异性监测与保护策略。

papers.title: No identified genetic effects of dam construction or releasing hatchery-reared brown trout (Salmo trutta) to a Norwegian wild brown trout population
papers.authors: Taugbøl, Annette; Vøllestad, Leif Asbjørn; Museth, Jon
papers.abstract: In the River Gudbrandsdalslågen, a hydropower dam blocked upstream migration of brown trout in the early 1960s and reduced natural production along a 4.4-km minimum-flow reach. A fishway was constructed in 1966, and annual stocking of 15,000 juvenile trout began in 1973. We evaluated the genetic consequences using 91 neutral SNPs from historic and contemporary scale samples collected from mature trout over a century (1909-2015). Contemporary juveniles from multiple spawning areas in the main river, both upstream and downstream of the dam, and in tributaries were also analyzed to assess population structure and group migratory fish from the historic dataset to geographic origins. Contemporary samples formed three genetically distinct groups corresponding to the lower and upper main river and one tributary. Genetic differentiation increased with geographic distance but was not associated by the hydropower dam. Historic samples clustered with the contemporary lower main-river group. Despite significant isolation by time, differentiation among years was weak. This long-term genetic stability likely reflects a large effective population size, maintained habitat connectivity, and use of local broodstock for stocking.
papers.summary_cn: 在挪威Gudbrandsdalslågen河，水电站大坝自1960年代阻断褐鳟（Salmo trutta）上溯通道并缩减了4.4 km减水河段的自然产量，1966年修建鱼道，1973年起每年放流1.5万尾幼鱼。研究利用1909–2015年历史与当代鳞片样本的91个中性SNP，结合主河坝上坝下及支流多个产卵区当代幼鱼，评估建坝与放流对野生种群的遗传影响。当代样本形成下游主河、上游主河和一条支流三个遗传群，遗传分化随地理距离增加但与大坝无关，历史样本聚入当代下游主河群，年间分化虽显著但很弱。长期的遗传稳定性可能源于较大的有效种群规模、维持的栖息地连通性以及使用本地亲鱼放流。

papers.title: Prey consumption and condition of endangered age‐0 pallid sturgeon Scaphirhynchus albus and co‐located congeners: An assessment of surrogacy
papers.authors: Gosch, Nathan J. C.; Gemeinhardt, Todd R.; Civiello, Anthony P.; Bonneau, Joseph L.
papers.abstract: Abstract The capture of wild age‐0 pallid sturgeon Scaphirhynchus albus was rare historically. However, an unprecedented high number of captures during 2021, coupled with a more typical year in 2020, provided a unique opportunity to address diet‐related knowledge gaps during early life and evaluate surrogacy relationships with abundant congener individuals. We assessed diet and body condition of 55 age‐0 pallid sturgeon and 139 co‐located non‐pallid Scaphirhynchus individuals of similar size. Both pallid and non‐pallid individuals primarily consumed Chironomidae (Diptera), with Lopescladius and Paracladopelma being the most frequently consumed prey genera for both groups. Age‐0 pallid sturgeon also yielded similar body condition as co‐located non‐pallid individuals during both years. Given the unprecedented number of captures, this work is a valuable case study for assessing surrogacy relationships involving an endangered fish in the wild and provides increased confidence in previous studies with more limited captures suggesting a valid surrogate relationship between an abundant congener (shovelnose sturgeon Scaphirhynchus platorynchus ) and rarer age‐0 pallid sturgeon <40‐mm long. These results, coupled with prior research, provide evidence refuting the hypotheses that inadequate prey resources or less efficient prey assimilation are the limiting factor for pallid sturgeon recruitment to age 1.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了濒危 pallid sturgeon（*Scaphirhynchus albus*）0龄个体与同域近缘种的食性与体况，以评估以常见近缘种作为替代种的可行性。2020和2021年共采集55尾 pallid sturgeon 和139尾体型相近的非 pallid *Scaphirhynchus* 个体，两组均以摇蚊科（Chironomidae）为主要饵料，优势属为 *Lopescladius* 和 *Paracladopelma*，且体况无显著差异。结果表明，常见 shovelnose sturgeon（*S. platorynchus*）可作为体长<40 mm 的0龄 pallid sturgeon 的有效替代种，并反驳了饵料资源不足或摄食同化效率低是限制 pallid sturgeon 补充至1龄关键因素的假说。

papers.title: Observation of high proportions of unmated females in kuruma prawn Penaeus japonicus in the Seto Inland Sea: implications for a mate-finding Allee effect
papers.authors: Sato, Taku; Kotani, Nao; Ueta, Yukio; Yoshioka, Takuya; Ando, Daisuke; Kimoto, Sho; Morita, Shogo; Tsutsumi, Kentaro; Yamamoto, Soichiro; Inokuchi, Daiki
papers.abstract: Abstract The abundance of kuruma prawn Penaeus japonicus in Japanese waters has declined markedly since the mid-1990s. Despite this long-term decline, the underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood, limiting the development of effective stock management strategies. One consequence of reduced population density may be lower encounter rates between mates, potentially suppressing the species’ reproductive rate through a mate-finding Allee effect, in which the probability of mating decreases as population density declines. Yet, this mechanism has received little attention in conventional fisheries management. In this study, we investigated whether a mate-finding Allee effect occurs in P. japonicus populations in the Seto Inland Sea, using market-based sampling. Our results revealed a high proportion of unmated females (> 30%), even among those sampled immediately before or after spawning. As a result of Bayesian generalized linear mixed models fitting for the probability that a female was unmated, interannual variation in population abundance, used as a proxy for individual density, was considered a possible explanation for this high proportion, implicating occurrence of a mate-finding Allee effect. This study provides valuable insights into mate-finding Allee effects in Penaeus japonicus , which may contribute to reduced mating success and the recent population decline, with implications for stock assessment and management.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以市场采样调查濑户内海日本对虾（Penaeus japonicus）雌虾的交配状况，检验种群密度下降是否引发 mate-finding Allee effect。结果显示，即使在产卵前后采样的个体中，未交配雌虾比例仍超过30%，且贝叶斯广义线性混合模型表明种群丰度的年际变化可解释这一高比例。研究提示 mate-finding Allee effect 可能降低交配成功率，进而加剧种群衰退，对 stock assessment 与管理具有启示意义。

papers.title: Everyday adaptation in a gilded trap: Risk-taking and resilience in Maine’s lobster fishery
papers.authors: Kilchenmann, Joelle; Burnham, Theresa L. U.; Leslie, Heather M.; Reardon, Kathleen M.; Samhouri, Jameal F.; Stoll, Joshua S.
papers.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
papers.abstract: Flexibility is widely regarded as an enabling factor of adaptive capacity among natural resource users. Yet, as ecological systems around the world become increasingly simplified and social environments reduce diversification options, flexibility is becoming limited. Despite this trend, efforts to study how people adapt within the confines of constrained social–ecological systems have been sparse. Here, we broaden the analysis of resilience through a study of the American lobster fishery in Maine, United States, one of the most valuable fisheries in the world. Drawing on 307,000 observations from 3,515 harvesters over a 13-y period (2010–2022), we used a generalized linear mixed-effects model to analyze how sociodemographic characteristics, economic conditions, and time shape the probability of fishing during poor weather conditions, which we define as high-risk. We find demographic and socioeconomic heterogeneity in risk-taking: Men, mid-career harvesters, and captains of larger businesses were more likely to fish in risky conditions, and both low landings and high catch prices increased risk-taking. Contrary to our prediction, however, we observed an overall decline in risk-taking through time. We argue that harvesters instead relied on everyday adaptation—individual-scale, short- and medium-term adjustments in business strategy that occur within the constraints of the existing social–ecological system—to maintain resilience without increasing risk. Observable shifts in fleet composition, including use of larger vessels and higher-capacity licenses, lend support to this understanding. These results suggest that even in highly constrained social–ecological systems, protected response spaces and comanagement structures can enable often overlooked forms of flexibility.
papers.summary_cn: 研究基于美国缅因州美洲螯龙虾渔业2010–2022年间3,515名捕捞者的30.7万条观测数据，采用广义线性混合效应模型，分析社会人口特征、经济状况和时间如何影响恶劣天气下出海捕捞（即高风险行为）的概率。结果显示，男性、职业生涯中期捕捞者及大型企业船长更倾向于冒险作业，低渔获量与高价格亦提升冒险概率，但整体冒险行为随时间下降。作者认为捕捞者通过个体尺度、短中期的“日常适应”策略（如船队结构向大型船舶和高容量许可证转变）在既有社会-生态约束下维持韧性，而非增加风险，表明受保护响应空间与共同管理结构可激发常被忽视的灵活性。

papers.title: Cis-regulatory inactivation of vitamin D signaling confers extreme calcium tolerance in Jialing fish
papers.authors: Zhang, Nan; Zhou, Yongsen; Feng, Jianbin; Yang, Tianhao; Liu, Huilin; Zhang, Yongsheng; Chen, Lingyun; Xiao, Weiyang; Wang, Tai; Hsueh, Aaron J. W
papers.abstract: The turquoise karst lakes of China’s Jiuzhaigou Nature Reserve harbor among the highest natural calcium concentrations known in freshwater, around threefold higher than adjacent rivers. Yet the Jialing fish ( Schizopygopsis kialingensis ) thrives there with serum calcium levels indistinguishable from river-dwelling conspecifics. We show that this calcium tolerance arose through evolutionary loss of vitamin D signaling. Lake and river populations diverged ∼410,000 years ago. Gill transcriptomics revealed >90% suppression of vitamin D receptor b ( vdrb ) and 99% reduction of its downstream calcium transporter calb2a in lake fish. Zebrafish knockout of either gene enhanced survival under hypercalcemia. We traced this suppression to specific mutations in a vdrb enhancer that reduce its activity. These findings reveal that regulatory dismantling of a canonical endocrine pathway can drive vertebrate adaptation to extreme environments, providing a clear example of how cis-regulatory evolution can drive ecological adaptation.
papers.summary_cn: 九寨沟喀斯特湖泊钙浓度约为邻近河流的三倍，但嘉陵裸裂尻鱼（Schizopygopsis kialingensis）能在其中正常生存，血清钙水平与河流种群无异。研究发现，湖泊与河流种群约在41万年前分化，湖泊鱼鳃中维生素D受体b（vdrb）表达抑制超过90%，下游钙转运体calb2a降低99%，且vdrb增强子突变导致其活性下降。斑马鱼敲除vdrb或calb2a可提高高钙环境下的存活率，表明维生素D信号通路的顺式调控失活驱动了该物种对极端钙环境的适应。

papers.title: From plankton to fish: 21st-century redistribution of marine biodiversity and the changing role of rare species
papers.authors: Couce, Elena; Greig, Lily; Engelhard, Georg H.; Pinnegar, John K.; Cooper, Keith M.; Hélaouët, Pierre; Pecuchet, Laurene; Peck, Myron A.; Lindegren, Martin; Thompson, Murray S. A.
papers.abstract: Predictions of climate-driven marine biodiversity change typically overlook noncommercial and rare taxa, leading to an incomplete and potentially biased understanding of change. We address this gap by quantifying α-, β-, and γ-diversity using Hill numbers consistently across co-occurring phytoplankton, zooplankton, benthos, and fish taxonomic groups. Using Bayesian additive regression trees and extensive survey data, we project climate-driven biodiversity change in the northeast Atlantic until 2100. We show that climate change could redistribute biodiversity both within taxonomic groups, altering the contribution of rare species, and across the food web. Widespread increases in fish and benthos species richness, reflecting poleward migration, often coincided with declines in zooplankton and phytoplankton richness, potentially disrupting energy transfer from lower to higher trophic levels. By identifying areas with high biodiversity across taxonomic groups and predicting how these could change in the future, we provide a framework to support proactive conservation actions to help achieve global biodiversity targets in a changing climate.
papers.summary_cn: 研究利用Hill numbers统一量化东北大西洋浮游植物、浮游动物、底栖生物和鱼类共现类群的α、β和γ多样性，并借助Bayesian additive regression trees预测至2100年气候变化驱动的生物多样性变化。结果显示，气候变化在改变各类群内部稀有物种贡献的同时，也重塑了跨营养级的多样性分布：鱼类和底栖生物物种丰富度因向极迁移而普遍上升，却常与浮游动物和浮游植物丰富度下降同步，可能削弱从低营养级向高营养级的能量传递。研究识别了跨类群高多样性区域及其未来变化，为气候变化下的前瞻性保护行动提供了框架。

papers.title: Plenty of fish in the sea, but only one multimodal feather star robot
papers.authors: McDonnell, Parker; Xu, Nicole W.
papers.abstract: A feather star–inspired soft swimming robot achieves multimodal 3D maneuverability with minimal actuation using a mechanically intelligent body design.
papers.summary_cn: 受羽星启发的软体游泳机器人通过机械智能本体设计，在极少驱动下实现多模态三维机动。

papers.title: Proposals to Reform the Minister’s Power to Promulgate Fisheries- Related Offences in South Africa: Perspectives From Selected Jurisdictions – Part I
papers.authors: Molefhi S Phorego; Hendrik J van As
papers.abstract: The role of Cabinet in the implementation of fisheries legislation and the promulgation of regulations relating to fishery-related offences remains under-studied. This is a global phenomenon and entails instances where the relevant Minister promulgates regulations for the outlawing of fishery-related activities that are not sanctioned by law. However, this approach does not explain why primary legislation, instead of regulations, should not be the mechanism used to combat IUU fishing. By relying on ministerial regulations, instead of treating IUU-related offences as criminal conduct, countries handle such matters in terms of administrative law principles, resulting in lesser penalties for perpetrators. This paper examines the role of the executive authority in the implementation of fisheries legislation and the promulgation of regulations relating to fishery-related offences. Four jurisdictions are selected for comparison, and the conclusions drawn from each jurisdiction are then used as the basis for proposals for legal reform in South Africa in relation to fishery-related crimes.
papers.summary_cn: 研究审视南非内阁在渔业立法实施及渔业相关违法法规颁布中的角色，指出以部长条例而非初级立法处理IUU捕捞违法，导致按行政法原则处置、处罚偏轻。通过比较四个司法辖区的做法，提出南非渔业相关犯罪的法律改革建议。

papers.title: Resolving a 165‐year taxonomic conundrum in African galaxiids (Teleostei: Galaxiidae): Reinstatement of Agalaxis Scott, 1936, revalidation of A. punctifer and A. dubius, and description of a new species
papers.authors: Chakona, Albert; Zarei, Fatah; Skelton, Paul H.; Bragança, Pedro H. N.; Swartz, Ernst R.
papers.abstract: Abstract The Cape galaxias, formerly treated as the single African representative of the family Galaxiidae under the name Galaxias zebratus (Castelnau, 1861), has long masked substantial hidden diversity. We consolidated all available molecular data and generated additional sequences to fill sampling gaps, providing the most comprehensive assessment of historically isolated lineages within this complex to date. Analysis of mitochondrial cyt b and COI sequences identified 15 genetically distinct lineages, most with restricted geographic ranges. Previous phylogenetic studies demonstrated that the African galaxiids are not closely related to Galaxias truttaceus Valenciennes, 1846, the type species of Galaxias , suggesting they may be misclassified. Detailed morphological and osteological examinations identified consistent diagnostic characters separating the Cape galaxiids from Galaxias and other galaxiid genera. Molecular and morphological evidence supports reinstatement of the genus Agalaxis Scott, 1936, for the African galaxiids. We further revalidate Agalaxis punctifer (Castelnau, 1861) and A. dubius (Gilchrist & Thompson, 1917), describe A. peninsulae sp. nov. and designate a neotype for and redescribe A. zebratus s.s. By resolving the application of available names, we establish a taxonomic framework for resolving the remaining undescribed diversity and recognise the Cape galaxiids as a diverse endemic radiation within the Cape Fold Ecoregion.
papers.summary_cn: 整合分子与形态学证据，对非洲Cape galaxiids（原统归为Galaxias zebratus）进行了迄今最全面的分类修订。基于cyt b和COI序列分析识别出15个遗传上独立的lineage，多数分布范围狭窄；形态与骨骼学检查发现其与Galaxias属及其他galaxiid属存在稳定的鉴别特征。据此恢复Agalaxis属（Scott, 1936），重新确认A. punctifer和A. dubius的有效性，描述新种A. peninsulae sp. nov.，并为A. zebratus s.s.指定neotype。该研究为Cape Fold Ecoregion内这一特有raditation的后续分类厘清奠定了基础。

papers.title: Using spatio-temporal models to assist ecosystem-based fisheries management: a New Zealand case study
papers.authors: Grüss, Arnaud; Pinkerton, Matthew H.; McGregor-Tiatia, Vidette
papers.journal: Reviews in Fish Biology and Fisheries
papers.summary_cn: 基于新西兰案例，探讨利用时空模型辅助基于生态系统的渔业管理（ecosystem-based fisheries management），为数据有限的渔业管理提供空间化评估工具。

papers.title: Social-ecological portfolio effects in ecosystem service provision, the case of commercial Pacific salmon fisheries in Canada
papers.authors: Affinito, Flavio; Fortin, Marie-Josée; Gonzalez, Andrew
papers.abstract: Human societies depend on stable ecosystem services, which are often stabilized by the ecological portfolio effect arising from biodiversity. Yet, whether this ecological stability propagates to the socio-economic dimensions of an ecosystem service is poorly understood. This study provides a social-ecological portfolio analysis of an ecosystem service by examining the provisioning service provided by commercial Pacific salmon ( Oncorhynchus ) fisheries in British Columbia, Canada. We used the Essential Ecosystem Service Variables (EESV) framework to analyze longitudinal monitoring data across multiple ecosystem service dimensions: ecological supply (abundance), use (catch), demand (price), instrumental value (landed value), and anthropogenic contribution (effort). We quantified portfolio strength and synchrony at two scales: a provincial multi-species portfolio (driven by species diversity) and regional species-level portfolio (driven by regional diversity). At the provincial scale, we found that species diversity provided a stabilizing portfolio effect across ecological and socio-economic dimensions. However, the underlying dynamics in species pair synchrony were not uniform. For example, we found high synchronicity in the Chinook–Coho pair for ecological supply , and Coho–Pink for instrumental value . This difference suggests that social and economic processes provide an additional, portfolio buffering effect. At the species-level, regional portfolios varied greatly: Pink was the most stable throughout social-ecological dimensions, whereas Chinook showed a weak, synchronous portfolio in ecological supply , highlighting potential vulnerability. Our findings suggest that, while biodiversity underpins overall social-ecological stability, specific ecological dynamics, such as the synchronicity of Chinook dynamics, may threaten ecosystem service stability. This approach highlights the importance of integrated social-ecological monitoring to identify and manage risk.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究以加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省商业太平洋鲑（*Oncorhynchus*）渔业为对象，基于 Essential Ecosystem Service Variables（EESV）框架，从生态供给、利用（catch）、需求（price）、工具价值（landed value）和人为投入（effort）等维度开展社会-生态 portfolio 分析。结果表明，省级多物种层面，物种多样性在生态与社会经济维度均提供了稳定化 portfolio 效应，但物种对间的同步性动态并不一致，如 Chinook–Coho 在生态供给上高度同步、Coho–Pink 在工具价值上高度同步，提示社会经济过程具有额外的缓冲作用。物种层面区域 portfolio 差异显著，Pink 在各维度最为稳定，而 Chinook 在生态供给上呈弱同步 portfolio，存在潜在脆弱性。研究强调，生物多样性虽支撑整体社会-生态稳定性，但特定生态动态（如 Chinook 的同步性）可能威胁生态系统服务稳定性，需通过整合性社会-生态监测识别与管理风险。

papers.title: Site- and landscape-scale estimates of ecological suitability inform desert fish conservation
papers.authors: Friebertshauser, Ryan J; Bestgen, Kevin R
papers.journal: Transactions of the American Fisheries Society
papers.abstract: Abstract Objective Persistence of freshwater fishes native to dryland streams increasingly depends on ecologically informed conservation as environmental and anthropogenic pressures increase. Imperiled Rio Grande Chub Gila pandora and Rio Grande Sucker Pantosteus plebeius require management to slow their declining ­distribution and abundance, but insights into their ecological requirements have been restricted to site-scale inference over limited areas. To expand this understanding and broadly inform conservation efforts, we conducted two assessments of ecological suitability for each species using data collected across their overlapping ranges. The goal of our first assessment was to identify site-scale abiotic and biotic conditions associated with occupancy. Our second assessment sought to explore the importance of landscape-scale covariates to presence and predict probability of presence in unsampled streams. Inference gained from these approaches independently and together enabled us to understand factors that affect the distribution, ecology, and habitat needs of these species, which will improve conservation actions. Methods Fish community surveys, site-level habitat assessments, and remotely sensed landscape scale covariates were measured at 112 sites across the range of Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker in the United States. To better understand site-scale physiochemical conditions and co-occurrences of White Sucker Catostomus commersonii and nonnative trout that are associated with occupancy, we used data from fish community and habitat surveys to fit multispecies occupancy models. We then used presence/absence information from a larger data set and a suite of remotely sensed covariates to develop random forest classification models that identified important landscape-scale predictors of presence. We used these models to predict the probability of presence for each Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker in unsampled streams, and from those predictions we inferred distribution patterns of ecologically suitable streams across our study area. Results Site-scale ecological suitability assessments identified positive relationships between water temperature and occupancy of both Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker. Rio Grande Chub occupancy was also positively associated with the quantity and depth of pools, and Rio Grande Sucker occupancy was negatively related to quantity of riffles. The probability of Rio Grande Chub occupancy was modestly reduced by nonnative trout occupancy, and Rio Grande Sucker occupancy was not associated with any nonnative species. Influenced primarily by modeled mean August stream temperature (NorWeST) and watershed position, defined as upstream drainage area and Strahler order, predictions from random forest models demonstrated higher probabilities of presence in warm, small- to medium-sized streams. While this produced higher proportions of ecologically suitable reaches toward the southern extent of their range in the United States, the greatest linear stream quantity predicted to support presence of both species occurred in north-central New Mexico. Conclusions Our first assessment, which was directed at understanding ecological suitability at the site scale, successfully described abiotic and biotic conditions associated with occupancy by Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker, which is useful to inform habitat restoration, nonnative species management, and the selection of streams and reach conditions that are suitable for repatriation. Our second assessment revealed important landscape-scale predictors of presence and patterns of predicted suitable habitat, information that is required to prioritize conservation regions and select streams for future surveys and repatriation efforts. Together, inference from both assessments more broadly described the ecological needs of Rio Grande Chub and Rio Grande Sucker and will allow managers to direct conservation actions at multiple scales.
papers.summary_cn: 研究旨在通过站点和景观两个尺度评估 Rio Grande Chub（Gila pandora）和 Rio Grande Sucker（Pantosteus plebeius）的生态适宜性，以指导其保护管理。作者在美国两物种分布区内112个站点开展鱼类群落调查和栖息地评估，结合多物种 occupancy 模型与随机森林分类模型，分别识别站点尺度环境因子和景观尺度预测变量。结果显示，两种鱼类的 occupancy 均与水温正相关，Rio Grande Chub 还与水塘数量和深度正相关，且受非本地鳟鱼 occupancy 的轻微负面影响；景观尺度上，8月均温（NorWeST）和流域位置是 presence 的主要预测因子，温暖的中小型溪流适宜性更高。研究为栖息地修复、非本地种管理和再引入选址提供了多尺度的科学依据。

papers.title:
Analysis of Multiple
Tire Rubber-Derived Chemicals
in Fish Bile and Plasma: Analytical Method and Field Assessment in
Puget Sound, WA, USA
papers.authors: da Silva, Denis; Gates, Jonelle; Hattaway, Madison; Harding, Louisa; O’Neill, Sandra; Schultz, Irvin
papers.abstract: Abstract Tire rubber-derived chemicals (TRCs) are known to be highly toxic to fish, but understanding of their environmental levels and fate is still limited. This study presents a new method for the analysis of 18 TRCs, including phenylenediamines (TRC-PDs), their quinone derivatives (TRC-Qs), and rubber vulcanizing and curing-related chemicals (TRC-VCRs) in fish bile and plasma samples. We applied this method in bile and plasma samples from English sole collected in urban, near-urban, and nonurban sites in Puget Sound, WA, USA. TRCs were detected in 100% of bile and 96% of plasma samples from English sole collected from all nine sites in Puget Sound. Mean TRC levels in bile samples per site ranged between 0.8 and 18 ng/mL, while plasma levels ranged between 0.22 and 0.63 ng/mL, with total summed reaching up to 31 ng/mL in bile and 1.3 ng/mL in plasma. TRC-PDs were the most abundant group of TRC in both bile and plasma. Higher levels of TRCs in bile suggests this matrix to be more valuable for environmental monitoring, providing more sensitive detection of TRC during low exposures. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first data set reporting environmental levels of 18 TRCs in the bile and plasma of field-caught fish.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究建立了同时分析鱼胆汁和血浆中18种轮胎橡胶衍生化学品（TRCs，包括phenylenediamines、quinone衍生物及硫化固化相关化学品）的新方法，并应用于美国Puget Sound城市、近郊及非城市站点采集的English sole。所有站点胆汁样本100%检出TRCs，血浆检出率96%，胆汁中TRC-PDs含量最高，胆汁总浓度（最高31 ng/mL）显著高于血浆（最高1.3 ng/mL），表明胆汁是环境监测中更敏感的基质。这是首个报道野外捕获鱼胆汁和血浆中18种TRCs环境水平的数据集。

papers.title: DeformDANet: morphology-aware detection with population estimation for shrimp post-larvae in dense aquaculture imagery
papers.authors: A, Sugunapriya; S, Markkandan
papers.abstract: Introduction Accurate and automated quantification of shrimp post-larvae (PL) in aquaculture hatcheries is critical for stock assessment, production management, and precision aquaculture, yet it remains labor-intensive when performed manually. Existing vision-based monitoring systems struggle with two domain-specific challenges: the biologically deformable morphology of shrimp post-larvae, which flex into irregular C- and S-shaped configurations during swimming, and the high target density in hatchery images, where hundreds of semi-transparent individuals cluster within a single frame, resulting in ambiguous localization and conflicting training signals. Methods To address these limitations, we propose DeformDANet, a dense object detector built upon two novel components. First, a geometry-adaptive Deformable Integrated Spatial Operation (DeformISO) Block aligns receptive fields with the deformable morphology of shrimp post-larvae through deformable feature extraction. Second, a fully vectorized Density-Adaptive Assignment (DAA) strategy replaces conventional fixed neighbourhood target assignment with a per-target radius derived from local k-nearest-neighbour density, thereby adaptively adjusting the positive assignment region and reducing assignment ambiguity in densely populated scenes. Results Extensive experiments on the publicly available PL-Detection benchmark demonstrate that DeformDANet achieves 94.5% mAP@50, 95.8% recall, and a 91.8% F1-score using only 1.38 M parameters and 6.82 GFLOPs, outperforming all compared methods in F1-score, recall, parameter efficiency, and inference speed. Furthermore, the validation-selected threshold configuration improved counting performance, reducing the mean absolute error to 2.75 ± 0.11 larvae per image and increasing the proportion of images with ±20% counting error to 78.87 ± 2.17%. Discussion These results indicate that DeformDANet provides an accurate, robust, and computationally efficient framework for automated vision-based monitoring and population estimation of shrimp post-larvae, supporting intelligent aquaculture management.
papers.summary_cn: 针对对虾仔虾（PL）在育苗场图像中形态易变（C/S形弯曲）且密度高、半透明导致定位模糊的问题，提出形态感知检测器 DeformDANet，其核心为可变形特征提取模块 DeformISO 与基于局部 k 近邻密度的密度自适应标签分配策略 DAA。在 PL-Detection 公开基准上，该模型以仅 1.38 M 参数和 6.82 GFLOPs 达到 94.5% mAP@50、95.8% recall 和 91.8% F1，计数平均绝对误差降至 2.75±0.11 尾/图。结果表明该框架可实现对虾仔虾的高精度、轻量化自动监测与种群估计，服务于精准水产养殖管理。

papers.title: Comparative Study of the Morphological and Meristic Features of African Tiger Fish (Hydrocynus vittatus) from the Congo and Zambezi River Basins
papers.authors: Chilambe, Emman; Pojana, Mebbah; Gondwe, Haggai; Kun, Clara Nyonnohnagbe
papers.journal: East African Journal of Agriculture and Biotechnology
papers.abstract: This study examined the morphological and meristic differences between Hydrocynus vittatus populations from the Chambeshi River in the Congo River Basin and Lake Kariba in the Zambezi River Basin, Zambia. Independent-samples t tests, Mann-Whitney U tests, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) were used to compare the morphometric and meristic traits. Multiple morphometric and meristic counts were found to be significantly different between the two populations (p < 0.001). Chambeshi specimens had bigger body dimensions than Lake Kariba specimens, with a mean weight and total length of 2.500 ± 0.371 kg and 46.193 ± 1.985 cm, compared to 1.803 ± 0.305 kg and 35.823 ± 1.652 cm, respectively. All the effect size ranges were between 0.556 and 0.887, indicating significant phenotypic differentiation. There was good separation of the populations, as shown in the PCA, with the first 2 components explaining 92.09% of the total variation. LDA yielded 100% classification accuracy for both the original and leave-one-out categories. While the present study did not directly test the underlying drivers, the observed difference may be due to geographic isolation, differential environment, habitat characteristics, prey availability, and fishing pressure. The results of this study lay a foundation for understanding the variation in the H. vittatus population and will guide future integrated morphological/genetic investigations for fisheries management and conservation in Zambia.
papers.summary_cn: 本研究比较了赞比亚刚果河流域Chambeshi河与赞比西河流域Kariba湖的非洲虎鱼（Hydrocynus vittatus）种群的形态与计数特征差异。采用t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验、PCA和LDA分析显示，两种群在多项形态和计数指标上差异显著（p < 0.001），Chambeshi种群体型更大（平均体重2.500 kg、全长46.193 cm，Kariba湖分别为1.803 kg和35.823 cm），效应量为0.556–0.887。PCA前两个主成分解释92.09%的总变异，LDA分类准确率达100%，表明两种群存在显著表型分化，推测与地理隔离、环境差异、饵料可得性及捕捞压力有关。

papers.authors: Kutty, Sheila Raman

papers.abstract: A rare presentation of hypopharyngeal foreign body with airway obstruction in an infant was presented at the Scientific and Clinical Society meet at Srinivas Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre, Mukka, Surathkal, Karnataka on 22nd May, 2013.
